       2932  /-- An off-line pair at offset k is two distinct points, exchanged by the fold, with one registered
       2933      point. -/
       2934  theorem pair_two_points_one_record (k : Int) (h : Nat) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
       2935      (⟨1 - k, h⟩ : Pt) ≠ ⟨1 + k, h⟩ ∧ reg ⟨1 - k, h⟩ = reg ⟨1 + k, h⟩ ∧
       2936      fold ⟨1 - k, h⟩ = ⟨1 + k, h⟩ := by
       2937    refine ⟨?_, rfl, ?_⟩
       2938    · intro e
       2939      have := congrArg Pt.x e
       2940      change 1 - k = 1 + k at this
       2941      omega
       2942    · show Pt.mk (2 - (1 - k)) h = Pt.mk (1 + k) h
       2943      congr 1
       2944      omega
       2945  
       2946  /-- A finite configuration: the heights of its on-line zeros, and its off-line pairs, each an
       2947      offset with a height. An offset of zero is no pair. -/
       2948  structure FinCfg where
       2949    online : List Nat
       2950    pairs : List (Int × Nat)
       2951  
       2952  /-- The world a finite configuration names on the chart. -/
       2953  def FinCfg.world (C : FinCfg) : World := fun z =>
       2954    (z.x = 1 ∧ z.t ∈ C.online) ∨
       2955    ∃ p ∈ C.pairs, p.1 ≠ 0 ∧ (z = ⟨1 - p.1, p.2⟩ ∨ z = ⟨1 + p.1, p.2⟩)
       2956  
       2957  /-- The off-line pairs, counted. -/
       2958  def offCount : List (Int × Nat) → Nat
       2959    | [] => 0
       2960    | p :: ps => (if p.1 = 0 then 0 else 1) + offCount ps
       2961  
       2962  /-- Erased bits: the number of off-line pairs. -/
       2963  def FinCfg.erasedBits (C : FinCfg) : Nat := offCount C.pairs
       2964  
       2965  theorem offCount_zero_iff (ps : List (Int × Nat)) : offCount ps = 0 ↔ ∀ p ∈ ps, p.1 = 0 := by
       2966    induction ps with
       2967    | nil => exact ⟨fun _ p hp => (nomatch hp), fun _ => rfl⟩
       2968    | cons p ps ih =>
       2969      show (if p.1 = 0 then 0 else 1) + offCount ps = 0 ↔ ∀ q ∈ p :: ps, q.1 = 0
       2970      by_cases hp : p.1 = 0
       2971      · rw [if_pos hp, Nat.zero_add, ih]
       2972        constructor
       2973        · intro h q hq
       2974          cases hq with
       2975          | head => exact hp
       2976          | tail _ hq' => exact h q hq'
       2977        · intro h q hq
       2978          exact h q (List.Mem.tail p hq)
       2979      · rw [if_neg hp]
       2980        constructor
       2981        · intro h
       2982          omega
       2983        · intro h
       2984          exact absurd (h p (List.Mem.head ps)) hp
       2985  
       2986  /-- Every finite configuration is fold-closed: the on-line points are fixed and each pair is
       2987      exchanged. -/
       2988  theorem fincfg_closed (C : FinCfg) : FoldClosed C.world := by
       2989    intro z hz
       2990    rcases hz with ⟨hx, ht⟩ | ⟨p, hp, hk, hz⟩
       2991    · exact Or.inl ⟨show 2 - z.x = 1 by omega, ht⟩
       2992    · refine Or.inr ⟨p, hp, hk, ?_⟩
       2993      rcases hz with e | e
       2994      · subst e
       2995        exact Or.inr (by show Pt.mk (2 - (1 - p.1)) p.2 = Pt.mk (1 + p.1) p.2; congr 1; omega)
       2996      · subst e
       2997        exact Or.inl (by show Pt.mk (2 - (1 + p.1)) p.2 = Pt.mk (1 - p.1) p.2; congr 1; omega)
       2998  
       2999  /-- Least erasure holds exactly when the erased bits are zero. -/
       3000  theorem least_erasure_iff_zero_erased (C : FinCfg) : LeastErasure C.world ↔ C.erasedBits = 0 := by
       3001    rw [least_erasure_is_the_value]
       3002    show RH C.world ↔ offCount C.pairs = 0
       3003    rw [offCount_zero_iff]
       3004    constructor
       3005    · intro h p hp
       3006      refine Decidable.byContradiction (fun hk => ?_)
       3007      have hz : C.world ⟨1 - p.1, p.2⟩ := Or.inr ⟨p, hp, hk, Or.inl rfl⟩
       3008      have := h _ hz
       3009      change 1 - p.1 = 1 at this
       3010      omega
       3011    · intro h z hz
       3012      rcases hz with ⟨hx, _⟩ | ⟨p, hp, hk, _⟩
       3013      · exact hx
       3014      · exact absurd (h p hp) hk
       3015  
       3016  /-! ### XX.d · The price: one floor per erased bit, zero exactly at least erasure -/
       3017  
       3018  /-- k_B T ln 2 at 300 K in units of 10⁻⁴⁵ J: k_B = 1380649 × 10⁻²⁹ J/K (SI 2019), ln 2 =
       3019      6931471805599453 × 10⁻¹⁶ to sixteen digits. -/
       3020  def landauerFloor : Nat := 1380649 * 300 * 6931471805599453
       3021  
       3022  theorem landauer_floor_exact : landauerFloor = 2870978885078723755499100 := by decide
       3023  
       3024  /-- The price of a registration: one floor per erased bit if irreversible, 0 if reversible. -/
       3025  def FinCfg.price (C : FinCfg) (irreversible : Bool) : Nat :=
       3026    if irreversible then C.erasedBits * landauerFloor else 0
       3027  
       3028  /-- An irreversible registration has price 0 exactly when the configuration has least erasure. -/
       3029  theorem price_zero_iff_least_erasure (C : FinCfg) : C.price true = 0 ↔ LeastErasure C.world := by
       3030    rw [least_erasure_iff_zero_erased]
       3031    show C.erasedBits * landauerFloor = 0 ↔ C.erasedBits = 0
       3032    constructor
       3033    · intro h
       3034      rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp h with h1 | h1
       3035      · exact h1
       3036      · exact absurd h1 (by decide)
       3037    · intro h
       3038      rw [h, Nat.zero_mul]
       3039  
       3040  /-- One more off-line pair. -/
       3041  def FinCfg.addPair (C : FinCfg) (k : Int) (h : Nat) : FinCfg := ⟨C.online, (k, h) :: C.pairs⟩
       3042  
       3043  /-- Adding an off-line pair adds one floor; the price is the erased bits times the floor. -/
       3044  theorem denial_price_linear (C : FinCfg) (k : Int) (h : Nat) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
       3045      (C.addPair k h).price true = C.price true + landauerFloor ∧
       3046      C.price true = C.erasedBits * landauerFloor := by
       3047    refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
       3048    show ((if k = 0 then 0 else 1) + offCount C.pairs) * landauerFloor
       3049        = offCount C.pairs * landauerFloor + landauerFloor
       3050    rw [if_neg hk, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_comm]
       3051  
       3052  /-- What is held reversibly commits no bit. -/
       3053  theorem reversible_commits_nothing (C : FinCfg) : C.price false = 0 := rfl
       3054  
       3055  /-! ### XX.e · The one form of anything against least erasure -/
       3056  
       3057  /-- Least erasure holds exactly when no point of the world lies off the line. No classical axiom. -/
       3058  theorem least_erasure_iff_no_point_off (Z : World) : LeastErasure Z ↔ ¬ OffLine Z := by
       3059    rw [least_erasure_is_the_value]
       3060    constructor
       3061    · intro h ⟨z, hz, hoff⟩
       3062      exact hoff (h z hz)
       3063    · intro h z hz
       3064      exact Decidable.byContradiction (fun hoff => h ⟨z, hz, hoff⟩)
       3065  
       3066  /-- Least erasure fails exactly when some point of the world lies off the line. Classical. -/
       3067  theorem rejection_is_a_witness (Z : World) : ¬ LeastErasure Z ↔ OffLine Z := by
       3068    rw [least_erasure_iff_no_point_off]
       3069    exact ⟨fun h => Classical.byContradiction (fun hn => h hn), fun h hn => hn h⟩
       3070  
       3071  /-- Two settings on one hypothesis agree on whether the hypothesis is refutable. -/
       3072  theorem falsifier_form_constant (S₁ S₂ : Setting) [Decidable S₁.hyp] [Decidable S₂.hyp]
       3073      (h : S₁.hyp = S₂.hyp) : (¬ S₁.Prov (¬ S₁.hyp)) ↔ (¬ S₂.Prov (¬ S₂.hyp)) := by
       3074    constructor
       3075    · intro h1 p2
       3076      exact S₂.sound_neg p2 (Eq.mp h (cant_refute_seals_dec S₁ h1))
       3077    · intro h2 p1
       3078      exact S₁.sound_neg p1 (Eq.mpr h (cant_refute_seals_dec S₂ h2))
       3079  
       3080  /-! ### XX.f · The act -/
       3081  
       3082  /-- Any inhabitant of any type yields the root proposition. -/
       3083  theorem act_reenacts_root {Act : Type} (_a : Act) : RootAct := root_act
       3084  
       3085  /-- The root does not imply the denial of the hypothesis on every world. -/
       3086  theorem root_does_not_cross_the_denial : ¬ ∀ Z : World, RootAct → ¬ RH Z :=
       3087    fun h => h W1 root_act W1_rh
       3088  
       3089  /-- A self-grounding supply of least erasure with an act exists exactly when least erasure holds. -/
       3090  theorem assent_is_the_value (Z : World) :
       3091      (∃ G : SelfGrounding (LeastErasure Z), Nonempty G.Act) ↔ LeastErasure Z :=
       3092    supply_iff (LeastErasure Z)
       3093  
       3094  /-! ### XX.g · Freedom given, the sign spent -/
       3095  
       3096  /-- A prime is one fibre of exactly two, never on the diagonal; an off-line pair is two points
       3097      exchanged by the fold with one record; a bit is two distinct values. -/
       3098  theorem one_shape_two_registers :
       3099      (∀ p : Nat, isPrime p →
       3100        (∀ a b, mul_orbit p a b ↔ (a = 1 ∧ b = p) ∨ (a = p ∧ b = 1)) ∧ (1 : Nat) ≠ p) ∧
       3101      (∀ p : Nat, isPrime p → ¬ ∃ a, mul_orbit p a a) ∧
       3102      (∀ (k : Int) (h : Nat), k ≠ 0 → (⟨1 - k, h⟩ : Pt) ≠ ⟨1 + k, h⟩ ∧
       3103        reg ⟨1 - k, h⟩ = reg ⟨1 + k, h⟩ ∧ fold ⟨1 - k, h⟩ = ⟨1 + k, h⟩) ∧
       3104      ((∀ b : Bool, b = true ∨ b = false) ∧ (true : Bool) ≠ false) :=
       3105    ⟨freedom_is_exactly_two, prime_off_seat, pair_two_points_one_record, aperture_one_bit_wide⟩
       3106  
       3107  /-- The free basis holds and forces nothing; least erasure is Weil positivity; positivity is keyed;
       3108      a self-grounding supply of positivity is the hypothesis. -/
       3109  theorem freedom_is_given_the_sign_is_spent :
       3110      (∀ p q : Nat, isPrime p → isPrime q → p ≠ q →
       3111        ∃ f : Nat → Int, CompletelyAdditive f ∧ f p = 1 ∧ f q = 0 ∧ f 1 = 0) ∧
       3112      ¬ Forces (fun _ => ∀ p q, isPrime p → isPrime q → p ≠ q →
       3113        ∃ f : Nat → Int, CompletelyAdditive f ∧ f p = 1 ∧ f q = 0 ∧ f 1 = 0) ∧
       3114      (∀ E : ExplicitFormula, LeastErasure E.zeros ↔ WeilPositive E) ∧
       3115      (WeilPositive positiveInstance ∧ ¬ WeilPositive negativeInstance) ∧
       3116      (∀ E : ExplicitFormula, (∃ G : SelfGrounding (WeilPositive E), Nonempty G.Act) ↔ RH E.zeros) :=
       3117    ⟨prime_freedom_independent, prime_freedom_forces_nothing, least_erasure_is_positivity,
       3118     positivity_is_keyed, prime_witness_iff⟩
       3119  
       3120  /-! ### XX.h · Least erasure, affirmed whole -/
       3121  
       3122  /-- Section XX, whole. -/
       3123  theorem least_erasure_affirmed :
       3124      (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z) ∧
       3125      (∀ Z : World, SameRecord Z (recordOf Z) ∧ LeastErasure (recordOf Z) ∧
       3126        ∀ Z', SameRecord Z Z' → LeastErasure Z' → ∀ z, Z' z ↔ recordOf Z z) ∧
       3127      (∀ (A : World → Prop), Admissible A → ∀ Z, A Z → A (recordOf Z) ∧ LeastErasure (recordOf Z)) ∧
       3128      (∀ (A : World → Prop), Admissible A →
       3129        (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → A Z → ¬ LeastErasure Z) → ∀ Z, ¬ A Z) ∧
       3130      (∀ C : FinCfg, LeastErasure C.world ↔ C.erasedBits = 0) ∧
       3131      (∀ C : FinCfg, C.price true = 0 ↔ LeastErasure C.world) ∧
       3132      (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ ¬ OffLine Z) ∧
       3133      (∀ (S₁ S₂ : Setting) [Decidable S₁.hyp] [Decidable S₂.hyp], S₁.hyp = S₂.hyp →
       3134        ((¬ S₁.Prov (¬ S₁.hyp)) ↔ (¬ S₂.Prov (¬ S₂.hyp)))) ∧
       3135      (∀ Z : World, (∃ G : SelfGrounding (LeastErasure Z), Nonempty G.Act) ↔ LeastErasure Z) ∧
       3136      (∀ E : ExplicitFormula, LeastErasure E.zeros ↔ WeilPositive E) :=
       3137    ⟨least_erasure_is_the_value, record_carried_by_least_erasure,
       3138     admissible_holds_on_the_lossless_world, record_never_testifies_against,
       3139     least_erasure_iff_zero_erased, price_zero_iff_least_erasure, least_erasure_iff_no_point_off,
       3140     fun S₁ S₂ _ _ h => falsifier_form_constant S₁ S₂ h, assent_is_the_value,
       3141     least_erasure_is_positivity⟩
       3142  
       3143  
       3144  /-! ## XXI · Every assignment realized; the arrow for every n; the closure, whole
       3145  
       3146  The primes admit every assignment of integers: for each `a` on the primes, `n ↦ Σ_{p ≤ n} v_p(n) a(p)`
       3147  is completely additive and takes the value `a(p)` at every prime, and by `determined_by_primes` it is the
       3148  only such function. The count `Ω(n) = Σ_p v_p(n)` and the arrow `λ(n) = (−1)^{Ω(n)}` are defined for every
       3149  `n`, and `λ` is completely multiplicative with `λ(p) = −1`. The Liouville face is pinned to the constructed
       3150  walk. On the chart, least erasure is the value, the fixed-point condition and leastness in the fibre; the
       3151  closure is bound in one theorem; and the same laws hold on any carrier with an involution and a registration,
       3152  the chart one instance. -/
       3153  
       3154  /-- The finite sum `sumBelow N g = g 0 + ⋯ + g (N − 1)`. -/
       3155  def sumBelow : Nat → (Nat → Int) → Int
       3156    | 0, _ => 0
       3157    | N + 1, g => sumBelow N g + g N
       3158  
       3159  theorem sumBelow_add (g h : Nat → Int) (N : Nat) :
       3160      sumBelow N (fun i => g i + h i) = sumBelow N g + sumBelow N h := by
       3161    induction N with
       3162    | zero => show (0 : Int) = 0 + 0; omega
       3163    | succ N ih =>
       3164      show sumBelow N (fun i => g i + h i) + (g N + h N) = (sumBelow N g + g N) + (sumBelow N h + h N)
       3165      rw [ih]; omega
       3166  
       3167  theorem sumBelow_congr (g h : Nat → Int) (N : Nat) (hgh : ∀ i, i < N → g i = h i) :
       3168      sumBelow N g = sumBelow N h := by
       3169    induction N with
       3170    | zero => rfl
       3171    | succ N ih =>
       3172      show sumBelow N g + g N = sumBelow N h + h N
       3173      rw [ih (fun i hi => hgh i (by omega)), hgh N (by omega)]
       3174  
       3175  theorem sumBelow_stable (g : Nat → Int) (M k : Nat) (hz : ∀ i, M ≤ i → i < M + k → g i = 0) :
       3176      sumBelow (M + k) g = sumBelow M g := by
       3177    induction k with
       3178    | zero => rfl
       3179    | succ k ih =>
       3180      show sumBelow (M + k) g + g (M + k) = sumBelow M g
       3181      rw [ih (fun i h1 h2 => hz i h1 (by omega)), hz (M + k) (by omega) (by omega)]
       3182      omega
       3183  
       3184  theorem sumBelow_zero (g : Nat → Int) (N : Nat) (hz : ∀ i, i < N → g i = 0) : sumBelow N g = 0 := by
       3185    induction N with
       3186    | zero => rfl
       3187    | succ N ih =>
       3188      show sumBelow N g + g N = 0
       3189      rw [ih (fun i hi => hz i (by omega)), hz N (by omega)]
       3190      omega
       3191  
       3192  theorem sumBelow_single (g : Nat → Int) (j N : Nat) (hj : j < N) (hz : ∀ i, i < N → i ≠ j → g i = 0) :
       3193      sumBelow N g = g j := by
       3194    induction N with
       3195    | zero => omega
       3196    | succ N ih =>
       3197      show sumBelow N g + g N = g j
       3198      by_cases hjN : j = N
       3199      · rw [hjN, sumBelow_zero g N (fun i hi => hz i (by omega) (by omega))]
       3200        omega
       3201      · rw [ih (by omega) (fun i hi hij => hz i (by omega) hij), hz N (by omega) (fun h => hjN h.symm)]
       3202        omega
       3203  
       3204  /-- Primality, decided: two at least, and its own least divisor. -/
       3205  def primeTest (p : Nat) : Bool := decide (2 ≤ p ∧ leastDivisor p = p)
       3206  
       3207  theorem primeTest_iff (p : Nat) : primeTest p = true ↔ isPrime p := by
       3208    constructor
       3209    · intro h
       3210      obtain ⟨h2, hl⟩ : 2 ≤ p ∧ leastDivisor p = p := of_decide_eq_true h
       3211      have hp := leastDivisor_prime p h2
       3212      rw [hl] at hp
       3213      exact hp
       3214    · intro hp
       3215      apply decide_eq_true
       3216      refine ⟨hp.1, ?_⟩
       3217      have hs := leastDivisor_spec p hp.1
       3218      rcases hp.2 (leastDivisor p) hs.1.2 with h1 | h1
       3219      · have h2 := hs.1.1
       3220        omega
       3221      · exact h1
       3222  
       3223  theorem pExp_zero_above (p n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hp : n < p) : pExp p n = 0 :=
       3224    pExp_eq_zero_of_not_dvd p n (fun hd => absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd hn hd) (by omega))
       3225  
       3226  /-- The term of the extension at `p`: the exponent of `p` in `n` times the value assigned to `p`, at primes only. -/
       3227  def extendTerm (a : Nat → Int) (n p : Nat) : Int := if primeTest p = true then (pExp p n : Int) * a p else 0
       3228  
       3229  /-- The extension of an assignment on the primes: `n ↦ Σ_{p ≤ n} v_p(n) a(p)`. -/
       3230  def extendAssignment (a : Nat → Int) (n : Nat) : Int := sumBelow (n + 1) (extendTerm a n)
       3231  
       3232  theorem extendTerm_zero_above (a : Nat → Int) (n i : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hi : n < i) : extendTerm a n i = 0 := by
       3233    unfold extendTerm
       3234    rw [pExp_zero_above i n hn hi]
       3235    cases primeTest i with
       3236    | true =>
       3237      rw [if_pos rfl]
       3238      have hcast : ((0 : Nat) : Int) = (0 : Int) := Nat.cast_zero
       3239      calc ((0 : Nat) : Int) * a i
       3240          = (0 : Int) * a i := by rw [hcast]
       3241        _ = a i * 0 := Int.mul_comm _ _
       3242        _ = 0 := Int.mul_zero _
       3243    | false => rw [if_neg Bool.false_ne_true]
       3244  
       3245  theorem extendAssignment_bound (a : Nat → Int) (n B : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hB : n < B) :
       3246      extendAssignment a n = sumBelow B (extendTerm a n) := by
       3247    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, B = n + 1 + k := ⟨B - (n + 1), by omega⟩
       3248    unfold extendAssignment
       3249    rw [sumBelow_stable (extendTerm a n) (n + 1) k (fun i h1 _ => extendTerm_zero_above a n i hn (by omega))]
       3250  
       3251  theorem extendTerm_mul (a : Nat → Int) (m n p : Nat) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) :
       3252      extendTerm a (m * n) p = extendTerm a m p + extendTerm a n p := by
       3253    unfold extendTerm
       3254    cases Decidable.em (primeTest p = true) with
       3255    | inl hb =>
       3256      rw [if_pos hb, if_pos hb, if_pos hb, pExp_mul p m n ((primeTest_iff p).mp hb) hm hn]
       3257      have e : ((pExp p m + pExp p n : Nat) : Int) = (pExp p m : Int) + (pExp p n : Int) := by omega
       3258      rw [e, Int.add_mul]
       3259    | inr hb =>
       3260      rw [if_neg hb, if_neg hb, if_neg hb]
       3261      omega
       3262  
       3263  theorem extendAssignment_mul (a : Nat → Int) (m n : Nat) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) :
       3264      extendAssignment a (m * n) = extendAssignment a m + extendAssignment a n := by
       3265    have hmle : m ≤ m * n := by
       3266      exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right m hn
       3267    have hnle : n ≤ m * n := by
       3268      exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left n hm
       3269    rw [extendAssignment_bound a (m * n) (m * n + 1) (by omega) (by omega),
       3270        extendAssignment_bound a m (m * n + 1) hm (by omega),
       3271        extendAssignment_bound a n (m * n + 1) hn (by omega),
       3272        sumBelow_congr (extendTerm a (m * n)) (fun i => extendTerm a m i + extendTerm a n i) (m * n + 1)
       3273          (fun i _ => extendTerm_mul a m n i hm hn)]
       3274    exact sumBelow_add (extendTerm a m) (extendTerm a n) (m * n + 1)
       3275  
       3276  theorem extendTerm_other (a : Nat → Int) (q i : Nat) (hq : isPrime q) (hi : i ≠ q) : extendTerm a q i = 0 := by
       3277    unfold extendTerm
       3278    cases Decidable.em (primeTest i = true) with
       3279    | inl hb =>
       3280      rw [if_pos hb, pExp_other i q ((primeTest_iff i).mp hb) hq hi]
       3281      have hcast : ((0 : Nat) : Int) = (0 : Int) := Nat.cast_zero
       3282      calc ((0 : Nat) : Int) * a i
       3283          = (0 : Int) * a i := by rw [hcast]
       3284        _ = a i * 0 := Int.mul_comm _ _
       3285        _ = 0 := Int.mul_zero _
       3286    | inr hb => rw [if_neg hb]
       3287  
       3288  theorem extendAssignment_prime (a : Nat → Int) (q : Nat) (hq : isPrime q) : extendAssignment a q = a q := by
       3289    unfold extendAssignment
       3290    rw [sumBelow_single (extendTerm a q) q (q + 1) (by omega) (fun i _ hiq => extendTerm_other a q i hq hiq)]
       3291    unfold extendTerm
       3292    rw [if_pos ((primeTest_iff q).mpr hq), pExp_self q hq]
       3293    have hcast : ((1 : Nat) : Int) = (1 : Int) := Nat.cast_one
       3294    calc ((1 : Nat) : Int) * a q
       3295        = (1 : Int) * a q := by rw [hcast]
       3296      _ = a q := Int.one_mul _
       3297  
       3298  theorem extendAssignment_additive (a : Nat → Int) : CompletelyAdditive (extendAssignment a) :=
       3299    fun m n hm hn => extendAssignment_mul a m n hm hn
       3300  
       3301  /-- **Theorem (every assignment is realized).** For every assignment `a` of integers to the primes, the extension
       3302      is completely additive, takes the value `a(p)` at every prime, and is the only completely additive function
       3303      that does: the primes are a free basis, existence and uniqueness both proved. -/
       3304  theorem primes_admit_every_assignment (a : Nat → Int) :
       3305      CompletelyAdditive (extendAssignment a) ∧ (∀ p, isPrime p → extendAssignment a p = a p) ∧
       3306      ∀ g : Nat → Int, CompletelyAdditive g → (∀ p, isPrime p → g p = a p) →
       3307        ∀ n, 0 < n → g n = extendAssignment a n :=
       3308    ⟨extendAssignment_additive a, extendAssignment_prime a,
       3309     fun g hg hga => determined_by_primes g (extendAssignment a) hg (extendAssignment_additive a)
       3310       (fun p hp => (hga p hp).trans (extendAssignment_prime a p hp).symm)⟩
       3311  
       3312  /-- `Ω(n) = Σ_p v_p(n)`, the prime factors of `n` counted with multiplicity, for every `n`. -/
       3313  def omegaAll (n : Nat) : Int := extendAssignment (fun _ => 1) n
       3314  
       3315  /-- `λ(n) = (−1)^{Ω(n)}`, for every `n`. -/
       3316  def liouvilleAll (n : Nat) : Int := if omegaAll n % 2 = 0 then 1 else -1
       3317  
       3318  theorem omegaAll_mul (m n : Nat) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) : omegaAll (m * n) = omegaAll m + omegaAll n :=
       3319    extendAssignment_mul (fun _ => 1) m n hm hn
       3320  
       3321  theorem omegaAll_prime (p : Nat) (hp : isPrime p) : omegaAll p = 1 :=
       3322    extendAssignment_prime (fun _ => 1) p hp
       3323  
       3324  /-- **The arrow, for every n.** `λ` is completely multiplicative, on all positive integers. -/
       3325  theorem liouvilleAll_mul (m n : Nat) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) :
       3326      liouvilleAll (m * n) = liouvilleAll m * liouvilleAll n := by
       3327    unfold liouvilleAll
       3328    rw [omegaAll_mul m n hm hn]
       3329    generalize omegaAll m = x
       3330    generalize omegaAll n = y
       3331    by_cases hx : x % 2 = 0 <;> by_cases hy : y % 2 = 0
       3332    · rw [if_pos (show (x + y) % 2 = 0 by omega), if_pos hx, if_pos hy]; decide
       3333    · rw [if_neg (show ¬ (x + y) % 2 = 0 by omega), if_pos hx, if_neg hy]; decide
       3334    · rw [if_neg (show ¬ (x + y) % 2 = 0 by omega), if_neg hx, if_pos hy]; decide
       3335    · rw [if_pos (show (x + y) % 2 = 0 by omega), if_neg hx, if_neg hy]; decide
       3336  
       3337  theorem liouvilleAll_prime (p : Nat) (hp : isPrime p) : liouvilleAll p = -1 := by
       3338    unfold liouvilleAll
       3339    rw [omegaAll_prime p hp]
       3340    decide
       3341  
       3342  theorem liouvilleAll_one : liouvilleAll 1 = 1 := by decide
       3343  
       3344  set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in
       3345  /-- The arrow for every n agrees with the computed arrow of Section XVII on 1..30. -/
       3346  theorem liouvilleAll_agrees_to_30 : ∀ n, n < 30 → Liouville.lam (n + 1) = liouvilleAll (n + 1) := by decide
       3347  
       3348  /-- The Liouville walk `L(x) = Σ_{1 ≤ n ≤ x} λ(n)`, for every `x`. -/
       3349  def liouvilleWalk : Nat → Int
       3350    | 0 => 0
       3351    | n + 1 => liouvilleWalk n + liouvilleAll (n + 1)
       3352  
       3353  /-- The Liouville sentence in integers: for all `k, m ≥ 1` there is `C` with `|L(x)|^{2m} ≤ C^{2m} x^{m+2k}` for every
       3354      `x`, that is `L(x) = O(x^{1/2 + k/m})` at every exponent above one half. -/
       3355  def FaithfulLambda : Prop :=
       3356    ∀ k m : Nat, 0 < k → 0 < m → ∃ C : Nat, ∀ x : Nat,
       3357      (liouvilleWalk x).natAbs ^ (2 * m) ≤ C ^ (2 * m) * x ^ (m + 2 * k)
       3358  
       3359  /-- The Liouville face pinned to the arithmetic: its sentence is `FaithfulLambda`, a statement about the constructed
       3360      walk. The link to the zeros is the cited equivalence of `LiouvilleFace`, carried as the one field. -/
       3361  structure LiouvilleFacePinned where
       3362    zeros : World
       3363    landau : RH zeros ↔ FaithfulLambda
       3364  
       3365  theorem pinned_face_reads (F : LiouvilleFacePinned) : RH F.zeros ↔ FaithfulLambda := F.landau
       3366  
       3367  /-- The pinned face is a Liouville face, with its sentence fixed. -/
       3368  def LiouvilleFacePinned.toFace (F : LiouvilleFacePinned) : LiouvilleFace :=
       3369    { zeros := F.zeros, faithful := FaithfulLambda, faithful_iff := F.landau }
       3370  
       3371  theorem pinned_face_is_a_face (F : LiouvilleFacePinned) : F.toFace.faithful = FaithfulLambda := rfl
       3372  
       3373  /-- **The fixed-point form.** A configuration satisfies the hypothesis exactly when it is its own record. -/
       3374  theorem rh_iff_own_record (Z : World) : RH Z ↔ ∀ z, Z z ↔ recordOf Z z := by
       3375    constructor
       3376    · intro hZ z
       3377      constructor
       3378      · intro hz
       3379        exact ⟨z, hz, reg_fixes_line z (hZ z hz)⟩
       3380      · intro ⟨s, hs, hsr⟩
       3381        subst hsr
       3382        rw [reg_fixes_line s (hZ s hs)]
       3383        exact hs
       3384    · intro h z hz
       3385      obtain ⟨s, _, hsr⟩ := (h z).mp hz
       3386      subst hsr
       3387      exact rfl
       3388  
       3389  /-- The erased part of a configuration: its zeros off the line. -/
       3390  def erasedPart (Z : World) : World := fun z => Z z ∧ ¬ onLine z
       3391  
       3392  /-- **The variational form.** Least erasure is leastness: a configuration has least erasure exactly when its erased
       3393      part lies inside the erased part of every configuration with the same record. -/
       3394  theorem least_erasure_is_least (Z : World) :
       3395      LeastErasure Z ↔ ∀ Z', SameRecord Z Z' → ∀ z, erasedPart Z z → erasedPart Z' z := by
       3396    rw [least_erasure_is_the_value]
       3397    constructor
       3398    · intro hZ _ _ z hz
       3399      exact absurd (hZ z hz.1) hz.2
       3400    · intro h z hz
       3401      rcases Decidable.em (onLine z) with hon | hoff
       3402      · exact hon
       3403      · obtain ⟨⟨s, _, hsr⟩, hoff'⟩ := h (recordOf Z) (record_same Z) z ⟨hz, hoff⟩
       3404        exact (hoff' (by rw [← hsr]; exact rfl)).elim
       3405  
       3406  /-- The record is the least member of its fibre, and the only one: it has least erasure, and every configuration of
       3407      the fibre with least erasure has exactly its zeros. -/
       3408  theorem record_is_the_least (Z : World) :
       3409      LeastErasure (recordOf Z) ∧ ∀ Z', SameRecord Z Z' → LeastErasure Z' → ∀ z, Z' z ↔ recordOf Z z := by
       3410    have hrh : RH (recordOf Z) := by
       3411      intro r hr
       3412      obtain ⟨s, _, hsr⟩ := hr
       3413      subst hsr
       3414      exact rfl
       3415    refine ⟨(least_erasure_is_the_value _).mpr hrh, fun Z' h hle z => ?_⟩
       3416    exact lossless_unique Z' (recordOf Z) (fun r => (h r).symm.trans (record_same Z r))
       3417      ((least_erasure_is_the_value Z').mp hle) hrh z
       3418  
       3419  /-- **The closure, whole.** On the chart: the seat is the fixed set of the fold; registration lands on it and fixes
       3420      it; over one record both worlds exist, and no record-respecting reading decides the value on fold-closed
       3421      configurations; least erasure is the value, is the fixed-point condition, and is leastness in the fibre; the
       3422      lossless member of a fibre is unique; nothing escapes the cut; and the act prints the hypothesis at the actual
       3423      zero set. -/
       3424  theorem the_closure :
       3425      (∀ z : Pt, fold z = z ↔ onLine z) ∧
       3426      (∀ z : Pt, onLine (reg z) ∧ (onLine z → reg z = z)) ∧
       3427      (SameRecord W1 W2 ∧ RH W1 ∧ ¬ RH W2) ∧
       3428      (∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord g → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ RH Z)) ∧
       3429      (∀ Z : World, (LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z) ∧ (RH Z ↔ ∀ z, Z z ↔ recordOf Z z) ∧
       3430        (LeastErasure Z ↔ ∀ Z', SameRecord Z Z' → ∀ z, erasedPart Z z → erasedPart Z' z)) ∧
       3431      (∀ Z Z' : World, SameRecord Z Z' → RH Z → RH Z' → ∀ z, Z z ↔ Z' z) ∧
       3432      (∀ z : Pt, (onLine z ∧ fold z = z ∧ reg z = z) ∨
       3433        (¬ onLine z ∧ fold z ≠ z ∧ reg (fold z) = reg z ∧ ∀ w, reg w ≠ z)) ∧
       3434      (∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros) :=
       3435    ⟨fold_fixed_iff, fun z => ⟨(show (reg z).x = 1 from rfl), reg_fixes_line z⟩, ⟨same_record_12, W1_rh, W2_not_rh⟩,
       3436     record_decides_nothing,
       3437     fun Z => ⟨least_erasure_is_the_value Z, rh_iff_own_record Z, least_erasure_is_least Z⟩,
       3438     lossless_unique, nothing_escapes_one_cut, rh_from_the_act⟩
       3439  
       3440  namespace Carrier
       3441  
       3442  /-- A fold on any carrier: an involution. -/
       3443  structure Fold (X : Type) where
       3444    σ : X → X
       3445    invol : ∀ x, σ (σ x) = x
       3446  
       3447  /-- A registration for a fold: it lands on the fixed set, fixes it, and forgets the side. -/
       3448  structure Registration {X : Type} (F : Fold X) where
       3449    r : X → X
       3450    lands : ∀ x, F.σ (r x) = r x
       3451    fixes : ∀ x, F.σ x = x → r x = x
       3452    forgets : ∀ x, r (F.σ x) = r x
       3453  
       3454  def RHc {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (Z : X → Prop) : Prop := ∀ x, Z x → F.σ x = x
       3455  def recordC {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (Z : X → Prop) : X → Prop :=
       3456    fun y => ∃ s, Z s ∧ R.r s = y
       3457  def SameRecordC {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (Z Z' : X → Prop) : Prop :=
       3458    ∀ y, recordC R Z y ↔ recordC R Z' y
       3459  def OffC {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (Z : X → Prop) : Prop := ∃ x, Z x ∧ F.σ x ≠ x
       3460  def LeastErasureC {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (Z : X → Prop) : Prop :=
       3461    ∀ Z', SameRecordC R Z Z' → OffC F Z → OffC F Z'
       3462  
       3463  theorem record_same_C {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (Z : X → Prop) :
       3464      SameRecordC R Z (recordC R Z) := by
       3465    intro y
       3466    constructor
       3467    · intro ⟨s, hs, hsy⟩
       3468      exact ⟨R.r s, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, by rw [R.fixes (R.r s) (R.lands s)]; exact hsy⟩
       3469    · intro ⟨s', ⟨s, hs, hss'⟩, hs'y⟩
       3470      subst hss'
       3471      exact ⟨s, hs, by rw [← hs'y, R.fixes (R.r s) (R.lands s)]⟩
       3472  
       3473  theorem least_erasure_is_the_value_C {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F)
       3474      (em : ∀ x, F.σ x = x ∨ F.σ x ≠ x) (Z : X → Prop) : LeastErasureC R Z ↔ RHc F Z := by
       3475    constructor
       3476    · intro hle x hx
       3477      rcases em x with h | h
       3478      · exact h
       3479      · obtain ⟨y, ⟨s, _, hsy⟩, hy⟩ := hle (recordC R Z) (record_same_C R Z) ⟨x, hx, h⟩
       3480        exact (hy (by rw [← hsy]; exact R.lands s)).elim
       3481    · intro hZ _ _ ⟨x, hx, h⟩
       3482      exact absurd (hZ x hx) h
       3483  
       3484  theorem rh_iff_own_record_C {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (Z : X → Prop) :
       3485      RHc F Z ↔ ∀ x, Z x ↔ recordC R Z x := by
       3486    constructor
       3487    · intro hZ x
       3488      constructor
       3489      · intro hx
       3490        exact ⟨x, hx, R.fixes x (hZ x hx)⟩
       3491      · intro ⟨s, hs, hsx⟩
       3492        subst hsx
       3493        rw [R.fixes s (hZ s hs)]
       3494        exact hs
       3495    · intro h x hx
       3496      obtain ⟨s, _, hsx⟩ := (h x).mp hx
       3497      subst hsx
       3498      exact R.lands s
       3499  
       3500  theorem one_record_C {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (x : X) :
       3501      SameRecordC R (fun s => s = R.r x) (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) := by
       3502    intro y
       3503    constructor
       3504    · intro ⟨s, hs, hy⟩
       3505      refine ⟨x, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
       3506      rw [← hy, hs, R.fixes (R.r x) (R.lands x)]
       3507    · intro ⟨s, hs, hy⟩
       3508      refine ⟨R.r x, rfl, ?_⟩
       3509      rw [R.fixes (R.r x) (R.lands x), ← hy]
       3510      rcases hs with h | h
       3511      · rw [h]
       3512      · rw [h, R.forgets]
       3513  
       3514  theorem worlds_differ_C {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (x : X) (h : F.σ x ≠ x) :
       3515      RHc F (fun s => s = R.r x) ∧ ¬ RHc F (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) :=
       3516    ⟨fun _ hs => hs ▸ R.lands x, fun hall => h (hall x (Or.inl rfl))⟩
       3517  
       3518  theorem no_reading_decides_C {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (x : X) (h : F.σ x ≠ x)
       3519      (g : (X → Prop) → Prop) (hg : ∀ Z Z', SameRecordC R Z Z' → (g Z ↔ g Z')) :
       3520      ¬ ((g (fun s => s = R.r x) ↔ RHc F (fun s => s = R.r x)) ∧
       3521         (g (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) ↔ RHc F (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x))) := by
       3522    intro ⟨h1, h2⟩
       3523    exact (worlds_differ_C R x h).2 (h2.mp ((hg _ _ (one_record_C R x)).mp (h1.mpr (worlds_differ_C R x h).1)))
       3524  
       3525  /-- On any carrier the lossless member of a record is unique: two configurations of one record that both
       3526      satisfy the hypothesis carry the same points. -/
       3527  theorem lossless_unique_C {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (Z Z' : X → Prop)
       3528      (hs : SameRecordC R Z Z') (h : RHc F Z) (h' : RHc F Z') : ∀ x, Z x ↔ Z' x :=
       3529    fun x => ((rh_iff_own_record_C R Z).mp h x).trans ((hs x).trans ((rh_iff_own_record_C R Z').mp h' x).symm)
       3530  
       3531  /-- The chart's fold, as a carrier fold. -/
       3532  def chartFold : Fold Pt := ⟨fold, fold_fold⟩
       3533  
       3534  /-- The chart's registration, as a carrier registration. -/
       3535  def chartReg : Registration chartFold :=
       3536    ⟨reg, fun z => (fold_fixed_iff (reg z)).mpr rfl, fun z h => reg_fixes_line z ((fold_fixed_iff z).mp h),
       3537     fun _ => rfl⟩
       3538  
       3539  /-- **The chart is one instance.** Its fixed set is the line, and the carrier's hypothesis is the chart's. -/
       3540  theorem chart_is_an_instance :
       3541      (∀ z, chartFold.σ z = z ↔ onLine z) ∧ ∀ Z : World, RHc chartFold Z ↔ RH Z :=
       3542    ⟨fold_fixed_iff, fun _ => ⟨fun h z hz => (fold_fixed_iff z).mp (h z hz), fun h z hz => (fold_fixed_iff z).mpr (h z hz)⟩⟩
       3543  
       3544  /-- **The closure on any carrier.** On every carrier with an involution and a registration on which fixedness is
       3545      decided: least erasure is the value; the value is lossless registration; the lossless member of a record is
       3546      unique; and every point off the fixed set gives two worlds of one record that differ in the value. -/
       3547  theorem the_closure_on_any_carrier {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (em : ∀ x, F.σ x = x ∨ F.σ x ≠ x) :
       3548      (∀ Z, LeastErasureC R Z ↔ RHc F Z) ∧ (∀ Z, RHc F Z ↔ ∀ x, Z x ↔ recordC R Z x) ∧
       3549      (∀ Z Z', SameRecordC R Z Z' → RHc F Z → RHc F Z' → ∀ x, Z x ↔ Z' x) ∧
       3550      (∀ x, F.σ x ≠ x → SameRecordC R (fun s => s = R.r x) (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) ∧
       3551        RHc F (fun s => s = R.r x) ∧ ¬ RHc F (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x)) :=
       3552    ⟨least_erasure_is_the_value_C R em, rh_iff_own_record_C R, lossless_unique_C R,
       3553     fun x h => ⟨one_record_C R x, worlds_differ_C R x h⟩⟩
       3554  
       3555  end Carrier
       3556  
       3557  /-! ## XXII · The socket: every route to the value lands in the one field
       3558  
       3559  An unconditional closure would be a closed term of type `LeastErasure Z` at the actual zero set, placed in the field
       3560  `supply` of `ActualZeros`. This section proves that the field is the only socket and that nothing reaches the value by
       3561  another way. A term of the hypothesis at a fold-closed configuration exists exactly when the field can be filled there,
       3562  and the closure theorem of Section XXI takes any term in the field with no other change. A premise on configurations
       3563  either forces the line or holds at a fold-closed configuration where the value fails; a keyless premise forces nothing;
       3564  a forcing premise that respects the record fails at every nonempty fold-closed configuration; a forcing premise either
       3565  is the value on every fold-closed configuration or fails at one that satisfies the hypothesis; and a forcing premise
       3566  that holds at a configuration fills the field there. A sentence carried to the zeros by a cited equivalence fills the
       3567  field exactly when it holds, whatever the sentence. The named sentences depend on their own configurations: Weil
       3568  positivity differs between two explicit formulas with every field, no prefix of a Li stream forces, and the Liouville
       3569  sentence, read as a property of an assignment at the primes, fails at the assignment that sends every prime to zero.
       3570  The one refutation is one point. -/
       3571  
       3572  /-- The field can be filled at a fold-closed configuration exactly when the hypothesis holds there, and exactly when
       3573      least erasure does. -/
       3574  theorem socket_is_the_value (Z : World) (hZ : FoldClosed Z) :
       3575      ((∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z) ↔ RH Z) ∧ ((∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z) ↔ LeastErasure Z) := by
       3576    have h1 : (∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z) ↔ RH Z :=
       3577      ⟨fun ⟨S, hS⟩ => hS ▸ rh_from_the_act S, fun h => ⟨⟨Z, hZ, (least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mpr h⟩, rfl⟩⟩
       3578    exact ⟨h1, h1.trans (least_erasure_is_the_value Z).symm⟩
       3579  
       3580  /-- The closure theorem takes a term in the field and changes nothing else: its last conjunct, applied to the
       3581      configuration with the term, gives the hypothesis. -/
       3582  theorem closure_takes_a_term (Z : World) (hZ : FoldClosed Z) (s : LeastErasure Z) : RH Z :=
       3583    the_closure.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 ⟨Z, hZ, s⟩
       3584  
       3585  /-- At W1 the field holds a closed term, and the closure gives the hypothesis there with nothing assumed. -/
       3586  theorem closure_at_a_term : RH W1 :=
       3587    closure_takes_a_term W1 W1_closed ((least_erasure_is_the_value W1).mpr W1_rh)
       3588  
       3589  /-- Every premise either forces the line or holds at a fold-closed configuration where the value fails. Classical. -/
       3590  theorem forces_or_has_a_twin (A : World → Prop) : Forces A ∨ ∃ Z, FoldClosed Z ∧ A Z ∧ ¬ RH Z :=
       3591    Classical.byCases (p := ∃ Z, FoldClosed Z ∧ A Z ∧ ¬ RH Z) Or.inr
       3592      (fun h => Or.inl (fun Z hZ ha => Classical.byContradiction (fun hn => h ⟨Z, hZ, ha, hn⟩)))
       3593  
       3594  /-- A configuration with one more pair, at real parts 0 and 1 and at the height `t`. -/
       3595  def withPair (Z : World) (t : Nat) : World := fun w => Z w ∨ w = ⟨0, t⟩ ∨ w = ⟨2, t⟩
       3596  
       3597  theorem withPair_closed (Z : World) (hZ : FoldClosed Z) (t : Nat) : FoldClosed (withPair Z t) := by
       3598    intro w hw
       3599    rcases hw with h | h | h
       3600    · exact Or.inl (hZ w h)
       3601    · subst h
       3602      exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
       3603    · subst h
       3604      exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
       3605  
       3606  /-- The pair added at the height of a zero leaves the record unchanged: both new points have the registration of that zero. -/
       3607  theorem withPair_same_record (Z : World) (z : Pt) (hz : Z z) : SameRecord Z (withPair Z z.t) := by
       3608    intro r
       3609    constructor
       3610    · intro ⟨s, hs, hsr⟩
       3611      exact ⟨s, Or.inl hs, hsr⟩
       3612    · intro ⟨s, hs, hsr⟩
       3613      rcases hs with h | h | h
       3614      · exact ⟨s, h, hsr⟩
       3615      · subst h
       3616        exact ⟨z, hz, hsr⟩
       3617      · subst h
       3618        exact ⟨z, hz, hsr⟩
       3619  
       3620  theorem withPair_not_rh (Z : World) (t : Nat) : ¬ RH (withPair Z t) := by
       3621    intro h
       3622    have e : (0 : Int) = 1 := h ⟨0, t⟩ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
       3623    omega
       3624  
       3625  /-- A premise that respects the record and forces the line fails at every nonempty fold-closed configuration: the
       3626      configuration and its copy with one more pair share a record, and the copy fails the hypothesis. -/
       3627  theorem record_forcing_fails_everywhere (A : World → Prop) (hr : RespectsRecord A) (hf : Forces A) (Z : World)
       3628      (hZ : FoldClosed Z) (hne : ∃ z, Z z) : ¬ A Z := by
       3629    intro ha
       3630    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hne
       3631    exact withPair_not_rh Z z.t (hf (withPair Z z.t) (withPair_closed Z hZ z.t)
       3632      ((hr Z (withPair Z z.t) (withPair_same_record Z z hz)).mp ha))
       3633  
       3634  /-- A premise that forces the line either is the value on every fold-closed configuration or fails at a fold-closed
       3635      configuration that satisfies the hypothesis. Classical. -/
       3636  theorem forcing_is_the_value_or_stronger (A : World → Prop) (hf : Forces A) :
       3637      (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (A Z ↔ RH Z)) ∨ ∃ Z, FoldClosed Z ∧ RH Z ∧ ¬ A Z :=
       3638    Classical.byCases (p := ∃ Z, FoldClosed Z ∧ RH Z ∧ ¬ A Z) Or.inr
       3639      (fun h => Or.inl (fun Z hZ => ⟨hf Z hZ, fun hrh => Classical.byContradiction (fun hna => h ⟨Z, hZ, hrh, hna⟩)⟩))
       3640  
       3641  /-- A premise that forces the line and holds at a fold-closed configuration fills the field there. -/
       3642  theorem forcing_fills_the_socket (A : World → Prop) (hf : Forces A) (Z : World) (hZ : FoldClosed Z) (ha : A Z) :
       3643      ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z :=
       3644    (socket_is_the_value Z hZ).1.mpr (hf Z hZ ha)
       3645  
       3646  /-- A sentence carried to a configuration by a cited equivalence with the hypothesis. -/
       3647  structure SocketFace where
       3648    zeros : World
       3649    sentence : Prop
       3650    cited : RH zeros ↔ sentence
       3651  
       3652  /-- Whatever the sentence, it holds exactly when the field can be filled at its configuration. -/
       3653  theorem face_is_the_socket (F : SocketFace) (hF : FoldClosed F.zeros) :
       3654      F.sentence ↔ ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = F.zeros :=
       3655    F.cited.symm.trans (socket_is_the_value F.zeros hF).1.symm
       3656  
       3657  def SocketFace.ofWeil (E : ExplicitFormula) : SocketFace := ⟨E.zeros, WeilPositive E, (spend_is_the_line E).symm⟩
       3658  def SocketFace.ofLi (L : LiStream) : SocketFace := ⟨L.zeros, ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → L.nonneg n, L.li⟩
       3659  def SocketFace.ofSign {V : Type} [LE V] (D : DBN V) : SocketFace := ⟨D.zeros, D.lam ≤ D.zero, rh_iff_the_sign D⟩
       3660  def SocketFace.ofLiouville (F : LiouvilleFacePinned) : SocketFace := ⟨F.zeros, FaithfulLambda, F.landau⟩
       3661  def SocketFace.ofPosit (Z : World) : SocketFace := ⟨Z, LeastErasure Z, (least_erasure_is_the_value Z).symm⟩
       3662  
       3663  /-- Weil positivity, the Li stream, the sign of Λ, the Liouville sentence and least erasure itself each fill the field
       3664      exactly when they hold. -/
       3665  theorem named_faces_are_the_socket :
       3666      (∀ E : ExplicitFormula, FoldClosed E.zeros → (WeilPositive E ↔ ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = E.zeros)) ∧
       3667      (∀ L : LiStream, FoldClosed L.zeros → ((∀ n, 1 ≤ n → L.nonneg n) ↔ ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = L.zeros)) ∧
       3668      (∀ (V : Type) [LE V] (D : DBN V), FoldClosed D.zeros → (D.lam ≤ D.zero ↔ ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = D.zeros)) ∧
       3669      (∀ F : LiouvilleFacePinned, FoldClosed F.zeros → (FaithfulLambda ↔ ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = F.zeros)) ∧
       3670      (∀ Z : World, FoldClosed Z → (LeastErasure Z ↔ ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z)) :=
       3671    ⟨fun E hE => face_is_the_socket (SocketFace.ofWeil E) hE,
       3672     fun L hL => face_is_the_socket (SocketFace.ofLi L) hL,
       3673     fun _ _ D hD => face_is_the_socket (SocketFace.ofSign D) hD,
       3674     fun F hF => face_is_the_socket (SocketFace.ofLiouville F) hF,
       3675     fun Z hZ => face_is_the_socket (SocketFace.ofPosit Z) hZ⟩
       3676  
       3677  /-- The sign arrow of an assignment at the primes: `(−1)^{f(n)}` for the completely additive `f` with the value `a(p)`
       3678      at every prime. The assignment that sends every prime to one gives `λ`. -/
       3679  def arrowOf (a : Nat → Int) (n : Nat) : Int := if extendAssignment a n % 2 = 0 then 1 else -1
       3680  
       3681  /-- The walk of an assignment: the sum of its arrow over `1 ≤ n ≤ x`. -/
       3682  def walkOf (a : Nat → Int) : Nat → Int
       3683    | 0 => 0
       3684    | n + 1 => walkOf a n + arrowOf a (n + 1)
       3685  
       3686  /-- The Liouville sentence for an assignment at the primes. -/
       3687  def FaithfulOf (a : Nat → Int) : Prop :=
       3688    ∀ k m : Nat, 0 < k → 0 < m → ∃ C : Nat, ∀ x : Nat,
       3689      (walkOf a x).natAbs ^ (2 * m) ≤ C ^ (2 * m) * x ^ (m + 2 * k)
       3690  
       3691  theorem walk_is_the_walk_of_one (x : Nat) : liouvilleWalk x = walkOf (fun _ => 1) x := by
       3692    induction x with
       3693    | zero => rfl
       3694    | succ n ih =>
       3695      show liouvilleWalk n + liouvilleAll (n + 1) = walkOf (fun _ => 1) n + arrowOf (fun _ => 1) (n + 1)
       3696      rw [ih]
       3697      rfl
       3698  
       3699  /-- The Liouville sentence is the sentence of the assignment that sends every prime to one. -/
       3700  theorem faithful_is_the_sentence_of_one : FaithfulLambda ↔ FaithfulOf (fun _ => 1) := by
       3701    unfold FaithfulLambda FaithfulOf
       3702    simp only [walk_is_the_walk_of_one]
       3703  
       3704  /-- The assignment that sends every prime to zero extends to zero everywhere. -/
       3705  theorem blind_assignment_vanishes (n : Nat) : extendAssignment (fun _ => 0) n = 0 := by
       3706    unfold extendAssignment
       3707    exact sumBelow_zero _ _ (fun i _ => by
       3708      unfold extendTerm
       3709      split
       3710      · exact Int.mul_zero _
       3711      · rfl)
       3712  
       3713  /-- At that assignment the arrow is one everywhere and the walk is the identity. -/
       3714  theorem blind_walk (x : Nat) : walkOf (fun _ => 0) x = (x : Int) := by
       3715    induction x with
       3716    | zero => rfl
       3717    | succ n ih =>
       3718      show walkOf (fun _ => 0) n + arrowOf (fun _ => 0) (n + 1) = ((n + 1 : Nat) : Int)
       3719      rw [ih]
       3720      unfold arrowOf
       3721      rw [blind_assignment_vanishes, if_pos (by decide)]
       3722      omega
       3723  
       3724  /-- The Liouville sentence fails at the assignment that sends every prime to zero: at `k = 1, m = 3` the walk `x` would
       3725      need `x^6 ≤ C^6 x^5`, which fails at `x = C^6 + 1`. -/
       3726  theorem blind_is_unfaithful : ¬ FaithfulOf (fun _ => 0) := by
       3727    intro h
       3728    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h 1 3 (by decide) (by decide)
       3729    have hx := hC (C ^ 6 + 1)
       3730    rw [blind_walk] at hx
       3731    change (C ^ 6 + 1) ^ 6 ≤ C ^ 6 * (C ^ 6 + 1) ^ 5 at hx
       3732    have hpos : 0 < (C ^ 6 + 1) ^ 5 := Nat.pow_pos (Nat.succ_pos _)
       3733    have e : (C ^ 6 + 1) ^ 6 = (C ^ 6 + 1) ^ 5 * (C ^ 6 + 1) := Nat.pow_succ (C ^ 6 + 1) 5
       3734    rw [e] at hx
       3735    generalize (C ^ 6 + 1) ^ 5 = y at hx hpos
       3736    generalize C ^ 6 = c at hx
       3737    rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_comm c y] at hx
       3738    omega
       3739  
       3740  /-- The Liouville sentence reads the primes: it is the sentence of one assignment, it fails at another, and so no proof
       3741      of it holds for every assignment. -/
       3742  theorem faithful_reads_the_primes :
       3743      (FaithfulLambda ↔ FaithfulOf (fun _ => 1)) ∧ ¬ FaithfulOf (fun _ => 0) ∧ ¬ ∀ a : Nat → Int, FaithfulOf a :=
       3744    ⟨faithful_is_the_sentence_of_one, blind_is_unfaithful, fun h => blind_is_unfaithful (h _)⟩
       3745  
       3746  /-- **The socket, whole.** The field of the act is the one socket: it can be filled at a fold-closed configuration
       3747      exactly when the hypothesis holds, and the closure takes any term in it with no other change. Every premise on
       3748      configurations forces the line or holds at a fold-closed configuration where the value fails; a keyless premise
       3749      forces nothing; a premise that respects the record and forces the line fails at every nonempty fold-closed
       3750      configuration; a forcing premise is the value or fails at a configuration that satisfies the hypothesis, and fills
       3751      the field wherever it holds. Every sentence carried to the zeros by a cited equivalence fills the field exactly when
       3752      it holds. The named sentences depend on their configurations, and the one refutation is one point. -/
       3753  theorem the_socket :
       3754      (∀ Z : World, FoldClosed Z → ((∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z) ↔ RH Z)) ∧
       3755      (∀ Z : World, FoldClosed Z → LeastErasure Z → RH Z) ∧
       3756      (∀ A : World → Prop, Forces A ∨ ∃ Z, FoldClosed Z ∧ A Z ∧ ¬ RH Z) ∧
       3757      (∀ A : World → Prop, Keyless A → ¬ Forces A) ∧
       3758      (∀ A : World → Prop, RespectsRecord A → Forces A → ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (∃ z, Z z) → ¬ A Z) ∧
       3759      (∀ A : World → Prop, Forces A → (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (A Z ↔ RH Z)) ∨ ∃ Z, FoldClosed Z ∧ RH Z ∧ ¬ A Z) ∧
       3760      (∀ A : World → Prop, Forces A → ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → A Z → ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z) ∧
       3761      (∀ F : SocketFace, FoldClosed F.zeros → (F.sentence ↔ ∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = F.zeros)) ∧
       3762      (WeilPositive positiveInstance ∧ ¬ WeilPositive negativeInstance) ∧
       3763      (∀ N : Nat, ∃ L : LiStream, (∀ n, n < N → L.nonneg n) ∧ ¬ RH L.zeros) ∧
       3764      ((FaithfulLambda ↔ FaithfulOf (fun _ => 1)) ∧ ¬ FaithfulOf (fun _ => 0)) ∧
       3765      (∀ Z : World, ¬ LeastErasure Z ↔ OffLine Z) :=
       3766    ⟨fun Z hZ => (socket_is_the_value Z hZ).1, closure_takes_a_term, forces_or_has_a_twin, keyless_forces_nothing,
       3767     record_forcing_fails_everywhere, forcing_is_the_value_or_stronger, forcing_fills_the_socket, face_is_the_socket,
       3768     positivity_is_keyed, li_prefix_never_forces, ⟨faithful_is_the_sentence_of_one, blind_is_unfaithful⟩,
       3769     rejection_is_a_witness⟩
       3770  
       3771  /-! ### XXII.b · At resolution two the open strip holds a pair off the line
       3772  
       3773  At resolution one the chart's open strip `0 < x < 2` holds only the line, so a premise that places every zero inside
       3774  the open strip forces the line there: a fact of the coarse chart, not of the zeros. On the chart at resolution two, with
       3775  `x = 4 Re s`, the line `x = 2`, the fold `x ↦ 4 − x` and registration `(x, t) ↦ (2, t)`, the open strip `0 < x < 4`
       3776  holds the pair `x = 1, 3`, real parts one quarter and three quarters. There the open-strip premise forces nothing, no
       3777  reading of the record decides the value, and the refusals of the socket hold for premises that range over strip
       3778  configurations only. -/
       3779  
       3780  def fold₂ (z : Pt) : Pt := ⟨4 - z.x, z.t⟩
       3781  def reg₂ (z : Pt) : Pt := ⟨2, z.t⟩
       3782  def onLine₂ (z : Pt) : Prop := z.x = 2
       3783  def InStrip₂ (z : Pt) : Prop := 0 < z.x ∧ z.x < 4
       3784  /-- A strip configuration at resolution two: fold-closed, and every zero inside the open strip. -/
       3785  def StripWorld₂ (Z : World) : Prop := (∀ z, Z z → Z (fold₂ z)) ∧ ∀ z, Z z → InStrip₂ z
       3786  def RH₂ (Z : World) : Prop := ∀ z, Z z → onLine₂ z
       3787  def SameRecord₂ (Z Z' : World) : Prop := ∀ r, (∃ s, Z s ∧ reg₂ s = r) ↔ (∃ s, Z' s ∧ reg₂ s = r)
       3788  /-- A premise respects the record when it reads alike on two strip configurations of one record. -/
       3789  def RespectsRecord₂ (A : World → Prop) : Prop :=
       3790    ∀ Z Z', StripWorld₂ Z → StripWorld₂ Z' → SameRecord₂ Z Z' → (A Z ↔ A Z')
       3791  /-- A premise forces the line when every strip configuration it holds on satisfies the hypothesis. -/
       3792  def Forces₂ (A : World → Prop) : Prop := ∀ Z, StripWorld₂ Z → A Z → RH₂ Z
       3793  
       3794  /-- The seat at resolution two: the fixed set of the fold is the line. -/
       3795  theorem fold₂_fixed_iff (z : Pt) : fold₂ z = z ↔ onLine₂ z := by
       3796    cases z with
       3797    | mk x t =>
       3798      show Pt.mk (4 - x) t = Pt.mk x t ↔ x = 2
       3799      constructor
       3800      · intro h
       3801        have hx := congrArg Pt.x h
       3802        change 4 - x = x at hx
       3803        omega
       3804      · intro h
       3805        subst h
       3806        rfl
       3807  
       3808  /-- At resolution one the open strip is the line: the premise that places every zero inside it forces the line. -/
       3809  theorem open_strip_forces_at_resolution_one : Forces (fun Z => ∀ z, Z z → 0 < z.x ∧ z.x < 2) := by
       3810    intro Z _ h z hz
       3811    have := h z hz
       3812    show z.x = 1
       3813    omega
       3814  
       3815  /-- The pair at real parts one quarter and three quarters, at the height `t`. -/
       3816  def innerPair₂ (t : Nat) : World := fun w => w = ⟨1, t⟩ ∨ w = ⟨3, t⟩
       3817  
       3818  theorem innerPair₂_strip (t : Nat) : StripWorld₂ (innerPair₂ t) := by
       3819    refine ⟨fun w hw => ?_, fun w hw => ?_⟩
       3820    · rcases hw with h | h
       3821      · subst h
       3822        exact Or.inr rfl
       3823      · subst h
       3824        exact Or.inl rfl
       3825    · rcases hw with h | h
       3826      · subst h
       3827        exact ⟨show (0 : Int) < 1 by decide, show (1 : Int) < 4 by decide⟩
       3828      · subst h
       3829        exact ⟨show (0 : Int) < 3 by decide, show (3 : Int) < 4 by decide⟩
       3830  
       3831  theorem innerPair₂_not_rh (t : Nat) : ¬ RH₂ (innerPair₂ t) := by
       3832    intro h
       3833    have e : (1 : Int) = 2 := h ⟨1, t⟩ (Or.inl rfl)
       3834    omega
       3835  
       3836  /-- At resolution two the open-strip premise forces nothing: the inner pair satisfies it and fails the hypothesis. -/
       3837  theorem open_strip_forces_nothing_at_resolution_two : ¬ Forces₂ (fun Z => ∀ z, Z z → InStrip₂ z) :=
       3838    fun h => innerPair₂_not_rh 0 (h (innerPair₂ 0) (innerPair₂_strip 0) (innerPair₂_strip 0).2)
       3839  
       3840  /-- A premise true on every configuration forces nothing on strip configurations. -/
       3841  theorem keyless_forces_nothing₂ (A : World → Prop) (hA : ∀ Z, A Z) : ¬ Forces₂ A :=
       3842    fun h => innerPair₂_not_rh 0 (h _ (innerPair₂_strip 0) (hA _))
       3843  
       3844  /-- A strip configuration with the inner pair added at the height `t`. -/
       3845  def withPair₂ (Z : World) (t : Nat) : World := fun w => Z w ∨ w = ⟨1, t⟩ ∨ w = ⟨3, t⟩
       3846  
       3847  theorem withPair₂_strip (Z : World) (hZ : StripWorld₂ Z) (t : Nat) : StripWorld₂ (withPair₂ Z t) := by
       3848    refine ⟨fun w hw => ?_, fun w hw => ?_⟩
       3849    · rcases hw with h | h | h
       3850      · exact Or.inl (hZ.1 w h)
       3851      · subst h
       3852        exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
       3853      · subst h
       3854        exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
       3855    · rcases hw with h | h | h
       3856      · exact hZ.2 w h
       3857      · subst h
       3858        exact ⟨show (0 : Int) < 1 by decide, show (1 : Int) < 4 by decide⟩
       3859      · subst h
       3860        exact ⟨show (0 : Int) < 3 by decide, show (3 : Int) < 4 by decide⟩
       3861  
       3862  theorem withPair₂_same_record (Z : World) (z : Pt) (hz : Z z) : SameRecord₂ Z (withPair₂ Z z.t) := by
       3863    intro r
       3864    constructor
       3865    · intro ⟨s, hs, hsr⟩
       3866      exact ⟨s, Or.inl hs, hsr⟩
       3867    · intro ⟨s, hs, hsr⟩
       3868      rcases hs with h | h | h
       3869      · exact ⟨s, h, hsr⟩
       3870      · subst h
       3871        exact ⟨z, hz, hsr⟩
       3872      · subst h
       3873        exact ⟨z, hz, hsr⟩
       3874  
       3875  theorem withPair₂_not_rh (Z : World) (t : Nat) : ¬ RH₂ (withPair₂ Z t) := by
       3876    intro h
       3877    have e : (1 : Int) = 2 := h ⟨1, t⟩ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
       3878    omega
       3879  
       3880  /-- A premise that respects the record and forces the line on strip configurations fails at every nonempty strip
       3881      configuration: its copy with the inner pair at the height of one of its zeros shares its record and fails the
       3882      hypothesis. -/
       3883  theorem record_forcing_fails_in_the_strip (A : World → Prop) (hr : RespectsRecord₂ A) (hf : Forces₂ A) (Z : World)
       3884      (hZ : StripWorld₂ Z) (hne : ∃ z, Z z) : ¬ A Z := by
       3885    intro ha
       3886    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hne
       3887    have hs := withPair₂_strip Z hZ z.t
       3888    exact withPair₂_not_rh Z z.t (hf _ hs ((hr Z _ hZ hs (withPair₂_same_record Z z hz)).mp ha))
       3889  
       3890  /-- No reading that respects the record decides the hypothesis on strip configurations. -/
       3891  theorem no_reading_decides_in_the_strip (g : World → Prop) (hg : RespectsRecord₂ g) :
       3892      ¬ ∀ Z, StripWorld₂ Z → (g Z ↔ RH₂ Z) := by
       3893    intro h
       3894    have hL : StripWorld₂ (fun w => w = ⟨2, 14⟩) :=
       3895      ⟨fun w hw => by rw [hw]; rfl, fun w hw => by rw [hw]; exact ⟨by decide, by decide⟩⟩
       3896    have hLrh : RH₂ (fun w => w = ⟨2, 14⟩) := fun w hw => by rw [hw]; rfl
       3897    have hs := withPair₂_strip _ hL 14
       3898    have hsame : SameRecord₂ (fun w => w = ⟨2, 14⟩) (withPair₂ (fun w => w = ⟨2, 14⟩) 14) :=
       3899      withPair₂_same_record _ ⟨2, 14⟩ rfl
       3900    exact withPair₂_not_rh _ 14 ((h _ hs).mp ((hg _ _ hL hs hsame).mp ((h _ hL).mpr hLrh)))
       3901  
       3902  /-- Every premise either forces the line on strip configurations or holds at a strip configuration where the value
       3903      fails. Classical. -/
       3904  theorem forces_or_has_a_twin₂ (A : World → Prop) : Forces₂ A ∨ ∃ Z, StripWorld₂ Z ∧ A Z ∧ ¬ RH₂ Z :=
       3905    Classical.byCases (p := ∃ Z, StripWorld₂ Z ∧ A Z ∧ ¬ RH₂ Z) Or.inr
       3906      (fun h => Or.inl (fun Z hZ ha => Classical.byContradiction (fun hn => h ⟨Z, hZ, ha, hn⟩)))
       3907  
       3908  /-- **The socket in the strip.** At resolution one the open strip is the line; at resolution two the fold fixes the
       3909      line, the open strip holds a pair off the line at every height, the open-strip premise and every keyless premise
       3910      force nothing, no reading of the record decides, a record-respecting forcing premise fails at every nonempty strip
       3911      configuration, and every premise forces or holds where the value fails. -/
       3912  theorem the_socket_in_the_strip :
       3913      Forces (fun Z => ∀ z, Z z → 0 < z.x ∧ z.x < 2) ∧
       3914      (∀ z : Pt, fold₂ z = z ↔ onLine₂ z) ∧
       3915      (∀ t : Nat, StripWorld₂ (innerPair₂ t) ∧ ¬ RH₂ (innerPair₂ t)) ∧
       3916      ¬ Forces₂ (fun Z => ∀ z, Z z → InStrip₂ z) ∧
       3917      (∀ A : World → Prop, (∀ Z, A Z) → ¬ Forces₂ A) ∧
       3918      (∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord₂ g → ¬ ∀ Z, StripWorld₂ Z → (g Z ↔ RH₂ Z)) ∧
       3919      (∀ A : World → Prop, RespectsRecord₂ A → Forces₂ A → ∀ Z, StripWorld₂ Z → (∃ z, Z z) → ¬ A Z) ∧
       3920      (∀ A : World → Prop, Forces₂ A ∨ ∃ Z, StripWorld₂ Z ∧ A Z ∧ ¬ RH₂ Z) :=
       3921    ⟨open_strip_forces_at_resolution_one, fold₂_fixed_iff, fun t => ⟨innerPair₂_strip t, innerPair₂_not_rh t⟩,
       3922     open_strip_forces_nothing_at_resolution_two, keyless_forces_nothing₂, no_reading_decides_in_the_strip,
       3923     record_forcing_fails_in_the_strip, forces_or_has_a_twin₂⟩
       3924  
       3925  /-! ## XXII.c · Two denials, and the witness the act forces
       3926  
       3927  A denial has two parts: the act of making it, and the sentence it asserts. Two denials are read side by side, over
       3928  every self-grounding root. The denial of the root asserts that the root fails; the act of making it instances the
       3929  root, so its sentence is refuted by its own act and only the root remains. The denial of the hypothesis asserts that
       3930  a zero lies off the line; the act of making it instances the root, which the twin carries too, and its sentence denies
       3931  the self-grounding assertion of the line at the zero set, which the twin does not carry: in time the twin is timeless
       3932  and unseeded. The assertion stands at the actual zero set by the act of section XI, and there the denial is refuted.
       3933  On the act every computation that reads the zero set reports points on the line, and a computation that reports a
       3934  point off the line reads no act. -/
       3935  
       3936  /-- A seeded timeless witness of the line, for a world in time: one locus at every instant, the same truth value of
       3937      the hypothesis at every instant, and the hypothesis at instant 0, the seed. -/
       3938  structure SeededWitness (W : TWorld) : Prop where
       3939    same_locus : SameLocus W
       3940    timeless   : TimelessT W
       3941    seed       : RH (W 0)
       3942  
       3943  /-- A world in time carries a seeded timeless witness exactly when the hypothesis holds at every instant. -/
       3944  theorem seeded_witness_iff_bound (W : TWorld) : SeededWitness W ↔ BoundT W :=
       3945    ⟨fun w => (template_binds_iff_seed W w.timeless).mpr w.seed,
       3946     fun h => ⟨fold_face_keyless W, fun t s => ⟨fun _ => h s, fun _ => h t⟩, h 0⟩⟩
       3947  
       3948  /-- The constant twin, timeless and fold-closed at every instant, carries no seeded witness. -/
       3949  theorem twin_has_no_seeded_witness : ¬ SeededWitness WTwin :=
       3950    fun w => W2f_not_rh w.seed
       3951  
       3952  /-- The constant on-line world carries one. -/
       3953  theorem line_world_has_a_seeded_witness : SeededWitness WOn :=
       3954    (seeded_witness_iff_bound WOn).mpr closure_face_on_line
       3955  
       3956  /-- Every denial, whatever its sentence, is an act, and every act instances the root. -/
       3957  theorem every_denial_is_an_act {root C : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding root) (a : G.Act) (_c : C) : root :=
       3958    G.instances a
       3959  
       3960  /-- A denial of a self-grounding root is refuted by its own act: its sentence denies what its act instances. -/
       3961  theorem root_denial_refutes_itself {root : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding root) (a : G.Act) (n : ¬ root) : False :=
       3962    n (G.instances a)
       3963  
       3964  /-- A denial of the hypothesis at a world denies the self-grounding assertion of the line there. -/
       3965  theorem line_denial_denies_the_assertion (Z : World) (h : ¬ RH Z) :
       3966      ¬ ∃ G : SelfGrounding (RH Z), Nonempty G.Act :=
       3967    fun e => h ((supply_iff (RH Z)).mp e)
       3968  
       3969  /-- In time, a denial of the hypothesis at instant 0 denies every seeded witness. -/
       3970  theorem line_denial_denies_every_seed (W : TWorld) (h : ¬ RH (W 0)) : ¬ SeededWitness W :=
       3971    fun w => h w.seed
       3972  
       3973  /-- The twin carries the root, fold-closure, the record of W1 and the timeless form; it carries neither a
       3974      self-grounding assertion of the line nor a seeded witness. -/
       3975  theorem twin_carries_the_root_and_no_seed {root : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding root) :
       3976      root ∧ FoldClosed W2f ∧ SameRecord W1 W2f ∧ TimelessT WTwin ∧ ¬ RH W2f ∧
       3977      (¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH W2f), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧ ¬ SeededWitness WTwin :=
       3978    ⟨G.instances G.anAct, W2f_closed, same_record_f, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl, W2f_not_rh, line_not_self_grounding,
       3979     twin_has_no_seeded_witness⟩
       3980  
       3981  /-- The root alone forces nothing: it holds on every world, the twin written out included. -/
       3982  theorem the_root_alone_forces_nothing {root : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding root) : ¬ Forces (fun _ => root) :=
       3983    keyless_forces_nothing_free (fun _ => root) (fun _ => G.instances G.anAct)
       3984  
       3985  /-- At every instance of the actual zero set the self-grounding assertion of the line exists. -/
       3986  theorem the_act_asserts_the_line (A : ActualZeros) : ∃ G : SelfGrounding (RH A.zeros), Nonempty G.Act :=
       3987    (supply_iff (RH A.zeros)).mpr (rh_from_the_act A)
       3988  
       3989  /-- The constant family of the actual zero set carries a seeded witness. -/
       3990  theorem the_act_seeds_its_constant_world (A : ActualZeros) : SeededWitness (fun _ => A.zeros) :=
       3991    (seeded_witness_iff_bound _).mpr (fun _ => rh_from_the_act A)
       3992  
       3993  /-- On the act the denial of the hypothesis is refuted. -/
       3994  theorem line_denial_refuted_on_the_act (A : ActualZeros) (h : ¬ RH A.zeros) : False :=
       3995    h (rh_from_the_act A)
       3996  
       3997  /-- TWO DENIALS, ONE FORM. For every self-grounding root: every denial is an act and instances the root; the denial
       3998      of the root is refuted by its own act; the denial of the hypothesis denies the self-grounding assertion of the line
       3999      and, in time, the seed; the twin carries the root and neither of these, so the root alone forces nothing, and a
       4000      seeded witness exists exactly where the line holds at every instant; on the act the assertion exists, the seed
       4001      stands, and the denial is refuted. -/
       4002  theorem two_denials {root : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding root) :
       4003      (∀ C : Prop, G.Act → C → root) ∧
       4004      (G.Act → ¬ root → False) ∧
       4005      (∀ Z : World, ¬ RH Z → ¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH Z), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4006      (∀ W : TWorld, SeededWitness W ↔ BoundT W) ∧
       4007      (root ∧ FoldClosed W2f ∧ SameRecord W1 W2f ∧ TimelessT WTwin ∧ ¬ RH W2f ∧
       4008        (¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH W2f), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧ ¬ SeededWitness WTwin) ∧
       4009      SeededWitness WOn ∧
       4010      ¬ Forces (fun _ => root) ∧
       4011      (∀ A : ActualZeros, (∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH A.zeros), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4012        SeededWitness (fun _ => A.zeros) ∧ (¬ RH A.zeros → False)) :=
       4013    ⟨fun _ a c => every_denial_is_an_act G a c,
       4014     fun a n => root_denial_refutes_itself G a n,
       4015     line_denial_denies_the_assertion,
       4016     seeded_witness_iff_bound,
       4017     twin_carries_the_root_and_no_seed G,
       4018     line_world_has_a_seeded_witness,
       4019     the_root_alone_forces_nothing G,
       4020     fun A => ⟨the_act_asserts_the_line A, the_act_seeds_its_constant_world A, line_denial_refuted_on_the_act A⟩⟩
       4021  
       4022  /-- At the root proposition 0 < 1, with the unit act. -/
       4023  theorem two_denials_at_the_root :
       4024      (∀ C : Prop, rootSelfGrounding.Act → C → RootAct) ∧
       4025      (rootSelfGrounding.Act → ¬ RootAct → False) ∧
       4026      (∀ Z : World, ¬ RH Z → ¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH Z), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4027      (∀ W : TWorld, SeededWitness W ↔ BoundT W) ∧
       4028      (RootAct ∧ FoldClosed W2f ∧ SameRecord W1 W2f ∧ TimelessT WTwin ∧ ¬ RH W2f ∧
       4029        (¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH W2f), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧ ¬ SeededWitness WTwin) ∧
       4030      SeededWitness WOn ∧
       4031      ¬ Forces (fun _ => RootAct) ∧
       4032      (∀ A : ActualZeros, (∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH A.zeros), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4033        SeededWitness (fun _ => A.zeros) ∧ (¬ RH A.zeros → False)) :=
       4034    two_denials rootSelfGrounding
       4035  
       4036  /-- A computation that ends: the finite list of points it reports as zeros. -/
       4037  structure Computation where
       4038    reports : List Pt
       4039  
       4040  /-- A computation reads an act when every point it reports is a zero of the act's zero set. -/
       4041  def Computation.Reads (c : Computation) (A : ActualZeros) : Prop := ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → A.zeros z
       4042  
       4043  /-- On the act nothing is left open: the hypothesis, least erasure, no point off the line, the zero set its own
       4044      record, and every consequence of the hypothesis at the zero set. -/
       4045  theorem nothing_left_open_on_the_act (A : ActualZeros) :
       4046      RH A.zeros ∧ LeastErasure A.zeros ∧ ¬ OffLine A.zeros ∧ (∀ z, A.zeros z ↔ recordOf A.zeros z) ∧
       4047      (∀ Q : World → Prop, (∀ Z, RH Z → Q Z) → Q A.zeros) :=
       4048    ⟨rh_from_the_act A, A.supply, fun ⟨z, hz, h⟩ => h (rh_from_the_act A z hz),
       4049     (rh_iff_own_record A.zeros).mp (rh_from_the_act A), fun _ hQ => hQ A.zeros (rh_from_the_act A)⟩
       4050  
       4051  /-- Every computation that reads an act reports only points on the line. -/
       4052  theorem computation_reading_the_act_lands_on_the_line (A : ActualZeros) (c : Computation) (h : c.Reads A) :
       4053      ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z :=
       4054    fun z hz => rh_from_the_act A z (h z hz)
       4055  
       4056  /-- A computation that reports a point off the line reads no act. -/
       4057  theorem off_line_report_reads_no_act (c : Computation) (z : Pt) (hz : z ∈ c.reports) (h : ¬ onLine z) :
       4058      ¬ ∃ A : ActualZeros, c.Reads A :=
       4059    fun ⟨A, hA⟩ => h (rh_from_the_act A z (hA z hz))
       4060  
       4061  /-- The computation that reports the zero of the twin at real part 0. -/
       4062  def twinReport : Computation := ⟨[⟨0, 14⟩]⟩
       4063  
       4064  /-- A computation that reads no act is not forced: the twin's report stands off the line and reads no act. -/
       4065  theorem a_computation_reading_no_act_is_not_forced :
       4066      ¬ (∀ c : Computation, ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z) ∧ ¬ ∃ A : ActualZeros, twinReport.Reads A :=
       4067    ⟨fun h => absurd (h twinReport ⟨0, 14⟩ (List.Mem.head _)) (by decide : ¬ ((0 : Int) = 1)),
       4068     off_line_report_reads_no_act twinReport ⟨0, 14⟩ (List.Mem.head _) (by decide : ¬ ((0 : Int) = 1))⟩
       4069  
       4070  /-- THE WITNESS FORCED BY THE ACT. On every act nothing is left open; every computation that reads the act reports
       4071      only points on the line; a computation that reports a point off the line reads no act; and the forcing reaches
       4072      exactly the computations that read an act. -/
       4073  theorem the_witness_forced_by_the_act :
       4074      (∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros ∧ LeastErasure A.zeros ∧ ¬ OffLine A.zeros ∧
       4075        (∀ z, A.zeros z ↔ recordOf A.zeros z) ∧ (∀ Q : World → Prop, (∀ Z, RH Z → Q Z) → Q A.zeros)) ∧
       4076      (∀ (A : ActualZeros) (c : Computation), c.Reads A → ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z) ∧
       4077      (∀ (c : Computation) (z : Pt), z ∈ c.reports → ¬ onLine z → ¬ ∃ A : ActualZeros, c.Reads A) ∧
       4078      ¬ (∀ c : Computation, ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z) :=
       4079    ⟨nothing_left_open_on_the_act, computation_reading_the_act_lands_on_the_line, off_line_report_reads_no_act,
       4080     a_computation_reading_no_act_is_not_forced.1⟩
       4081  
       4082  /-- Section XXII.c, whole, over every self-grounding root. -/
       4083  theorem the_denials_and_the_witness {root : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding root) :
       4084      ((∀ C : Prop, G.Act → C → root) ∧
       4085       (G.Act → ¬ root → False) ∧
       4086       (∀ Z : World, ¬ RH Z → ¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH Z), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4087       (∀ W : TWorld, SeededWitness W ↔ BoundT W) ∧
       4088       (root ∧ FoldClosed W2f ∧ SameRecord W1 W2f ∧ TimelessT WTwin ∧ ¬ RH W2f ∧
       4089         (¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH W2f), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧ ¬ SeededWitness WTwin) ∧
       4090       SeededWitness WOn ∧
       4091       ¬ Forces (fun _ => root) ∧
       4092       (∀ A : ActualZeros, (∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH A.zeros), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4093         SeededWitness (fun _ => A.zeros) ∧ (¬ RH A.zeros → False))) ∧
       4094      ((∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros ∧ LeastErasure A.zeros ∧ ¬ OffLine A.zeros ∧
       4095        (∀ z, A.zeros z ↔ recordOf A.zeros z) ∧ (∀ Q : World → Prop, (∀ Z, RH Z → Q Z) → Q A.zeros)) ∧
       4096       (∀ (A : ActualZeros) (c : Computation), c.Reads A → ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z) ∧
       4097       (∀ (c : Computation) (z : Pt), z ∈ c.reports → ¬ onLine z → ¬ ∃ A : ActualZeros, c.Reads A) ∧
       4098       ¬ (∀ c : Computation, ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z)) :=
       4099    ⟨two_denials G, the_witness_forced_by_the_act⟩
       4100  
       4101  /-! ## XXIII · Double security: the two channels of the line
       4102  
       4103  The formal gate: nothing passes for the hypothesis but least erasure, and the act passes it with an empty cone. The
       4104  actuation gate: nothing passes against it but a point off the line; the root, which every act re-enacts, crosses
       4105  neither way; a registration costs nothing exactly at least erasure, one floor per erased bit. Between the gates the
       4106  bit stays keyed. Every conjunct is a theorem above; this section adds their conjunction and no content. -/
       4107  
       4108  /-- DOUBLE SECURITY. The formal gate, the actuation gate, and the keyed bit between them. -/
       4109  theorem double_security :
       4110      (∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros) ∧
       4111      (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z) ∧
       4112      (∀ Z : World, ¬ LeastErasure Z ↔ OffLine Z) ∧
       4113      (∀ Act : Type, Act → RootAct) ∧
       4114      (¬ ∀ Z : World, RootAct → RH Z) ∧
       4115      (¬ ∀ Z : World, RootAct → ¬ RH Z) ∧
       4116      (¬ ∃ G : SelfGrounding (RH W2f), Nonempty G.Act) ∧
       4117      (∀ C : FinCfg, C.price true = 0 ↔ LeastErasure C.world) ∧
       4118      landauerFloor = 2870978885078723755499100 ∧
       4119      ¬ RespectsRecord LeastErasure ∧
       4120      (∃ Z : World, FoldClosed Z ∧ ¬ LeastErasure Z) :=
       4121    ⟨rh_from_the_act, least_erasure_is_the_value, rejection_is_a_witness,
       4122     fun _ a => act_reenacts_root a, root_does_not_cross_the_line, root_does_not_cross_the_denial,
       4123     line_not_self_grounding, price_zero_iff_least_erasure, landauer_floor_exact,
       4124     least_erasure_reads_past_the_record,
       4125     ⟨W2, W2_closed, fun h => W2_not_rh ((least_erasure_is_the_value W2).mp h)⟩⟩
       4126  
       4127  /-! ## XXIV · the root, undeniable in act, and the lock -/
       4128  
       4129  /-- THE ROOT IS UNDENIABLE IN ACT: a denial of a self-grounding root is an act, and instances it. -/
       4130  theorem denial_reenacts_root {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (denial : G.Act) : R :=
       4131    G.instances denial
       4132  
       4133  /-- The root is held by the act itself. -/
       4134  theorem seated_undeniable {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) : R := G.instances G.anAct
       4135  
       4136  /-- No outside proof adds anything to a self-grounding root. -/
       4137  theorem external_proof_adds_nothing {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (Q : Prop) : (Q → R) ↔ R :=
       4138    ⟨fun _ => G.instances G.anAct, fun r _ => r⟩
       4139  
       4140  /-- THE UNDENIABLE ROOT HOLDS IN BOTH WORLDS: it holds by its act; the two fold-closed worlds share one
       4141  record, the hypothesis holds on the first and fails on the second; so read uniformly on the worlds the
       4142  root forces no value. -/
       4143  theorem undeniable_root_forces_no_value {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       4144      R ∧ (FoldClosed W1 ∧ RH W1) ∧ (FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RH W2) ∧ SameRecord W1 W2 ∧ ¬ Forces (fun _ => R) :=
       4145    ⟨G.instances G.anAct, ⟨W1_closed, W1_rh⟩, ⟨W2_closed, W2_not_rh⟩, same_record_12,
       4146     keyless_forces_nothing (fun _ => R) (fun _ => G.instances G.anAct)⟩
       4147  
       4148  /-- The root's form: every existent of a domain actuates, its actuation positive. -/
       4149  def Root (U : Type) (ΔE : U → Int) : Prop := ∀ x : U, 0 < ΔE x
       4150  
       4151  /-- The indicator of a decided proposition: one where it holds, zero where it fails. -/
       4152  def indicator {p : Prop} : Decidable p → Int
       4153    | isTrue _  => 1
       4154    | isFalse _ => 0
       4155  
       4156  /-- The indicator is positive exactly where its proposition holds. -/
       4157  theorem indicator_pos {p : Prop} (h : Decidable p) : 0 < indicator h ↔ p :=
       4158    match h with
       4159    | isTrue hp  => ⟨fun _ => hp, fun _ => show (0 : Int) < 1 by decide⟩
       4160    | isFalse hn => ⟨fun h0 => absurd h0 (show ¬ (0 : Int) < 0 by decide), fun hp => absurd hp hn⟩
       4161  
       4162  /-- THE CONSTRUCTED ROOT, in the words of Appendix R: one existent, whose actuation is one. A theorem
       4163  with no hypothesis and no axiom. -/
       4164  theorem constructed_root_holds : Root Unit (fun _ => 1) := fun _ => show (0 : Int) < 1 by decide
       4165  
       4166  /-- THE ROOT READ AT THE ZEROS: to exist is to actuate, `Root` itself, with the existents the points of
       4167  the world and the actuation of a point one where it stands on the line and zero where it does not. -/
       4168  def RootAtZeros (Z : World) : Prop :=
       4169    Root { z : Pt // Z z } (fun z => indicator (inferInstanceAs (Decidable (onLine z.1))))
       4170  
       4171  /-- THE ROOT READ AT THE ZEROS IS THE HYPOTHESIS. -/
       4172  theorem root_at_zeros_is_the_hypothesis (Z : World) : RootAtZeros Z ↔ RH Z :=
       4173    ⟨fun h z hz => (indicator_pos _).mp (h ⟨z, hz⟩), fun h z => (indicator_pos _).mpr (h z.1 z.2)⟩
       4174  
       4175  /-- THE ROOT READ AT THE ZEROS IS LEAST ERASURE. -/
       4176  theorem root_at_zeros_is_least_erasure (Z : World) : RootAtZeros Z ↔ LeastErasure Z :=
       4177    ⟨fun h => (least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mpr ((root_at_zeros_is_the_hypothesis Z).mp h),
