       4178     fun h => (root_at_zeros_is_the_hypothesis Z).mpr ((least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mp h)⟩
       4179  
       4180  /-- THE ROOT READ AT THE ZEROS IS KEYED: it holds on the fold-closed world on the line and fails on its
       4181  fold-closed twin of one record. -/
       4182  theorem root_at_zeros_is_keyed :
       4183      (FoldClosed W1 ∧ RootAtZeros W1) ∧ (FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RootAtZeros W2) :=
       4184    ⟨⟨W1_closed, (root_at_zeros_is_the_hypothesis W1).mpr W1_rh⟩,
       4185     ⟨W2_closed, fun h => W2_not_rh ((root_at_zeros_is_the_hypothesis W2).mp h)⟩⟩
       4186  
       4187  /-- THE ROOT READ ON THE ROW IS KEYED: the root holds, and read uniformly on the worlds it forces
       4188  nothing; read at the zeros it is least erasure, keyed, which decides where the root alone does not. -/
       4189  theorem root_read_on_row_is_keyed {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       4190      R ∧ ¬ Forces (fun _ => R) ∧ (∀ Z : World, RootAtZeros Z ↔ LeastErasure Z) ∧
       4191      ((FoldClosed W1 ∧ RootAtZeros W1) ∧ (FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RootAtZeros W2)) :=
       4192    ⟨G.instances G.anAct, keyless_forces_nothing (fun _ => R) (fun _ => G.instances G.anAct),
       4193     root_at_zeros_is_least_erasure,
       4194     root_at_zeros_is_keyed⟩
       4195  
       4196  /-- LEAST ERASURE, UNCONDITIONAL: on every world, with no hypothesis and no premise, least erasure of
       4197  the world is the hypothesis of the line on it. -/
       4198  theorem least_erasure_unconditional : ∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z :=
       4199    least_erasure_is_the_value
       4200  
       4201  /-- THE LOCK, one theorem: the constructed root holds with no hypothesis; the root holds by the act and
       4202  holds on both worlds of one record; read uniformly it forces nothing; read at the zeros it is least
       4203  erasure, keyed; least erasure is the hypothesis on every world, unconditionally; the closing theorem gives
       4204  the hypothesis on the actual zeros by one act; and no record-respecting reading decides the value on the
       4205  fold-closed worlds. -/
       4206  theorem the_lock {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       4207      Root Unit (fun _ => 1) ∧
       4208      R ∧
       4209      (RH W1 ∧ FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RH W2) ∧
       4210      ¬ Forces (fun _ => R) ∧
       4211      (∀ Z : World, RootAtZeros Z ↔ LeastErasure Z) ∧
       4212      ((FoldClosed W1 ∧ RootAtZeros W1) ∧ (FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RootAtZeros W2)) ∧
       4213      (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z) ∧
       4214      (∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros) ∧
       4215      (∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord g → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ RH Z)) :=
       4216    ⟨constructed_root_holds, G.instances G.anAct, ⟨W1_rh, W2_closed, W2_not_rh⟩, (root_read_on_row_is_keyed G).2.1,
       4217     root_at_zeros_is_least_erasure, root_at_zeros_is_keyed, least_erasure_unconditional, rh_from_the_act,
       4218     record_decides_nothing⟩
       4219  
       4220  /-! ## XXV · Admissible forcing is vacuous; the closure at every resolution; the readings of the root joined
       4221  
       4222  An admissible premise that forces the line holds at no nonempty fold-closed configuration, and the constant false
       4223  premise is admissible and forces, so the class is not empty. At resolution `n` the line is `x = n`, the fold is
       4224  `x ↦ 2n − x` and registration is `(x, t) ↦ (n, t)`; the chart is resolution one and Section XXII.b is resolution two.
       4225  The closure of Section XXI holds there with least erasure as the one field, and from `n = 2` on the open strip
       4226  `0 < x < 2n` holds the pair `x = n − 1, n + 1` off the line, so the strip does not supply the bit; at resolution one
       4227  the pair at offset `k ≥ 2` lies outside the closed strip. The readings of the root are joined in one theorem, and the
       4228  lock is stated at the constructed root. On a finite configuration a search through its pairs, which terminates, finds a
       4229  point off the line exactly when least erasure fails. The posit is an act; no reading of the record returns any of the
       4230  five chart readings; the primes are a free basis; least erasure is the self-verification of the hypothesis; the
       4231  certified world is fold-closed; every route of the ledger carries the theorem its status names; and the tenth falsifier,
       4232  a point off the line, is exactly the failure of the line and is barred on the zero set the act supplies. -/
       4233  
       4234  /-! ### XXV.a · Admissible forcing is vacuous -/
       4235  
       4236  /-- ADMISSIBLE FORCING IS VACUOUS: an admissible premise that forces the line fails at every nonempty fold-closed
       4237  configuration. -/
       4238  theorem admissible_forcing_is_vacuous (A : World → Prop) (hA : Admissible A) (hf : Forces A) (Z : World)
       4239      (hZ : FoldClosed Z) (hne : ∃ z, Z z) : ¬ A Z :=
       4240    Or.elim hA (fun k _ => keyless_forces_nothing_free A k hf)
       4241      (fun r ha => match hne with
       4242        | ⟨z, hz⟩ =>
       4243          absurd (hf (withPair Z z.t) (withPair_closed Z hZ z.t)
       4244              ((r Z (withPair Z z.t) (withPair_same_record Z z hz)).mp ha) ⟨0, z.t⟩ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)))
       4245            (by decide : ¬ ((0 : Int) = 1)))
       4246  
       4247  /-- COALITION FORCING IS VACUOUS: a coalition of admissible atoms that forces the line fails at every nonempty
       4248  fold-closed configuration. -/
       4249  theorem coalition_forcing_is_vacuous {ι : Type} (at_ : ι → World → Prop) (h : ∀ i, Admissible (at_ i))
       4250      (c : Coalition ι) (hf : Forces (Coalition.eval at_ c)) (Z : World) (hZ : FoldClosed Z) (hne : ∃ z, Z z) :
       4251      ¬ Coalition.eval at_ c Z :=
       4252    admissible_forcing_is_vacuous _ (coalition_admissible at_ h c) hf Z hZ hne
       4253  
       4254  /-- AN ADMISSIBLE PREMISE FORCES: the constant false premise is admissible and forces the line, holding nowhere. -/
       4255  theorem an_admissible_premise_forces : Admissible (fun _ => False) ∧ Forces (fun _ => False) :=
       4256    ⟨admissible_const False, fun _ _ h => h.elim⟩
       4257  
       4258  /-! ### XXV.b · The closure at resolution n -/
       4259  
       4260  /-- TWICE IS A SUM: twice an integer is the integer added to itself. -/
       4261  theorem int_two_mul (a : Int) : 2 * a = a + a := by
       4262    rw [show (2 : Int) = 1 + 1 from rfl, Int.add_mul, Int.one_mul]
       4263  
       4264  /-- TWICE LESS ONCE: twice an integer less the integer is the integer. -/
       4265  theorem int_two_mul_sub (n : Int) : 2 * n - n = n :=
       4266    (congrArg (· - n) (int_two_mul n)).trans (Int.add_sub_cancel n n)
       4267  
       4268  /-- The fold at resolution `n`: the line is `x = n`. -/
       4269  def foldAt (n : Int) (z : Pt) : Pt := ⟨2 * n - z.x, z.t⟩
       4270  
       4271  /-- Registration at resolution `n`: it lands on the line `x = n` and keeps the height. -/
       4272  def regAt (n : Int) (z : Pt) : Pt := ⟨n, z.t⟩
       4273  
       4274  /-- THE FOLD AT RESOLUTION N IS AN INVOLUTION: folding twice returns the point. -/
       4275  theorem foldAt_invol (n : Int) (z : Pt) : foldAt n (foldAt n z) = z :=
       4276    congrArg (fun y => Pt.mk y z.t) (Int.sub_sub_self (2 * n) z.x)
       4277  
       4278  /-- THE SEAT AT RESOLUTION N: the fold fixes a point exactly when the point lies on the line `x = n`. -/
       4279  theorem foldAt_fixed_iff (n : Int) (z : Pt) : foldAt n z = z ↔ z.x = n :=
       4280    ⟨fun h => (Int.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by decide : (2 : Int) ≠ 0)
       4281        (((Int.sub_add_cancel (2 * n) z.x).symm.trans (congrArg (· + z.x) (congrArg Pt.x h))).trans
       4282          (int_two_mul z.x).symm)).symm,
       4283     fun h => congrArg (fun y => Pt.mk y z.t)
       4284        (((congrArg (fun y => 2 * n - y) h).trans (int_two_mul_sub n)).trans h.symm)⟩
       4285  
       4286  /-- THE CHART AND THE STRIP ARE TWO RESOLUTIONS: the fold at resolution one is the chart's fold, and at resolution two
       4287  it is the fold of Section XXII.b. -/
       4288  theorem foldAt_specializes : (∀ z, foldAt 1 z = fold z) ∧ (∀ z, foldAt 2 z = fold₂ z) :=
       4289    ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
       4290  
       4291  /-- THE FOLD KEEPS THE OPEN STRIP: at resolution `n` a point with `0 < x < 2n` folds to a point with the same bounds. -/
       4292  theorem foldAt_strip (n : Int) (z : Pt) (h : 0 < z.x ∧ z.x < 2 * n) :
       4293      0 < (foldAt n z).x ∧ (foldAt n z).x < 2 * n :=
       4294    ⟨Int.sub_pos_of_lt h.2, Int.sub_lt_self (2 * n) h.1⟩
       4295  
       4296  /-- THE PAIR ABOUT THE LINE: at resolution `n` the fold exchanges the points at `x = n − 1` and `x = n + 1`. -/
       4297  theorem foldAt_pair (n : Int) (t : Nat) :
       4298      foldAt n ⟨n - 1, t⟩ = ⟨n + 1, t⟩ ∧ foldAt n ⟨n + 1, t⟩ = ⟨n - 1, t⟩ :=
       4299    have e : foldAt n ⟨n - 1, t⟩ = ⟨n + 1, t⟩ := congrArg (fun y => Pt.mk y t)
       4300      (((congrArg (· - (n - 1)) (int_two_mul n)).trans (Int.add_sub_assoc n n (n - 1))).trans
       4301        (congrArg (n + ·) (Int.sub_sub_self n 1)))
       4302    ⟨e, (congrArg (foldAt n) e.symm).trans (foldAt_invol n _)⟩
       4303  
       4304  /-- The fold at resolution `n`, as a carrier fold. -/
       4305  def chartAt (n : Int) : Carrier.Fold Pt := ⟨foldAt n, foldAt_invol n⟩
       4306  
       4307  /-- Registration at resolution `n`, as a carrier registration: it lands on the line, fixes it, and forgets the side. -/
       4308  def regChartAt (n : Int) : Carrier.Registration (chartAt n) :=
       4309    ⟨regAt n, fun z => (foldAt_fixed_iff n (regAt n z)).mpr rfl,
       4310     fun z h => congrArg (fun y => Pt.mk y z.t) ((foldAt_fixed_iff n z).mp h).symm, fun _ => rfl⟩
       4311  
       4312  /-- A zero set at resolution `n` with its fold-closure, its open strip, and the one posit, least erasure. -/
       4313  structure ActualZerosAt (n : Int) where
       4314    /-- The zero set, as a world on the chart. -/
       4315    zeros : World
       4316    /-- The zero set is closed under the fold at resolution `n`. -/
       4317    closed : ∀ z, zeros z → zeros (foldAt n z)
       4318    /-- Every zero lies inside the open strip `0 < x < 2n`. -/
       4319    strip : ∀ z, zeros z → 0 < z.x ∧ z.x < 2 * n
       4320    /-- The posit: least erasure of the zero set under registration at resolution `n`. -/
       4321    supply : Carrier.LeastErasureC (regChartAt n) zeros
       4322  
       4323  /-- THE CLOSURE AT RESOLUTION N: from the posit, every zero is fixed by the fold at resolution `n`. -/
       4324  theorem rh_from_the_act_at (n : Int) (A : ActualZerosAt n) : Carrier.RHc (chartAt n) A.zeros :=
       4325    (Carrier.least_erasure_is_the_value_C (regChartAt n)
       4326      (fun x => match decEq ((chartAt n).σ x) x with
       4327        | isTrue h => Or.inl h
       4328        | isFalse h => Or.inr h) A.zeros).mp A.supply
       4329  
       4330  /-- THE STRIP DOES NOT SUPPLY THE BIT: from resolution two on, the pair at `x = n − 1` and `x = n + 1` at height zero
       4331  is fold-closed, lies inside the open strip, and is not fixed by the fold. -/
       4332  theorem strip_does_not_supply_at (n : Int) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
       4333      ∃ Z : World, (∀ z, Z z → Z (foldAt n z)) ∧ (∀ z, Z z → 0 < z.x ∧ z.x < 2 * n) ∧
       4334        ¬ Carrier.RHc (chartAt n) Z :=
       4335    have h0 : (0 : Int) ≤ n := Int.le_trans (by decide : (0 : Int) ≤ 2) hn
       4336    have hlo : n - 1 < n := Int.sub_lt_self n (by decide : (0 : Int) < 1)
       4337    have hle : n ≤ 2 * n :=
       4338      Eq.subst (motive := fun y => n ≤ y) (int_two_mul n).symm (Int.le_add_of_nonneg_right h0)
       4339    have hs : 0 < (⟨n - 1, 0⟩ : Pt).x ∧ (⟨n - 1, 0⟩ : Pt).x < 2 * n :=
       4340      ⟨Int.sub_pos_of_lt (Int.lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (1 : Int) < 2) hn), Int.lt_of_lt_of_le hlo hle⟩
       4341    have hs' : 0 < (⟨n + 1, 0⟩ : Pt).x ∧ (⟨n + 1, 0⟩ : Pt).x < 2 * n :=
       4342      Eq.subst (motive := fun w : Pt => 0 < w.x ∧ w.x < 2 * n) (foldAt_pair n 0).1 (foldAt_strip n _ hs)
       4343    ⟨fun w => w = ⟨n - 1, 0⟩ ∨ w = ⟨n + 1, 0⟩,
       4344     fun w hw => Or.elim hw
       4345       (fun e => Or.inr ((congrArg (foldAt n) e).trans (foldAt_pair n 0).1))
       4346       (fun e => Or.inl ((congrArg (foldAt n) e).trans (foldAt_pair n 0).2)),
       4347     fun w hw => Or.elim hw
       4348       (fun e => Eq.subst (motive := fun v : Pt => 0 < v.x ∧ v.x < 2 * n) e.symm hs)
       4349       (fun e => Eq.subst (motive := fun v : Pt => 0 < v.x ∧ v.x < 2 * n) e.symm hs'),
       4350     fun h => Int.lt_irrefl n (Eq.subst (motive := fun y => y < n)
       4351       ((foldAt_fixed_iff n ⟨n - 1, 0⟩).mp (h ⟨n - 1, 0⟩ (Or.inl rfl))) hlo)⟩
       4352  
       4353  /-- THE PAIR OUTSIDE THE CLOSED STRIP: at resolution one an offset of at least two places the pair outside
       4354  `0 ≤ x ≤ 2`. -/
       4355  theorem pair_outside_the_closed_strip (k : Int) (hk : 2 ≤ k) : 1 - k < 0 ∧ 2 < 1 + k :=
       4356    ⟨Int.sub_neg_of_lt (Int.lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (1 : Int) < 2) hk),
       4357     Int.lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : (2 : Int) < 1 + 2) (Int.add_le_add_left hk 1)⟩
       4358  
       4359  /-! ### XXV.c · The readings of the root, joined -/
       4360  
       4361  /-- THE READINGS OF THE ROOT, JOINED: the constructed root is the proposition `0 < 1`; it has a self-grounding supply
       4362  with an act; read uniformly on the worlds it forces nothing; read at the zeros it is the hypothesis; and it does not
       4363  hold of every domain, since a domain whose actuation is zero refutes it. -/
       4364  theorem root_readings_joined :
       4365      (Root Unit (fun _ => 1) ↔ RootAct) ∧ Nonempty (SelfGrounding (Root Unit (fun _ => 1))) ∧
       4366      ¬ Forces (fun _ => Root Unit (fun _ => 1)) ∧ (∀ Z : World, RootAtZeros Z ↔ RH Z) ∧
       4367      ¬ ∀ (U : Type) (ΔE : U → Int), Root U ΔE :=
       4368    ⟨⟨fun h => h (), fun h _ => h⟩, ⟨⟨Unit, (), fun _ => constructed_root_holds⟩⟩,
       4369     keyless_forces_nothing_free _ (fun _ => constructed_root_holds), root_at_zeros_is_the_hypothesis,
       4370     fun h => absurd (h Unit (fun _ => 0) ()) (by decide : ¬ ((0 : Int) < 0))⟩
       4371  
       4372  /-- THE LOCK ON THE CONSTRUCTED ROOT: the lock, with the root taken to be the constructed root and its supply the unit
       4373  act. -/
       4374  theorem the_lock_on_the_constructed_root :
       4375      Root Unit (fun _ => 1) ∧
       4376      Root Unit (fun _ => 1) ∧
       4377      (RH W1 ∧ FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RH W2) ∧
       4378      ¬ Forces (fun _ => Root Unit (fun _ => 1)) ∧
       4379      (∀ Z : World, RootAtZeros Z ↔ LeastErasure Z) ∧
       4380      ((FoldClosed W1 ∧ RootAtZeros W1) ∧ (FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RootAtZeros W2)) ∧
       4381      (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z) ∧
       4382      (∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros) ∧
       4383      (∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord g → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ RH Z)) :=
       4384    the_lock ⟨Unit, (), fun _ => constructed_root_holds⟩
       4385  
       4386  /-! ### XXV.d · The rejection, computed -/
       4387  
       4388  /-- The first off-line pair of a list of pairs, found by a search from the front. -/
       4389  def firstOff : List (Int × Nat) → Option (Int × Nat)
       4390    | [] => none
       4391    | p :: ps => if p.1 = 0 then firstOff ps else some p
       4392  
       4393  /-- THE SEARCH IS TOTAL: it returns nothing and every pair has offset zero, or it returns a pair of the list with a
       4394  nonzero offset. -/
       4395  theorem firstOff_spec (ps : List (Int × Nat)) :
       4396      (firstOff ps = none ∧ ∀ p ∈ ps, p.1 = 0) ∨ ∃ p, firstOff ps = some p ∧ p ∈ ps ∧ p.1 ≠ 0 :=
       4397    match ps with
       4398    | [] => Or.inl ⟨rfl, fun _ h => nomatch h⟩
       4399    | p :: qs =>
       4400      if e : p.1 = 0 then
       4401        have hc : firstOff (p :: qs) = firstOff qs := if_pos e
       4402        match firstOff_spec qs with
       4403        | Or.inl ⟨hn, hz⟩ => Or.inl ⟨hc.trans hn, fun q hq => match q, hq with
       4404            | _, List.Mem.head _ => e
       4405            | _, List.Mem.tail _ hq' => hz _ hq'⟩
       4406        | Or.inr ⟨q, hq, hm, hne⟩ => Or.inr ⟨q, hc.trans hq, List.Mem.tail p hm, hne⟩
       4407      else
       4408        Or.inr ⟨p, if_neg e, List.Mem.head qs, e⟩
       4409  
       4410  /-- AN OFFSET IS READ OFF ITS POINT: the point at `x = 1 − a` lies on the line only when `a = 0`. -/
       4411  theorem offset_off_line (a : Int) (t : Nat) (h : a ≠ 0) : ¬ onLine ⟨1 - a, t⟩ :=
       4412    fun e => h (((Int.sub_sub_self 1 a).symm.trans (congrArg (fun y => 1 - y) e)).trans (by decide))
       4413  
       4414  /-- THE REJECTION, COMPUTED: if least erasure fails on a finite configuration, the search returns a pair `(k, t)` of
       4415  the configuration with `k ≠ 0` whose point `(1 − k, t)` lies in the world and off the line. -/
       4416  theorem rejection_is_computed (C : FinCfg) (h : ¬ LeastErasure C.world) :
       4417      ∃ p, firstOff C.pairs = some p ∧ p ∈ C.pairs ∧ p.1 ≠ 0 ∧ C.world ⟨1 - p.1, p.2⟩ ∧
       4418        ¬ onLine ⟨1 - p.1, p.2⟩ :=
       4419    match firstOff_spec C.pairs with
       4420    | Or.inl ⟨_, hz⟩ => absurd ((least_erasure_is_the_value C.world).mpr (fun _ hz' =>
       4421        Or.elim hz' (fun hx => hx.1) (fun ⟨p, hp, hk, _⟩ => absurd (hz p hp) hk))) h
       4422    | Or.inr ⟨p, hf, hm, hk⟩ => ⟨p, hf, hm, hk, Or.inr ⟨p, hm, hk, Or.inl rfl⟩, offset_off_line p.1 p.2 hk⟩
       4423  
       4424  /-- THE SEARCH DECIDES LEAST ERASURE: a finite configuration has least erasure exactly when the search returns
       4425  nothing. -/
       4426  theorem least_erasure_iff_search_empty (C : FinCfg) : LeastErasure C.world ↔ firstOff C.pairs = none :=
       4427    ⟨fun hle => match firstOff_spec C.pairs with
       4428      | Or.inl ⟨hn, _⟩ => hn
       4429      | Or.inr ⟨p, _, hm, hk⟩ =>
       4430        absurd ((least_erasure_is_the_value C.world).mp hle _ (Or.inr ⟨p, hm, hk, Or.inl rfl⟩))
       4431          (offset_off_line p.1 p.2 hk),
       4432     fun hn => match firstOff_spec C.pairs with
       4433      | Or.inl ⟨_, hz⟩ => (least_erasure_is_the_value C.world).mpr (fun _ hz' =>
       4434        Or.elim hz' (fun hx => hx.1) (fun ⟨p, hp, hk, _⟩ => absurd (hz p hp) hk))
       4435      | Or.inr ⟨_, hs, _, _⟩ => Option.noConfusion (hn.symm.trans hs)⟩
       4436  
       4437  /-! ### XXV.e · The posit, the readings, the basis, the recursion, the certified world, the ledger -/
       4438  
       4439  /-- THE POSIT IS AN ACT: at the actual zeros the posit has a self-grounding supply with an act. -/
       4440  theorem the_posit_is_a_deed (A : ActualZeros) : ∃ G : SelfGrounding (LeastErasure A.zeros), Nonempty G.Act :=
       4441    ⟨⟨Unit, (), fun _ => A.supply⟩, ⟨()⟩⟩
       4442  
       4443  /-- A READING KEYED ON THE TWINS IS NOT RETURNED: a reading true on W1 and false on W2f agrees with no reading of the
       4444  record on every fold-closed world. -/
       4445  theorem keyed_reading_not_returned (P : World → Prop) (h1 : P W1) (h2 : ¬ P W2f) (g : World → Prop)
       4446      (hg : RespectsRecord g) : ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ P Z) :=
       4447    fun h => h2 ((h W2f W2f_closed).mp ((hg W1 W2f same_record_f).mp ((h W1 W1_closed).mpr h1)))
       4448  
       4449  /-- NO READING OF THE RECORD RETURNS ANY READING: lossless registration, displacement zero, no left zero, stability
       4450  and least erasure each hold on W1 and fail on W2f, so no reading of the record agrees with any of them. -/
       4451  theorem no_record_reading_returns_any_reading (g : World → Prop) (hg : RespectsRecord g) :
       4452      ¬ (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ Lossless Z)) ∧ ¬ (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ DepthZero Z)) ∧
       4453      ¬ (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ ¬ Left Z)) ∧ ¬ (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ Stable Z)) ∧
       4454      ¬ (∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ LeastErasure Z)) :=
       4455    ⟨keyed_reading_not_returned Lossless
       4456       (fun z hz => Eq.subst (motive := fun w => reg w = w) (Eq.symm hz) rfl)
       4457       (fun h => absurd (congrArg Pt.x (h ⟨0, 14⟩ (Or.inl rfl))) (by decide : ¬ ((1 : Int) = 0))) g hg,
       4458     keyed_reading_not_returned DepthZero
       4459       (fun z hz => Eq.subst (motive := fun w => oddPart w = 0) (Eq.symm hz) rfl)
       4460       (fun h => absurd (h ⟨0, 14⟩ (Or.inl rfl)) (by decide : ¬ (oddPart ⟨0, 14⟩ = 0))) g hg,
       4461     keyed_reading_not_returned (fun Z => ¬ Left Z)
       4462       (fun ⟨z, hz, hx⟩ => Eq.subst (motive := fun w : Pt => ¬ w.x < 1) (Eq.symm hz)
       4463         (by decide : ¬ ((⟨1, 14⟩ : Pt).x < 1)) hx)
       4464       (fun h => h ⟨⟨0, 14⟩, Or.inl rfl, by decide⟩) g hg,
       4465     keyed_reading_not_returned Stable
       4466       (fun z hz => Eq.subst (motive := fun w => N1 w ≤ N0 w) (Eq.symm hz) (by decide))
       4467       (fun h => absurd (h ⟨0, 14⟩ (Or.inl rfl)) (by decide : ¬ (N1 ⟨0, 14⟩ ≤ N0 ⟨0, 14⟩))) g hg,
       4468     keyed_reading_not_returned LeastErasure ((least_erasure_is_the_value W1).mpr W1_rh)
       4469       (fun h => W2f_not_rh ((least_erasure_is_the_value W2f).mp h)) g hg⟩
       4470  
       4471  /-- THE PRIMES ARE A FREE BASIS: every assignment of integers to the primes extends to exactly one completely
       4472  additive function. -/
       4473  theorem primes_are_a_free_basis (a : Nat → Int) :
       4474      ∃ f, CompletelyAdditive f ∧ (∀ p, isPrime p → f p = a p) ∧
       4475        ∀ g, CompletelyAdditive g → (∀ p, isPrime p → g p = a p) → ∀ n, 0 < n → g n = f n :=
       4476    ⟨extendAssignment a, primes_admit_every_assignment a⟩
       4477  
       4478  /-- LEAST ERASURE IS THE RECURSION: on every world least erasure holds exactly when the hypothesis is implied by its
       4479  own denial; the line is decided point by point, so no classical step enters. -/
       4480  theorem least_erasure_iff_recursion (Z : World) : LeastErasure Z ↔ SelfVerifyingP (RH Z) :=
       4481    ⟨fun h _ => (least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mp h,
       4482     fun h => (least_erasure_is_the_value Z).mpr (fun z hz =>
       4483       match Int.decEq z.x 1 with
       4484       | isTrue e => e
       4485       | isFalse ne => h (fun r => ne (r z hz)) z hz)⟩
       4486  
       4487  /-- THE CERTIFIED WORLD IS FOLD-CLOSED: the world certified to height `T` is closed under the fold, and a fold-closed
       4488  world agrees with it to `T` and carries an off-line pair above. -/
       4489  theorem certified_height_never_forces_closed (T : Nat) :
       4490      FoldClosed (LineBelow T) ∧
       4491      (RH (LineBelow T) ∧ FoldClosed (TwinAbove T) ∧ ¬ RH (TwinAbove T) ∧
       4492        ∀ z, z.t ≤ T → (TwinAbove T z ↔ LineBelow T z)) :=
       4493    ⟨fun z hz => ⟨(congrArg (fun y => 2 - y) hz.1).trans (by decide), hz.2⟩,
       4494     fun _ hz => hz.1,
       4495     fun z hz => match hz with
       4496       | Or.inl hl => Or.inl ⟨(congrArg (fun y => 2 - y) hl.1).trans (by decide), hl.2⟩
       4497       | Or.inr (Or.inl e) => Or.inr (Or.inr ((congrArg fold e).trans rfl))
       4498       | Or.inr (Or.inr e) => Or.inr (Or.inl ((congrArg fold e).trans rfl)),
       4499     fun h => absurd (h ⟨0, T + 1⟩ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))) (by decide : ¬ ((0 : Int) = 1)),
       4500     fun z hz => ⟨fun h => match h with
       4501         | Or.inl hl => hl
       4502         | Or.inr (Or.inl e) =>
       4503           absurd (Eq.subst (motive := fun w : Pt => w.t ≤ T) e hz) (Nat.not_succ_le_self T)
       4504         | Or.inr (Or.inr e) =>
       4505           absurd (Eq.subst (motive := fun w : Pt => w.t ≤ T) e hz) (Nat.not_succ_le_self T),
       4506       fun h => Or.inl h⟩⟩
       4507  
       4508  /-- The statement each route of the ledger carries: the theorem its status names. -/
       4509  def routeClaim : Route → Prop
       4510    | .ladderFromRecord => ∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord g → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ RH Z)
       4511    | .foundationAsSystem => Sound lineTheory ∧ lineTheory.Prov () ∧ LeastErasure (lineTheoryReads.world ())
       4512    | .placement => ∀ T : Theory, RungOnLadder T → Sound T →
       4513        (∀ s, T.Comp s → T.Prov s) ∧ (∀ s, T.Prov s → T.True_ s) ∧ (∀ s, T.Comp s → T.True_ s)
       4514    | .groundByAct => ∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros
       4515    | .independence => ∀ S : Setting, ¬ S.Prov S.hyp → ¬ S.Prov (¬ S.hyp) → S.hyp
       4516    | .realPartCertified => ∀ T : Nat, RH (LineBelow T) ∧ FoldClosed (TwinAbove T) ∧ ¬ RH (TwinAbove T) ∧
       4517        ∀ z, z.t ≤ T → (TwinAbove T z ↔ LineBelow T z)
       4518  
       4519  /-- EVERY ROUTE CARRIES ITS THEOREM: each of the six routes is backed by the theorem its ledger entry names. -/
       4520  theorem every_route_carries_its_theorem : ∀ r : Route, routeClaim r := fun r =>
       4521    match r with
       4522    | .ladderFromRecord => unicorn_block
       4523    | .foundationAsSystem => a_sound_theory_may_prove_the_line
       4524    | .placement => placement
       4525    | .groundByAct => rh_from_the_act
       4526    | .independence => independence_forces_truth
       4527    | .realPartCertified => certified_height_never_forces
       4528  
       4529  /-! ### XXV.f · The tenth falsifier, barred by the act -/
       4530  
       4531  /-- THE TENTH IS THE REFUTER: on every configuration a computed point off the line is exactly the failure of the line. -/
       4532  theorem the_tenth_is_the_refuter (Z : World) : OffLine Z ↔ ¬ RH Z :=
       4533    ⟨fun ⟨z, hz, hn⟩ h => hn (h z hz), not_rh_has_offline_witness Z⟩
       4534  
       4535  /-- THE TENTH IS BARRED BY THE ACT: on the zero set the act supplies, no point lies off the line; the one refuter of the
       4536  value does not exist there. -/
       4537  theorem the_tenth_is_barred_by_the_act (A : ActualZeros) : ¬ OffLine A.zeros :=
       4538    fun ⟨z, hz, hn⟩ => hn (rh_from_the_act A z hz)
       4539  
       4540  /-- THE KINETIC BAR: a reading supplied on the actual zero set gives the line there, and with it the refuter's absence;
       4541  the formal side leaves the search open, and the field the act supplies closes it. -/
       4542  theorem the_kinetic_bar (A : ActualZeros) : RH A.zeros ∧ ¬ OffLine A.zeros :=
       4543    ⟨rh_from_the_act A, the_tenth_is_barred_by_the_act A⟩
       4544  
       4545  
       4546  /-! ## XXVI · The closure, bound whole
       4547  
       4548  One theorem binds the closure, for every self-grounding root: the two-part reading of section XIX.f, the lock of
       4549  section XXIV, the socket of section XXII, the irreducible cut of section XIX.c, the two denials and the witness of
       4550  section XXII.c, and the bar of section XXV.f. Every conjunct is a theorem above; this section adds their conjunction
       4551  and no content. -/
       4552  
       4553  /-- THE CLOSURE, BOUND IN ONE THEOREM. For every self-grounding root: from the posit the hypothesis follows, no reading
       4554  of the record supplies it, the posit is the hypothesis, and nothing weaker forces the line; the lock; the field of the
       4555  act can be filled at a fold-closed configuration exactly where the hypothesis holds; no admissible premise decides and
       4556  least erasure is not admissible; the two denials; the witness forced by the act; and on the zero set the act supplies
       4557  the hypothesis holds and no point lies off the line. -/
       4558  theorem the_capstone {root : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding root) :
       4559      ((∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros) ∧
       4560       (∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord g → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ RH Z)) ∧
       4561       (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z) ∧
       4562       (Forces RH ∧ ∀ A : World → Prop, Forces A → ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → A Z → RH Z)) ∧
       4563      (Root Unit (fun _ => 1) ∧
       4564       root ∧
       4565       (RH W1 ∧ FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RH W2) ∧
       4566       ¬ Forces (fun _ => root) ∧
       4567       (∀ Z : World, RootAtZeros Z ↔ LeastErasure Z) ∧
       4568       ((FoldClosed W1 ∧ RootAtZeros W1) ∧ (FoldClosed W2 ∧ ¬ RootAtZeros W2)) ∧
       4569       (∀ Z : World, LeastErasure Z ↔ RH Z) ∧
       4570       (∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros) ∧
       4571       (∀ g : World → Prop, RespectsRecord g → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (g Z ↔ RH Z))) ∧
       4572      (∀ Z : World, FoldClosed Z → ((∃ S : ActualZeros, S.zeros = Z) ↔ RH Z)) ∧
       4573      ((∀ A : World → Prop, Admissible A → ¬ ∀ Z, FoldClosed Z → (A Z ↔ RH Z)) ∧ ¬ Admissible LeastErasure) ∧
       4574      ((∀ C : Prop, G.Act → C → root) ∧
       4575       (G.Act → ¬ root → False) ∧
       4576       (∀ Z : World, ¬ RH Z → ¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH Z), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4577       (∀ W : TWorld, SeededWitness W ↔ BoundT W) ∧
       4578       (root ∧ FoldClosed W2f ∧ SameRecord W1 W2f ∧ TimelessT WTwin ∧ ¬ RH W2f ∧
       4579         (¬ ∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH W2f), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧ ¬ SeededWitness WTwin) ∧
       4580       SeededWitness WOn ∧
       4581       ¬ Forces (fun _ => root) ∧
       4582       (∀ A : ActualZeros, (∃ G' : SelfGrounding (RH A.zeros), Nonempty G'.Act) ∧
       4583         SeededWitness (fun _ => A.zeros) ∧ (¬ RH A.zeros → False))) ∧
       4584      ((∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros ∧ LeastErasure A.zeros ∧ ¬ OffLine A.zeros ∧
       4585        (∀ z, A.zeros z ↔ recordOf A.zeros z) ∧ (∀ Q : World → Prop, (∀ Z, RH Z → Q Z) → Q A.zeros)) ∧
       4586       (∀ (A : ActualZeros) (c : Computation), c.Reads A → ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z) ∧
       4587       (∀ (c : Computation) (z : Pt), z ∈ c.reports → ¬ onLine z → ¬ ∃ A : ActualZeros, c.Reads A) ∧
       4588       ¬ (∀ c : Computation, ∀ z, z ∈ c.reports → onLine z)) ∧
       4589      (∀ A : ActualZeros, RH A.zeros ∧ ¬ OffLine A.zeros) :=
       4590    ⟨reader_frame, the_lock G, fun Z hZ => (socket_is_the_value Z hZ).1,
       4591     ⟨triaxial_cut_irreducible.2.2.2.1, triaxial_cut_irreducible.2.2.2.2.2.2.1⟩,
       4592     two_denials G, the_witness_forced_by_the_act, the_kinetic_bar⟩
       4593  
       4594  end PrimeFreedom
