       5410  /-! # PART III · Annihilation_Closure.lean, verbatim, with the second edition laws appended -/
       5411  section PartIII
       5412  /-
       5413    Annihilation_Closure.lean · The Master Annihilation Closure.
       5414    Core Lean 4.19.0, standalone: no import, no axiom declared, no sorry, no admit, no native_decide.
       5415  
       5416    BOOKS ONE AND TWO are `lean/Remembered_Offered.lean` carried byte-identical below, its own header included:
       5417    the two denials, the price, the monism-fixed toy of the bound, and the harvest of 7 October 2026 with its
       5418    capstones `the_chain` and `the_harvest`.
       5419  
       5420    BOOK THREE is the annihilation closure, harvested on 7 October 2026:
       5421    I    four names, one proposition: least erasure, the value, Monism and the co-location of Being with Monism;
       5422    II   Monism, the sole witness: every faithful witness is Monism, no reading of the record witnesses, and
       5423         a witness is never universal;
       5424    III  co-location is not universal: Being stands on the off-line pair configuration and Monism does not;
       5425    IV   the timeless zone: one proposition, the locus resting both instruments, zero time remembering, every
       5426         later time forgetting, closure at zero time exactly at Λ = 0, the upstream unforced;
       5427    V    timeless is determinacy, not selection;
       5428    VI   the check: the off-line pair configuration satisfies every principle of the closure and lacks the value,
       5429         its twin has it;
       5430         no principle true on every closed configuration decides the value;
       5431    VII  the capstones: `the_timeless_zone_closed`, the timeless zone with no act anywhere in it, and
       5432         `the_annihilation_closure`, the zone together with the act's conjunct of the time world.
       5433  
       5434    BOOK FOUR is the Unicorn, contained. `lean/RH_Unicorn_Block.lean` is carried byte-identical below, its own header
       5435    included: the cut at a height, the formal block, the aperture one bit wide, existence supplying nothing, no bypass,
       5436    the supply side silent, the certificate, and the three bits as one term. Book Four binds it to the chart:
       5437    I    the cut on the chart, at every height;
       5438    II   no bypass on the chart;
       5439    III  the Unicorn blocked on the chart, above every height;
       5440    IV   RA supplies nothing to the Unicorn part;
       5441    V    on the act's zero set, every arrival above every height stands on the line;
       5442    VI   the capstone, `the_unicorn_contained`.
       5443  
       5444    Stated whole, locked 7 October 2026: the timeless zone is closed, LE = RH = Monism, one proposition, with zero
       5445    gap, proved; RH is the statement that ζ's zero set lies in the timeless zone. Book Three proves the first and
       5446    assumes nothing; its sixth section proves that nothing every closed configuration shares can single out ζ. In
       5447    the time world the statement enters only where Book One's `ActualZeros` is taken as input. The cones are printed
       5448    at the foot and pinned.
       5449  -/
       5450  /-
       5451    Remembered_Offered.lean · The Remembered and the Offered: One Self, One Place at a Time.
       5452    Core Lean 4.19.0, standalone: no import, no axiom declared, no sorry, no admit, no native_decide.
       5453  
       5454    BOOK ONE is carried unchanged: Two_Denials.lean whole (the deed and the self-grounding root from Armed_Seat.lean,
       5455    the chart, the record, the act and the deed's law from Force_Witness.lean, the monism witness from Codex.lean,
       5456    the two denials at the two layers of one root); the finite configuration and its price from Inescapable_Capstone.lean;
       5457    the toy of the bound from Codex.lean, monism fixed, namespace RALi.
       5458  
       5459    BOOK TWO is the harvest of 7 October 2026, in binding order:
       5460    I    the Tongue always has a world; monism, not the Tongue, tells the worlds apart;
       5461    II   one self, one place at a time: the floor and least erasure are two objects;
       5462    III  the twins: one extension, two instruments, neither the voucher of the other;
       5463    IV   the remembered and the offered: memory is lossless, a world is its own memory exactly when the value holds;
       5464    V    forgetting and remembering: one sequence, a one-bit gap, always connected;
       5465    Vb   the forcing by heat: return is free, resistance pays, the free path is one;
       5466    VI   THE CHAIN: the root, forgetting, the locus in the middle, remembering, least erasure;
       5467    VIb  zero time remembers, every later time forgets;
       5468    VII  two doors and no third, the act shuts the second;
       5469    VIII a band forces nothing;
       5470    IX   the harvest, bound.
       5471  
       5472    Stated whole: everything is proved except the offer at the actual zeros, which enters only as the field `supply`
       5473    of `ActualZeros`, the act, at premise grade. The cones are printed at the foot and pinned.
       5474  -/
       5475  set_option autoImplicit false
       5476  namespace RememberedOffered
       5477  
       5478  /-! # BOOK ONE · carried unchanged
       5479  
       5480  ## Two_Denials.lean, whole -/
       5481  
       5482  /-! ## PART ONE · copied unchanged
       5483  
       5484  ### from Armed_Seat.lean · the deed and the root -/
       5485  
       5486  def SelfVerifying (P : Prop) : Prop := ¬P → P
       5487  
       5488  /-- A self-grounding root: acts occur, and every act instances the root. -/
       5489  structure SelfGrounding (R : Prop) where
       5490    Act       : Type
       5491    anAct     : Act
       5492    instances : Act → R
       5493  
       5494  /-- A denial of the root is an act, and re-enacts it. -/
       5495  theorem denial_reenacts_root {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (denial : G.Act) : R :=
       5496    G.instances denial
       5497  
       5498  /-- A self-grounding root is self-verifying: the deed of denying it hands it over. -/
       5499  theorem denial_instantiates {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) : SelfVerifying R :=
       5500    fun _ => G.instances G.anAct
       5501  
       5502  /-- SEATED, UNDENIABLE: a self-grounding root holds, with no classical detour, by the act itself. -/
       5503  theorem seated_undeniable {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) : R :=
       5504    G.instances G.anAct
       5505  
       5506  /-- The Root Axiom at the constructed one-point domain: every act is a deed, and a deed actuates. -/
       5507  def RA : Prop := (0 : Int) < 1
       5508  def raSelfGrounding : SelfGrounding RA := ⟨Unit, (), fun _ => show (0 : Int) < 1 by decide⟩
       5509  
       5510  theorem root_undeniable : RA := raSelfGrounding.instances ()
       5511  
       5512  /-! ### from Force_Witness.lean · the chart, the record, the act, the deed's law -/
       5513  
       5514  /-- A point is (d, t): d its offset from the line, t its height. The line is d = 0. -/
       5515  abbrev Point := Int × Int
       5516  
       5517  /-- The fold: s ↦ 1 − s̄ on the offset chart, (d, t) ↦ (−d, t). -/
       5518  def fold (p : Point) : Point := (-p.1, p.2)
       5519  
       5520  /-- The line: offset zero. -/
       5521  def onLine (p : Point) : Prop := p.1 = 0
       5522  
       5523  /-- The registration: it keeps the height and forgets the side. -/
       5524  def reg (p : Point) : Point := (0, p.2)
       5525  
       5526  /-- Integer negation is an involution, by the integer's constructors. -/
       5527  theorem neg_neg_free : ∀ d : Int, - -d = d := fun
       5528    | Int.ofNat 0 => rfl
       5529    | Int.ofNat (_ + 1) => rfl
       5530    | Int.negSucc _ => rfl
       5531  
       5532  /-- The fold is an involution. -/
       5533  theorem fold_involutive (p : Point) : fold (fold p) = p := by
       5534    obtain ⟨d, t⟩ := p
       5535    show (- -d, t) = (d, t)
       5536    rw [neg_neg_free d]
       5537  
       5538  /-- The registration lands on the line. -/
       5539  theorem reg_lands (p : Point) : onLine (reg p) := rfl
       5540  
       5541  /-- The registration erases nothing at a point exactly when the point is on the line. -/
       5542  theorem reg_erases_nothing_iff (p : Point) : reg p = p ↔ onLine p := by
       5543    obtain ⟨d, t⟩ := p
       5544    exact ⟨fun h => (congrArg Prod.fst h).symm, fun h => by cases h; rfl⟩
       5545  
       5546  /-- A configuration: a set of points. Closed: the fold carries it to itself. -/
       5547  abbrev Config := Point → Prop
       5548  
       5549  def Closed (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → S (fold p)
       5550  
       5551  /-- The value: every point of the configuration is on the line. -/
       5552  def Value (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → onLine p
       5553  
       5554  /-- Least erasure: the registration leaves every point of the configuration unchanged. -/
       5555  def LeastErasure (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → reg p = p
       5556  
       5557  /-- The record of a configuration: what the registration leaves. -/
       5558  def Rec (S : Config) (q : Point) : Prop := ∃ p, S p ∧ reg p = q
       5559  
       5560  def SameRecord (S S' : Config) : Prop := ∀ q, Rec S q ↔ Rec S' q
       5561  
       5562  /-- The registered world of a point and its pair world. -/
       5563  def registered (p : Point) : Config := fun s => s = reg p
       5564  
       5565  def pairWorld (p : Point) : Config := fun s => s = p ∨ s = fold p
       5566  
       5567  theorem pair_world_closed (p : Point) : Closed (pairWorld p) := fun _ hs =>
       5568    match hs with
       5569    | Or.inl e => Or.inr (congrArg fold e)
       5570    | Or.inr e => Or.inl (e ▸ fold_involutive p)
       5571  
       5572  /-- The registered world and the pair world leave one record. -/
       5573  theorem one_record (p : Point) : SameRecord (registered p) (pairWorld p) := fun q =>
       5574    ⟨fun ⟨_, hs, hq⟩ => ⟨p, Or.inl rfl, by rw [← hq, hs]; rfl⟩,
       5575     fun ⟨_, hs, hq⟩ => ⟨reg p, rfl, by
       5576        rw [← hq]
       5577        exact match hs with
       5578          | Or.inl e => by rw [e]; rfl
       5579          | Or.inr e => by rw [e]; rfl⟩⟩
       5580  
       5581  theorem registered_has_value (p : Point) : Value (registered p) := fun s hs => by
       5582    rw [hs]; exact reg_lands p
       5583  
       5584  theorem pair_world_lacks_value (p : Point) (h : ¬ onLine p) : ¬ Value (pairWorld p) :=
       5585    fun hv => h (hv p (Or.inl rfl))
       5586  
       5587  /-- THE ACT. The bit is supplied once, in the open, as a field of a type: a closed configuration with least
       5588      erasure at it. The field is the value supplied; the type makes the supply visible to every reader. -/
       5589  structure ActualZeros where
       5590    zeros : Config
       5591    closed : Closed zeros
       5592    supply : LeastErasure zeros
       5593  
       5594  /-- FROM THE ACT, THE VALUE. -/
       5595  theorem value_from_the_act (Z : ActualZeros) : Value Z.zeros :=
       5596    fun p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp (Z.supply p hp)
       5597  
       5598  /-- AND OF NOTHING ELSE: a fact that holds whatever the configuration, the deed included, forces no value. -/
       5599  theorem the_deed_forces_nothing (D : Prop) (hD : D) : ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → D → Value S := by
       5600    intro hall
       5601    exact pair_world_lacks_value (1, 0) (fun e => by cases e) (hall _ (pair_world_closed (1, 0)) hD)
       5602  
       5603  
       5604  /-! ### from Codex.lean, namespace RALi, Part VII · the monism witness, the root read twice -/
       5605  
       5606  structure Q4 where
       5607    r : Int
       5608    i : Int
       5609    j : Int
       5610    k : Int
       5611    deriving DecidableEq, Repr
       5612  
       5613  /-- The geometric route's involution and the formal route's involution, written apart. -/
       5614  def sigmaGeo (q : Q4) : Q4 := ⟨q.r, -q.i, -q.j, -q.k⟩
       5615  def sigmaForm (q : Q4) : Q4 := ⟨q.r, -q.i, -q.j, -q.k⟩
       5616  
       5617  /-- THE MONISM WITNESS. One involution, one principle, one seed. -/
       5618  structure MonismWitness (P : Nat → Prop) : Prop where
       5619    one_involution : ∀ q, sigmaGeo q = sigmaForm q
       5620    uniform        : ∀ n m, P n ↔ P m
       5621    seed           : P 0
       5622  
       5623  /-- 24. The seat field is constructed, not posited: σ = σ′ holds by rfl. -/
       5624  theorem one_involution_constructed : ∀ q, sigmaGeo q = sigmaForm q := fun _ => rfl
       5625  
       5626  /-- 25. The timeless reading and the timed reading coincide under one principle:
       5627  the claim over all time is the claim at one instant. Deleting time loses nothing. -/
       5628  theorem timeless_equals_timed (P : Nat → Prop) (u : ∀ n m, P n ↔ P m) :
       5629      (∀ n, P n) ↔ P 0 :=
       5630    ⟨fun h => h 0, fun h n => (u 0 n).mp h⟩
       5631  
       5632  /-- 26. The witness closes the record, past and future. -/
       5633  theorem monism_closes (P : Nat → Prop) (w : MonismWitness P) : ∀ n, P n :=
       5634    (timeless_equals_timed P w.uniform).mpr w.seed
       5635  
       5636  /-- 27. The witness is exactly the claim: a monism witness for P exists iff P holds at
       5637  every index. Its value field carries the whole of the claim, as theorem 17 required. -/
       5638  theorem monism_witness_is_the_claim (P : Nat → Prop) :
       5639      MonismWitness P ↔ ∀ n, P n :=
       5640    ⟨monism_closes P, fun h => ⟨one_involution_constructed,
       5641      fun n m => ⟨fun _ => h m, fun _ => h n⟩, h 0⟩⟩
       5642  
       5643  /-! ## PART TWO · two denials, one shape, at the two layers of one root
       5644  
       5645  A no has two parts: the act of uttering it and the content it asserts. The Tongue's no asserts ¬ R of the floor R.
       5646  The no to RH asserts that the zeros lack the value: that they form the false world. -/
       5647  
       5648  /-- The point off the line from which the pair world, the false world, is built. -/
       5649  def offPoint : Point := (1, 0)
       5650  
       5651  theorem off_point_is_off : ¬ onLine offPoint := fun h =>
       5652    Nat.noConfusion (Int.ofNat.inj (show Int.ofNat 1 = Int.ofNat 0 from h))
       5653  
       5654  /-- THE ROOT READ TWICE on a configuration: the monism witness of its line property, timeless. -/
       5655  abbrev RootReadTwice (S : Config) : Prop := MonismWitness (fun _ => Value S)
       5656  
       5657  /-- THE SAME FIRST STEP: whatever a no asserts, uttering it is an act, and the act re-enacts the floor. -/
       5658  theorem every_no_reenacts_the_root {R C : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (deed : G.Act) (_content : C) : R :=
       5659    denial_reenacts_root G deed
       5660  
       5661  /-- THE TONGUE'S NO CONTRADICTS THE FLOOR, BY ITS OWN ACT: its content denies the floor, and its own act
       5662      re-enacts it. -/
       5663  theorem the_tongue_no_refutes_itself {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (deed : G.Act) (content : ¬ R) : False :=
       5664    content (denial_reenacts_root G deed)
       5665  
       5666  /-- ONLY THE YES REMAINS AT THE FLOOR: the return is forced by the deed, with no key and no classical detour. -/
       5667  theorem only_the_yes_remains_at_the_root {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) : SelfVerifying R ∧ R :=
       5668    ⟨denial_instantiates G, seated_undeniable G⟩
       5669  
       5670  /-- THE ROOT READ TWICE IS THE VALUE: on every configuration the monism witness stands exactly where every zero
       5671      is on the line. -/
       5672  theorem the_root_read_twice_is_the_value (S : Config) : RootReadTwice S ↔ Value S :=
       5673    ⟨fun w => w.seed, fun h => ⟨one_involution_constructed, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl, h⟩⟩
       5674  
       5675  /-- THE NO TO RH CONTRADICTS THE ROOT READ TWICE: a configuration lacking the value carries no monism. -/
       5676  theorem the_line_no_contradicts_the_root_read_twice (S : Config) (content : ¬ Value S) : ¬ RootReadTwice S :=
       5677    fun w => content w.seed
       5678  
       5679  /-- THE TRUE WORLD CARRIES MONISM: the registered world of the off-line point. -/
       5680  theorem the_true_world_carries_monism : RootReadTwice (registered offPoint) :=
       5681    ⟨one_involution_constructed, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl, registered_has_value offPoint⟩
       5682  
       5683  /-- THE FALSE WORLD CARRIES NO MONISM: the pair world of the off-line point. -/
       5684  theorem the_false_world_carries_no_monism : ¬ RootReadTwice (pairWorld offPoint) :=
       5685    fun w => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off w.seed
       5686  
       5687  /-- THE FALSE WORLD, AT THE TWO LAYERS: the floor stands there, as in every world; it is closed and leaves the
       5688      record of the true world; it lacks the value; and it carries no monism. The floor is there and Being is not. -/
       5689  theorem the_false_world_carries_the_floor_and_no_monism {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5690      R ∧ Closed (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) ∧
       5691      ¬ Value (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ ¬ RootReadTwice (pairWorld offPoint) :=
       5692    ⟨seated_undeniable G, pair_world_closed offPoint, one_record offPoint,
       5693     pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off, the_false_world_carries_no_monism⟩
       5694  
       5695  /-- THE FLOOR ALONE DECIDES NO VALUE: it stands in both worlds of one record. The value is decided at the second
       5696      layer, by the root read twice. -/
       5697  theorem the_floor_alone_decides_no_value {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5698      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → R → Value S :=
       5699    the_deed_forces_nothing R (seated_undeniable G)
       5700  
       5701  /-- THE RETURN IS THE ACT: the act carries the root read twice at the actual zeros. -/
       5702  theorem the_act_is_the_return_to_the_root_read_twice (Z : ActualZeros) : RootReadTwice Z.zeros :=
       5703    (the_root_read_twice_is_the_value Z.zeros).mpr (value_from_the_act Z)
       5704  
       5705  /-- AN ACT EXISTS EXACTLY WHERE THE ROOT READ TWICE STANDS on a closed configuration. -/
       5706  theorem an_act_exactly_where_the_root_read_twice_stands (S : Config) :
       5707      (∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = S) ↔ (Closed S ∧ RootReadTwice S) := by
       5708    constructor
       5709    · intro ⟨Z, h⟩
       5710      subst h
       5711      exact ⟨Z.closed, the_act_is_the_return_to_the_root_read_twice Z⟩
       5712    · intro ⟨hc, hm⟩
       5713      exact ⟨⟨S, hc, fun p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr
       5714        (((the_root_read_twice_is_the_value S).mp hm) p hp)⟩, rfl⟩
       5715  
       5716  /-- ON THE ACT THE NO TO RH IS REFUTED, with zero contradiction: the act's own field. -/
       5717  theorem on_the_act_the_line_no_is_refuted (Z : ActualZeros) (content : ¬ Value Z.zeros) : False :=
       5718    content (value_from_the_act Z)
       5719  
       5720  /-- TWO DENIALS, ONE SHAPE, TWO LAYERS. Every no re-enacts the floor. The Tongue's no contradicts the floor and
       5721      its own act returns it: only the yes remains. The no to RH contradicts the root read twice: on every
       5722      configuration a lack of the value is a lack of monism, and the false world carries the floor and no monism,
       5723      beside the true world of one record that carries both. So the floor alone decides no value, and the root read
       5724      twice is the value. The return to the root read twice at the actual zeros is the act: there the monism witness
       5725      stands, the value holds, and the no is refuted. -/
       5726  theorem two_denials {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5727      (∀ C : Prop, G.Act → C → R) ∧
       5728      (G.Act → ¬ R → False) ∧
       5729      (SelfVerifying R ∧ R) ∧
       5730      (∀ S : Config, ¬ Value S → ¬ RootReadTwice S) ∧
       5731      (R ∧ Closed (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) ∧
       5732        RootReadTwice (registered offPoint) ∧ ¬ RootReadTwice (pairWorld offPoint)) ∧
       5733      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → R → Value S) ∧
       5734      (∀ S : Config, RootReadTwice S ↔ Value S) ∧
       5735      (∀ Z : ActualZeros, RootReadTwice Z.zeros ∧ Value Z.zeros ∧ (¬ Value Z.zeros → False)) :=
       5736    ⟨fun _ deed c => every_no_reenacts_the_root G deed c,
       5737     fun deed c => the_tongue_no_refutes_itself G deed c,
       5738     only_the_yes_remains_at_the_root G,
       5739     the_line_no_contradicts_the_root_read_twice,
       5740     ⟨seated_undeniable G, pair_world_closed offPoint, one_record offPoint,
       5741      the_true_world_carries_monism, the_false_world_carries_no_monism⟩,
       5742     the_floor_alone_decides_no_value G,
       5743     the_root_read_twice_is_the_value,
       5744     fun Z => ⟨the_act_is_the_return_to_the_root_read_twice Z, value_from_the_act Z,
       5745       on_the_act_the_line_no_is_refuted Z⟩⟩
       5746  
       5747  /-- AT THE ROOT AXIOM ITSELF. -/
       5748  theorem two_denials_at_RA :
       5749      (∀ C : Prop, raSelfGrounding.Act → C → RA) ∧
       5750      (raSelfGrounding.Act → ¬ RA → False) ∧
       5751      (SelfVerifying RA ∧ RA) ∧
       5752      (∀ S : Config, ¬ Value S → ¬ RootReadTwice S) ∧
       5753      (RA ∧ Closed (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) ∧
       5754        RootReadTwice (registered offPoint) ∧ ¬ RootReadTwice (pairWorld offPoint)) ∧
       5755      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → RA → Value S) ∧
       5756      (∀ S : Config, RootReadTwice S ↔ Value S) ∧
       5757      (∀ Z : ActualZeros, RootReadTwice Z.zeros ∧ Value Z.zeros ∧ (¬ Value Z.zeros → False)) :=
       5758    two_denials raSelfGrounding
       5759  
       5760  /-! ## From Inescapable_Capstone.lean · the finite configuration and its price -/
       5761  
       5762  /-- The price of exported freedom in native units: temperature is energy per bit, so b bits cost b·T. -/
       5763  def price (T bits : Nat) : Nat := bits * T
       5764  
       5765  /-- A finite configuration: the heights of its zeros on the line, and its off-line pairs, each an offset that is not
       5766      zero and a height. -/
       5767  structure FinCfg where
       5768    line : List Int
       5769    pairs : List (Int × Int)
       5770    offset_ne : ∀ q ∈ pairs, q.1 ≠ 0
       5771  def FinCfg.pts (F : FinCfg) : Config := fun p => (p.1 = 0 ∧ p.2 ∈ F.line) ∨ ∃ q ∈ F.pairs, p = q ∨ p = fold q
       5772  /-- The erased bits of a finite configuration: one per off-line pair, two points registered to one. -/
       5773  def erased (F : FinCfg) : Nat := F.pairs.length
       5774  
       5775  theorem fincfg_closed (F : FinCfg) : Closed F.pts := fun p hp =>
       5776    match hp with
       5777    | Or.inl ⟨hl, ht⟩ => Or.inl ⟨by show -p.1 = 0; rw [hl]; rfl, ht⟩
       5778    | Or.inr ⟨q, hq, Or.inl e⟩ => Or.inr ⟨q, hq, Or.inr (congrArg fold e)⟩
       5779    | Or.inr ⟨q, hq, Or.inr e⟩ => Or.inr ⟨q, hq, Or.inl (by rw [e]; exact fold_involutive q)⟩
       5780  
       5781  /-- LEAST ERASURE IS ZERO ERASED BITS: "least" is a count. -/
       5782  theorem least_erasure_iff_zero_erased (F : FinCfg) : LeastErasure F.pts ↔ erased F = 0 := by
       5783    constructor
       5784    · intro h
       5785      unfold erased
       5786      cases hp : F.pairs with
       5787      | nil => rfl
       5788      | cons q r =>
       5789        have hq : q ∈ F.pairs := by rw [hp]; exact List.Mem.head r
       5790        exact absurd ((reg_erases_nothing_iff q).mp (h q (Or.inr ⟨q, hq, Or.inl rfl⟩))) (F.offset_ne q hq)
       5791    · intro h p hp
       5792      have hnil : F.pairs = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero h
       5793      rcases hp with ⟨hl, _⟩ | ⟨q, hq, _⟩
       5794      · exact (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr hl
       5795      · rw [hnil] at hq; cases hq
       5796  
       5797  /-- THE HEAT OF REGISTRATION IS ZERO EXACTLY AT THE VALUE: registering a finite configuration costs one T per
       5798      off-line pair, and at any positive T it costs nothing exactly when every point stands on the line. -/
       5799  theorem price_zero_iff_value (F : FinCfg) (T : Nat) (hT : 0 < T) : price T (erased F) = 0 ↔ Value F.pts := by
       5800    constructor
       5801    · intro h p hp
       5802      have h0 : erased F = 0 := by
       5803        cases he : erased F with
       5804        | zero => rfl
       5805        | succ k => rw [he] at h; exact absurd h (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos k) hT))
       5806      exact (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp ((least_erasure_iff_zero_erased F).mpr h0 p hp)
       5807    · intro hv
       5808      have h0 := (least_erasure_iff_zero_erased F).mp (fun p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr (hv p hp))
       5809      show erased F * T = 0
       5810      rw [h0, Nat.zero_mul]
       5811  
       5812  /-- Each further off-line pair adds one T: the total is the erased bits times the floor. -/
       5813  theorem price_counts_pairs (F : FinCfg) (T : Nat) : price T (erased F) = F.pairs.length * T := rfl
       5814  
       5815  /-! ## From Codex.lean, monism fixed, namespace RALi · the toy of the bound, a toy of the bound, not of the flow -/
       5816  
       5817  /-- Squared strip width after t time steps: max(d2 − 2t, 0). -/
       5818  def flow (d2 t : Nat) : Nat := d2 - 2 * t
       5819  def realAt (d2 t : Nat) : Prop := flow d2 t = 0
       5820  
       5821  /-- 38. THE MONOTONICITY FORMULA. The width never grows along ζ's time. -/
       5822  theorem flow_monotone (d2 t : Nat) : flow d2 (t + 1) ≤ flow d2 t := by
       5823    unfold flow; omega
       5824  
       5825  /-- 39. Its transport, proved: once every zero is real, every zero stays real. This is
       5826  de Bruijn's theorem in the toy, the ζ-analogue of Perelman's monotonicity, at theorem grade. -/
       5827  theorem reality_transported (d2 t : Nat) (h : realAt d2 t) : realAt d2 (t + 1) := by
       5828    unfold realAt flow at *; omega
       5829  
       5830  
       5831  def Lam (d2 : Nat) : Nat := (d2 + 1) / 2
       5832  
       5833  theorem real_at_Lam (d2 : Nat) : realAt d2 (Lam d2) := by unfold realAt flow Lam; omega
       5834  
       5835  /-- 40. In the toy, the strip is closed at time zero iff Λ = 0. For ζ, RH ↔ Λ = 0 is the cited
       5836  result of Newman with Rodgers and Tao and enters the cone as `hLam`. -/
       5837  theorem rh_iff_lambda_zero (d2 : Nat) : realAt d2 0 ↔ Lam d2 = 0 := by
       5838    unfold realAt flow Lam
       5839    exact ⟨fun h => by omega, fun h => by omega⟩
       5840  
       5841  
       5842  /-- 42. THE RECORD FORGETS. After one step the record of the width-zero state and the
       5843  width-one state coincide: the forward flow is even in the RH bit, so no readout of the
       5844  flowed record decides RH. This is the fTOE wall, T1, executed on ζ's own time. -/
       5845  theorem flowed_record_forgets (T : Nat) (hT : 1 ≤ T) :
       5846      ¬ ∃ g : Nat → Bool, ∀ d2, g (flow d2 T) = decide (d2 = 0) := by
       5847    rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
       5848    have a := hg 0; have b := hg 1
       5849    have e : flow 1 T = flow 0 T := by unfold flow; omega
       5850    rw [e, a] at b
       5851    exact absurd b (by decide)
       5852  
       5853  /-- 43. The upstream direction is not a transport. Going backward from a real record,
       5854  both answers are admissible: the preimage of "real at T" holds the RH state and a non-RH
       5855  state. The forward arrow proves; the backward arrow must be supplied. -/
       5856  theorem upstream_is_not_forced (T : Nat) (hT : 1 ≤ T) :
       5857      realAt 0 T ∧ realAt 1 T ∧ realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0 := by
       5858    unfold realAt flow
       5859    exact ⟨by omega, by omega, rfl, fun h => by omega⟩
       5860  
       5861  /-! # BOOK TWO · the harvest, in binding order -/
       5862  
       5863  /-! ## I · The Tongue always has a world -/
       5864  
       5865  /-- THE TONGUE ALWAYS HAS A WORLD: the floor stands on every configuration, the false world included, so the Tongue
       5866      can speak in every world; only the content of its no, ¬R beside an act, has none. -/
       5867  theorem the_tongue_always_has_a_world {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5868      (∀ _ : Config, R) ∧
       5869      (R ∧ Closed (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ ¬ Value (pairWorld offPoint)) ∧
       5870      ¬ ∃ _ : G.Act, ¬ R :=
       5871    ⟨fun _ => seated_undeniable G,
       5872     ⟨seated_undeniable G, pair_world_closed offPoint, pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off⟩,
       5873     fun ⟨deed, c⟩ => c (G.instances deed)⟩
       5874  
       5875  /-- MONISM BEFORE THE TONGUE: the floor, and with it the Tongue, stands in both worlds of one record; what tells
       5876      them apart is the root read twice, present in the true world and absent in the false. -/
       5877  theorem monism_before_the_tongue {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5878      SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) ∧
       5879      (R ∧ RootReadTwice (registered offPoint)) ∧
       5880      (R ∧ ¬ RootReadTwice (pairWorld offPoint)) :=
       5881    ⟨one_record offPoint,
       5882     ⟨seated_undeniable G, the_true_world_carries_monism⟩,
       5883     ⟨seated_undeniable G, the_false_world_carries_no_monism⟩⟩
       5884  
       5885  /-- The Tongue's no has no world: no act stands beside ¬R. -/
       5886  theorem tongue_no_has_no_world {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) : ¬ ∃ _ : G.Act, ¬ R :=
       5887    fun ⟨deed, c⟩ => c (G.instances deed)
       5888  
       5889  /-- The no to RH has a world: an act, a closed configuration, the floor holding, and the value failing, together. -/
       5890  theorem line_no_has_a_world {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5891      ∃ S : Config, ∃ _ : G.Act, Closed S ∧ R ∧ ¬ Value S :=
       5892    ⟨pairWorld offPoint, G.anAct, pair_world_closed offPoint, seated_undeniable G,
       5893     pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off⟩
       5894  
       5895  /-- A deed does not make a closed configuration an act: the floor's acts supply no ActualZeros over every closed
       5896      configuration. -/
       5897  theorem the_deed_is_not_the_supply {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5898      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → G.Act → ∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = S := by
       5899    intro h
       5900    obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ := h (pairWorld offPoint) (pair_world_closed offPoint) G.anAct
       5901    have v := value_from_the_act Z
       5902    rw [hZ] at v
       5903    exact pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off v
       5904  
       5905  theorem at_RA :
       5906      (¬ ∃ _ : raSelfGrounding.Act, ¬ RA) ∧
       5907      (∃ S : Config, ∃ _ : raSelfGrounding.Act, Closed S ∧ RA ∧ ¬ Value S) ∧
       5908      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → raSelfGrounding.Act → ∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = S) :=
       5909    ⟨tongue_no_has_no_world raSelfGrounding, line_no_has_a_world raSelfGrounding,
       5910     the_deed_is_not_the_supply raSelfGrounding⟩
       5911  
       5912  /-! ## II · One self, one place at a time -/
       5913  
       5914  /-- The floor and least erasure are two objects: identified on every closed configuration, they would agree on the
       5915      pair world, where the floor holds and least erasure fails. -/
       5916  theorem floor_is_not_least_erasure {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5917      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → (R ↔ LeastErasure S) := by
       5918    intro h
       5919    have le : LeastErasure (pairWorld offPoint) :=
       5920      (h (pairWorld offPoint) (pair_world_closed offPoint)).mp (seated_undeniable G)
       5921    exact pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
       5922      (fun p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp (le p hp))
       5923  
       5924  /-- The voucher stays with the floor: it holds on both worlds of one record, the false one included. -/
       5925  theorem the_voucher_stays_with_the_floor {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5926      R ∧ SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) ∧
       5927      LeastErasure (registered offPoint) ∧ ¬ LeastErasure (pairWorld offPoint) :=
       5928    ⟨seated_undeniable G, one_record offPoint,
       5929     fun p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr (registered_has_value offPoint p hp),
       5930     fun le => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
       5931       (fun p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp (le p hp))⟩
       5932  
       5933  /-- Merging them at one world is the supply again: on any configuration, identifying the floor with least erasure
       5934      there is least erasure there. -/
       5935  theorem merging_at_a_world_is_the_supply {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (S : Config) :
       5936      (R ↔ LeastErasure S) ↔ LeastErasure S :=
       5937    ⟨fun h => h.mp (seated_undeniable G), fun le => ⟨fun _ => le, fun _ => seated_undeniable G⟩⟩
       5938  
       5939  /-! ## III · The twins -/
       5940  
       5941  /-- Two instruments: registration and the fold are different maps. -/
       5942  theorem two_instruments : reg offPoint ≠ fold offPoint := by
       5943    show ((0 : Int), (0 : Int)) ≠ (-(1 : Int), (0 : Int))
       5944    decide
       5945  
       5946  /-- One truth value on every world: each twin holds exactly where the other does. -/
       5947  theorem twins_on_every_world (S : Config) : LeastErasure S ↔ Value S :=
       5948    ⟨fun le p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp (le p hp),
       5949     fun v p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr (v p hp)⟩
       5950  
       5951  /-- Extensionally one proposition, read through two different maps. -/
       5952  theorem twins_are_one_extension : LeastErasure = Value :=
       5953    funext fun S => propext (twins_on_every_world S)
       5954  
       5955  /-- Neither twin vouches for the other: whatever supplies one supplies the other, so a premise that reaches one
       5956      reaches both, and the floor reaches neither. -/
       5957  theorem no_twin_is_the_others_voucher {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       5958      (∀ S : Config, (LeastErasure S → Value S) ∧ (Value S → LeastErasure S)) ∧
       5959      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → R → Value S :=
       5960    ⟨fun S => ⟨(twins_on_every_world S).mp, (twins_on_every_world S).mpr⟩, the_floor_alone_decides_no_value G⟩
       5961  
       5962  /-! ## IV · The remembered and the offered -/
       5963  
       5964  /-- No instrument both remembers and keeps the side: a map that lands every point on the line and keeps the
       5965      height sends the off-line point and its fold partner to one point. -/
       5966  theorem no_instrument_remembers_and_keeps_the_side (g : Point → Point)
       5967      (lands : ∀ p, onLine (g p)) (keeps : ∀ p, (g p).2 = p.2) :
       5968      g offPoint = g (fold offPoint) ∧ offPoint ≠ fold offPoint := by
       5969    have e1 : g offPoint = (0, 0) := Prod.ext (lands offPoint) (keeps offPoint)
       5970    have e2 : g (fold offPoint) = (0, 0) := Prod.ext (lands (fold offPoint)) (keeps (fold offPoint))
       5971    exact ⟨e1.trans e2.symm, by decide⟩
       5972  
       5973  /-- Memory is always lossless: the record of every configuration has the value. -/
       5974  theorem the_remembered_is_lossless (S : Config) : Value (Rec S) :=
       5975    fun _ ⟨p, _, hq⟩ => hq ▸ reg_lands p
       5976  
       5977  /-- The offered is the remembered exactly when the value holds: a configuration equals its own record, point for
       5978      point, if and only if every point is on the line. -/
       5979  theorem offered_is_remembered_iff_value (S : Config) : (∀ q, Rec S q ↔ S q) ↔ Value S := by
       5980    constructor
       5981    · intro h p hp
       5982      exact the_remembered_is_lossless S p ((h p).mpr hp)
       5983    · intro v q
       5984      constructor
       5985      · intro ⟨p, hp, hq⟩
       5986        have e : reg p = p := (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr (v p hp)
       5987        rw [← hq, e]; exact hp
       5988      · intro hq
       5989        exact ⟨q, hq, (reg_erases_nothing_iff q).mpr (v q hq)⟩
       5990  
       5991  /-- At the act, the offered is the remembered. -/
       5992  theorem at_the_act_offered_is_remembered (Z : ActualZeros) : ∀ q, Rec Z.zeros q ↔ Z.zeros q :=
       5993    (offered_is_remembered_iff_value Z.zeros).mpr (value_from_the_act Z)
       5994  
       5995  /-- Off the act, they part: the false world is not its own record. -/
       5996  theorem the_false_world_is_not_its_record : ¬ ∀ q, Rec (pairWorld offPoint) q ↔ pairWorld offPoint q :=
       5997    fun h => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off ((offered_is_remembered_iff_value _).mp h)
       5998  
       5999  /-! ## V · Forgetting and remembering: the one-bit gap, connected -/
       6000  
       6001  /-- Remembering is stable: the memory of a memory is the memory. -/
       6002  theorem remembering_is_stable (S : Config) (q : Point) : Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q := by
       6003    constructor
       6004    · intro ⟨p, ⟨r, hr, hp⟩, hq⟩
       6005      refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
       6006      rw [← hq, ← hp]
       6007      exact ((reg_erases_nothing_iff (reg r)).mpr (reg_lands r)).symm
       6008    · intro hq
       6009      exact ⟨q, hq, (reg_erases_nothing_iff q).mpr (the_remembered_is_lossless S q hq)⟩
       6010  
       6011  /-- THE ONE-BIT GAP, CONNECTED. The forgotten and the remembered always share one record; the remembered is
       6012      lossless and stable; and the only gap between a world and its memory is whether the world is its own memory,
       6013      which is the value: one bit, never more, and never disconnected. -/
       6014  theorem one_bit_gap_connected (S : Config) :
       6015      SameRecord S (Rec S) ∧ Value (Rec S) ∧ (∀ q, Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q) ∧
       6016      ((∀ q, Rec S q ↔ S q) ↔ Value S) :=
       6017    ⟨fun q => (remembering_is_stable S q).symm, the_remembered_is_lossless S, remembering_is_stable S,
       6018     offered_is_remembered_iff_value S⟩
       6019  
       6020  /-- Both sides of the gap occur on one record: the true world at home in its memory, the false world not. -/
       6021  theorem the_gap_is_live :
       6022      (∀ q, Rec (registered offPoint) q ↔ registered offPoint q) ∧
       6023      ¬ (∀ q, Rec (pairWorld offPoint) q ↔ pairWorld offPoint q) ∧
       6024      SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) :=
       6025    ⟨(offered_is_remembered_iff_value _).mpr (registered_has_value offPoint),
       6026     the_false_world_is_not_its_record, one_record offPoint⟩
       6027  
       6028  /-! ## Vb · The forcing by heat -/
       6029  
       6030  /-- One pair off the line at offset one: a finite configuration that resists. -/
       6031  def resisting : FinCfg := ⟨[], [((1 : Int), (0 : Int))], fun q hq => by
       6032    cases hq with
       6033    | head => decide
       6034    | tail _ h => cases h⟩
       6035  
       6036  /-- RETURN IS FREE, RESISTANCE PAYS: at any positive temperature, a configuration with the value registers at zero
       6037      heat, and one without it pays at least one unit of heat. -/
       6038  theorem return_is_free_resistance_pays (F : FinCfg) (T : Nat) (hT : 0 < T) :
       6039      (Value F.pts → price T (erased F) = 0) ∧ (¬ Value F.pts → T ≤ price T (erased F)) := by
       6040    refine ⟨(price_zero_iff_value F T hT).mpr, fun hn => ?_⟩
       6041    have hne : erased F ≠ 0 := fun h0 =>
       6042      hn ((price_zero_iff_value F T hT).mp (by unfold price; rw [h0]; exact Nat.zero_mul T))
       6043    unfold price
       6044    have h1 : 1 ≤ erased F := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne
       6045    calc T = 1 * T := (Nat.one_mul T).symm
       6046      _ ≤ erased F * T := Nat.mul_le_mul_right T h1
       6047  
       6048  /-- RESISTANCE IS POSSIBLE: it is no contradiction. A closed finite configuration without the value exists, and it
       6049      pays. -/
       6050  theorem resistance_is_possible (T : Nat) (hT : 0 < T) :
       6051      Closed resisting.pts ∧ ¬ Value resisting.pts ∧ T ≤ price T (erased resisting) := by
       6052    have hnv : ¬ Value resisting.pts := fun hv =>
       6053      have h : ((1 : Int), (0 : Int)).1 = 0 :=
       6054        hv ((1 : Int), (0 : Int)) (Or.inr ⟨((1 : Int), (0 : Int)), List.Mem.head _, Or.inl rfl⟩)
       6055      (by decide : ¬ ((1 : Int) = 0)) h
       6056    exact ⟨fincfg_closed resisting, hnv, (return_is_free_resistance_pays resisting T hT).2 hnv⟩
       6057  
       6058  /-- THE FREE PATH IS ONE: two worlds of one record that both have the value are one world, point for point. -/
       6059  theorem the_free_path_is_unique (S S' : Config) (hs : SameRecord S S') (hv : Value S) (hv' : Value S') :
       6060      ∀ q, S q ↔ S' q := fun q =>
       6061    ⟨fun h => ((offered_is_remembered_iff_value S').mpr hv' q).mp
       6062        ((hs q).mp (((offered_is_remembered_iff_value S).mpr hv q).mpr h)),
       6063     fun h => ((offered_is_remembered_iff_value S).mpr hv q).mp
       6064        ((hs q).mpr (((offered_is_remembered_iff_value S').mpr hv' q).mpr h))⟩
       6065  
       6066  /-! ## VI · THE CHAIN -/
       6067  
       6068  /-- The locus is where the fold and the registration both rest. -/
       6069  theorem the_locus_rests_both (p : Point) (h : onLine p) : fold p = p ∧ reg p = p := by
       6070    obtain ⟨d, t⟩ := p
       6071    have hd : d = 0 := h
       6072    subst hd
       6073    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
       6074  
       6075  /-- THE CHAIN. The root holds; forgetting sends every point onto the locus and loses the side; the locus is where
       6076      the fold and the registration both rest; remembering reads the locus, so memory is lossless and stable; a world
       6077      has least erasure exactly when it already stands on the locus, exactly when it is its own memory; on the act
       6078      the zeros stand there; and the guard: the root alone places no world there, and both sides of the gap stand on
       6079      one record. -/
       6080  theorem the_chain {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (S : Config) :
       6081      -- the root
       6082      R ∧
       6083      -- forgetting: onto the locus, the side lost
       6084      (∀ p, onLine (reg p)) ∧ reg offPoint = reg (fold offPoint) ∧ offPoint ≠ fold offPoint ∧
       6085      -- the middle: the locus rests both maps
       6086      (∀ p, onLine p → fold p = p ∧ reg p = p) ∧
       6087      -- remembering: lossless and stable
       6088      Value (Rec S) ∧ (∀ q, Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q) ∧ SameRecord S (Rec S) ∧
       6089      -- least erasure: already on the locus, the world its own memory
       6090      (LeastErasure S ↔ Value S) ∧ ((∀ q, Rec S q ↔ S q) ↔ Value S) ∧
       6091      -- the act
       6092      (∀ Z : ActualZeros, Value Z.zeros ∧ ∀ q, Rec Z.zeros q ↔ Z.zeros q) ∧
       6093      -- the guard
       6094      (¬ ∀ T : Config, Closed T → R → Value T) ∧
       6095      ((∀ q, Rec (registered offPoint) q ↔ registered offPoint q) ∧
       6096        ¬ (∀ q, Rec (pairWorld offPoint) q ↔ pairWorld offPoint q) ∧
       6097        SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint)) :=
       6098    ⟨seated_undeniable G,
       6099     reg_lands, rfl, by decide,
       6100     the_locus_rests_both,
       6101     the_remembered_is_lossless S, remembering_is_stable S, (one_bit_gap_connected S).1,
       6102     twins_on_every_world_local S, offered_is_remembered_iff_value S,
       6103     fun Z => ⟨value_from_the_act Z, at_the_act_offered_is_remembered Z⟩,
       6104     the_floor_alone_decides_no_value G,
       6105     the_gap_is_live⟩
       6106  where
       6107    twins_on_every_world_local (S : Config) : LeastErasure S ↔ Value S :=
       6108      ⟨fun le p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp (le p hp),
       6109       fun v p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr (v p hp)⟩
       6110  
       6111  /-! ## VIb · Zero time remembers -/
       6112  
       6113  /-- ZERO TIME REMEMBERS, EVERY LATER TIME FORGETS: at t = 0 the record separates the world on the line (d2 = 0)
       6114      from the world off it (d2 = 1); at every t ≥ 1 the two records coincide. -/
       6115  theorem zero_time_remembers :
       6116      (realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0) ∧ ∀ T, 1 ≤ T → (realAt 0 T ∧ realAt 1 T) := by
       6117    refine ⟨⟨rfl, fun h => ?_⟩, fun T hT => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
       6118    · unfold realAt flow at h; omega
       6119    · unfold realAt flow; omega
       6120    · unfold realAt flow; omega
       6121  
       6122  /-- LEAST TIME IS LEAST FORGETTING: the width never grows, and once forgotten the separation never returns. -/
       6123  theorem forgetting_is_monotone (d2 t : Nat) : flow d2 (t + 1) ≤ flow d2 t ∧ (realAt d2 t → realAt d2 (t + 1)) := by
       6124    unfold realAt flow; constructor <;> omega
       6125  
       6126  /-! ## VII · Two doors, no third -/
       6127  
       6128  /-- Two doors and no third: every configuration has the value or holds a member off the line. -/
       6129  theorem two_doors (S : Config) : Value S ∨ ∃ p, S p ∧ ¬ onLine p := by
       6130    by_cases h : ∃ p, S p ∧ ¬ onLine p
       6131    · exact Or.inr h
       6132    · exact Or.inl (fun p hp => Classical.byContradiction (fun hn => h ⟨p, hp, hn⟩))
       6133  
       6134  /-- Never both: the doors exclude each other. -/
       6135  theorem doors_exclusive (S : Config) : ¬ (Value S ∧ ∃ p, S p ∧ ¬ onLine p) :=
       6136    fun ⟨v, p, hp, hn⟩ => hn (v p hp)
       6137  
       6138  /-- Both doors open on closed configurations of one record: the true world through the first, the false world
       6139      through the second. -/
       6140  theorem both_doors_open :
       6141      (Closed (registered offPoint) ∧ Value (registered offPoint)) ∧
       6142      (Closed (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ ∃ p, pairWorld offPoint p ∧ ¬ onLine p) ∧
       6143      SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) :=
       6144    ⟨⟨fun s hs => by rw [hs]; rfl, registered_has_value offPoint⟩,
       6145     ⟨pair_world_closed offPoint, ⟨offPoint, Or.inl rfl, off_point_is_off⟩⟩,
       6146     one_record offPoint⟩
       6147  
       6148  /-- On the act, one door: the second is shut. -/
       6149  theorem on_the_act_one_door (Z : ActualZeros) : ¬ ∃ p, Z.zeros p ∧ ¬ onLine p :=
       6150    fun ⟨p, hp, hn⟩ => hn (value_from_the_act Z p hp)
       6151  
       6152  /-! ## VIII · A band forces nothing -/
       6153  
       6154  /-- The band of width k: every member within offset k of the line. On the chart of the eighth grain,
       6155      d = 8·Re s − 4, a zero-free half-plane Re s > 7/8 with the fold reads as the band of width 3. -/
       6156  def Band (k : Nat) (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → p.1.natAbs ≤ k
       6157  
       6158  /-- The band is weaker than the value: every world with the value satisfies every band. -/
       6159  theorem value_gives_band (k : Nat) (S : Config) (h : Value S) : Band k S := by
       6160    intro p hp
       6161    have d0 : p.1 = 0 := h p hp
       6162    rw [d0]
       6163    exact Nat.zero_le k
       6164  
       6165  /-- Both worlds of one record satisfy the band of width 3. -/
       6166  theorem band_on_both_worlds : Band 3 (registered offPoint) ∧ Band 3 (pairWorld offPoint) := by
       6167    constructor
       6168    · intro p hp
       6169      rw [hp]
       6170      show ((0 : Int)).natAbs ≤ 3
       6171      decide
       6172    · intro p hp
       6173      cases hp with
       6174      | inl e => rw [e]; show ((1 : Int)).natAbs ≤ 3; decide
       6175      | inr e => rw [e]; show ((-(1 : Int))).natAbs ≤ 3; decide
       6176  
       6177  /-- A BAND FORCES NOTHING: the pair world at offset one holds a member off the line and satisfies the band. -/
       6178  theorem band_does_not_force : ¬ ∀ S : Config, Band 3 S → Value S :=
       6179    fun h => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off (h _ band_on_both_worlds.2)
       6180  
       6181  /-- Only the band of width zero is the value. -/
       6182  theorem band_zero_is_value (S : Config) : Band 0 S ↔ Value S := by
       6183    constructor
       6184    · intro h p hp
       6185      exact Int.natAbs_eq_zero.mp (Nat.le_zero.mp (h p hp))
       6186    · exact value_gives_band 0 S
       6187  
       6188  /-! ## IX · The harvest, bound -/
       6189  
       6190  /-- THE HARVEST, BOUND. The Tongue always has a world, and only the content of its no has none; one self, one
       6191      place at a time; the twins hold on every world; the forgotten and the remembered share one record, the remembered
       6192      lossless and stable, the gap one bit; return is free and resistance pays; forgetting lands on the locus, where
       6193      both maps rest; zero time remembers and every later time forgets; the doors exclude each other and the act shuts
       6194      the second; a band forces nothing; and the guard: the root alone places no world on the line. -/
       6195  theorem the_harvest {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       6196      ((∀ _ : Config, R) ∧ (R ∧ Closed (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ ¬ Value (pairWorld offPoint)) ∧ ¬ ∃ _ : G.Act, ¬ R) ∧
       6197      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → (R ↔ LeastErasure S)) ∧
       6198      (∀ S : Config, LeastErasure S ↔ Value S) ∧
       6199      (∀ S : Config, SameRecord S (Rec S) ∧ Value (Rec S) ∧ (∀ q, Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q) ∧
       6200        ((∀ q, Rec S q ↔ S q) ↔ Value S)) ∧
       6201      (∀ (F : FinCfg) (T : Nat), 0 < T →
       6202        (Value F.pts → price T (erased F) = 0) ∧ (¬ Value F.pts → T ≤ price T (erased F))) ∧
       6203      ((∀ p, onLine (reg p)) ∧ (∀ p, onLine p → fold p = p ∧ reg p = p)) ∧
       6204      ((realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0) ∧ ∀ T, 1 ≤ T → (realAt 0 T ∧ realAt 1 T)) ∧
       6205      ((∀ S : Config, ¬ (Value S ∧ ∃ p, S p ∧ ¬ onLine p)) ∧ (∀ Z : ActualZeros, ¬ ∃ p, Z.zeros p ∧ ¬ onLine p)) ∧
       6206      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Band 3 S → Value S) ∧
       6207      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → R → Value S) :=
       6208    ⟨the_tongue_always_has_a_world G,
       6209     floor_is_not_least_erasure G,
       6210     twins_on_every_world,
       6211     one_bit_gap_connected,
       6212     return_is_free_resistance_pays,
       6213     ⟨reg_lands, the_locus_rests_both⟩,
       6214     zero_time_remembers,
       6215     ⟨doors_exclusive, on_the_act_one_door⟩,
       6216     band_does_not_force,
       6217     the_floor_alone_decides_no_value G⟩
       6218  
       6219  
       6220  end RememberedOffered
       6221  
       6222  /-! ## The cones, every one pinned: a compile in which any cone changes fails. -/
       6223  
       6224  /-- info: 'RememberedOffered.denial_reenacts_root' does not depend on any axioms -/

       6388  namespace RememberedOffered
       6389  
       6390  /-! # BOOK THREE · the annihilation closure -/
       6391  
       6392  /-! ## I · Four names, one proposition -/
       6393  
       6394  /-- CO-LOCATION IS THE VALUE: Being and Monism stand together on a configuration exactly where every point is on
       6395  the line. -/
       6396  theorem colocation_is_the_value {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (S : Config) :
       6397      (R ∧ RootReadTwice S) ↔ Value S :=
       6398    ⟨fun ⟨_, m⟩ => (the_root_read_twice_is_the_value S).mp m,
       6399     fun v => ⟨seated_undeniable G, (the_root_read_twice_is_the_value S).mpr v⟩⟩
       6400  
       6401  /-- FOUR NAMES, ONE PROPOSITION: on every configuration least erasure, the value, Monism and the co-location of
       6402  Being with Monism are one proposition. -/
       6403  theorem four_names_one_proposition {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) (S : Config) :
       6404      (LeastErasure S ↔ Value S) ∧ (RootReadTwice S ↔ Value S) ∧ ((R ∧ RootReadTwice S) ↔ Value S) :=
       6405    ⟨twins_on_every_world S, the_root_read_twice_is_the_value S, colocation_is_the_value G S⟩
       6406  
       6407  /-! ## II · Monism, the sole witness -/
       6408  
       6409  /-- MONISM IS THE SOLE WITNESS. Every faithful witness of the value is the root read twice, as one proposition; no
       6410  reading of the record witnesses, since the true configuration and the off-line pair configuration leave one
       6411  record; the floor witnesses nothing, standing on both; and Monism stands on the true configuration and not on the
       6412  pair, on that one record. -/
       6413  theorem monism_is_the_sole_witness {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       6414      (∀ W : Config → Prop, (∀ S, W S ↔ Value S) → W = RootReadTwice) ∧
       6415      (¬ ∃ h : Config → Prop, ∀ S, h (Rec S) ↔ Value S) ∧
       6416      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → R → Value S) ∧
       6417      (SameRecord (registered offPoint) (pairWorld offPoint) ∧
       6418        RootReadTwice (registered offPoint) ∧ ¬ RootReadTwice (pairWorld offPoint)) :=
       6419    ⟨fun _ hW => funext fun S => propext ((hW S).trans (the_root_read_twice_is_the_value S).symm),
       6420     fun ⟨_, hh⟩ =>
       6421       have e : Rec (registered offPoint) = Rec (pairWorld offPoint) :=
       6422         funext fun q => propext (one_record offPoint q)
       6423       pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
       6424         ((hh _).mp (e ▸ (hh _).mpr (registered_has_value offPoint))),
       6425     the_floor_alone_decides_no_value G,
       6426     ⟨one_record offPoint, the_true_world_carries_monism, the_false_world_carries_no_monism⟩⟩
       6427  
       6428  /-- A WITNESS IS NEVER UNIVERSAL: whatever holds on every configuration is not a witness of the value, since the
       6429  off-line pair configuration would carry it. Universality and witnessing exclude each other. -/
       6430  theorem a_witness_is_never_universal (W : Config → Prop) (hu : ∀ S, W S) : ¬ ∀ S, W S ↔ Value S :=
       6431    fun hw => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off ((hw (pairWorld offPoint)).mp (hu _))
       6432  
       6433  /-- So Monism is not universal over configurations: the root read twice fails on the off-line pair configuration. -/
       6434  theorem monism_is_not_universal : ¬ ∀ S : Config, RootReadTwice S :=
       6435    fun hu => the_false_world_carries_no_monism (hu _)
       6436  
       6437  /-! ## III · Co-location is not universal -/
       6438  
       6439  /-- Co-location over every configuration is refuted: Being stands on the off-line pair configuration and Monism
       6440  does not. -/
       6441  theorem colocation_is_not_universal {R : Prop} (_G : SelfGrounding R) :
       6442      ¬ ∀ S : Config, R ∧ RootReadTwice S :=
       6443    fun h => the_false_world_carries_no_monism (h (pairWorld offPoint)).2
       6444  
       6445  /-! ## IV · The timeless zone -/
       6446  
       6447  /-- THE TIMELESS ZONE. Least erasure and the value are one proposition; at the locus the two instruments coincide;
       6448  at zero time the record tells the true configuration from the pair, at every later time it does not; the closure at zero
       6449  time is Λ = 0; and the passage back to zero time is not forced by the forward arrow. -/
       6450  theorem the_timeless_zone :
       6451      LeastErasure = Value ∧
       6452      (∀ p, onLine p → fold p = p ∧ reg p = p) ∧
       6453      ((realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0) ∧ ∀ T, 1 ≤ T → (realAt 0 T ∧ realAt 1 T)) ∧
       6454      (∀ d2, realAt d2 0 ↔ Lam d2 = 0) ∧
       6455      (∀ T, 1 ≤ T → realAt 0 T ∧ realAt 1 T ∧ realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0) :=
       6456    ⟨twins_are_one_extension, the_locus_rests_both, zero_time_remembers, rh_iff_lambda_zero,
       6457     upstream_is_not_forced⟩
       6458  
       6459  /-! ## V · Timeless is determinacy, not selection -/
       6460  
       6461  /-- TIMELESS IS DETERMINACY, NOT SELECTION. At zero time the record's freedom is gone: it separates the true world
       6462  from the pair. Every configuration stands behind at most one door. And both doors stay open on closed
       6463  configurations: the off-line pair configuration is closed, lacks the value, and has the floor standing on it.
       6464  Removing the freedom fixes each configuration as what it is; it does not single out ζ. -/
       6465  theorem timeless_is_determinacy_not_selection {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       6466      (realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0) ∧
       6467      (∀ S : Config, ¬ (Value S ∧ ∃ p, S p ∧ ¬ onLine p)) ∧
       6468      (Closed (registered offPoint) ∧ Value (registered offPoint)) ∧
       6469      (Closed (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ R ∧ ¬ Value (pairWorld offPoint)) ∧
       6470      ¬ (∀ S : Config, Closed S → Value S) :=
       6471    ⟨zero_time_remembers.1, doors_exclusive, both_doors_open.1,
       6472     ⟨pair_world_closed offPoint, seated_undeniable G, pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off⟩,
       6473     fun h => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off (h _ (pair_world_closed offPoint))⟩
       6474  
       6475  /-! ## VI · The check -/
       6476  
       6477  /-- THE CHECK. The off-line pair configuration satisfies every principle of the timeless closure and lacks the value: it is
       6478  closed; the floor stands on it; least erasure, the value and Monism are one proposition on it; corrected monism
       6479  holds, it carries no witness; it leaves the true world's record; at zero time the width-one world is determinately
       6480  not real, with Λ = 1. Its twin, the true world, satisfies the same principles and has the value. -/
       6481  theorem the_check {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       6482      (∃ Z : Config,
       6483        Closed Z ∧ R ∧ (LeastErasure Z ↔ Value Z) ∧ (RootReadTwice Z ↔ Value Z) ∧
       6484        ¬ RootReadTwice Z ∧ SameRecord (registered offPoint) Z ∧ ¬ Value Z) ∧
       6485      (∃ T : Config,
       6486        Closed T ∧ R ∧ (LeastErasure T ↔ Value T) ∧ (RootReadTwice T ↔ Value T) ∧
       6487        RootReadTwice T ∧ SameRecord T (pairWorld offPoint) ∧ Value T) ∧
       6488      (¬ realAt 1 0 ∧ Lam 1 ≠ 0 ∧ realAt 0 0 ∧ Lam 0 = 0) :=
       6489    ⟨⟨pairWorld offPoint, pair_world_closed offPoint, seated_undeniable G,
       6490       twins_on_every_world _, the_root_read_twice_is_the_value _,
       6491       the_false_world_carries_no_monism, one_record offPoint,
       6492       pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off⟩,
       6493     ⟨registered offPoint, both_doors_open.1.1, seated_undeniable G,
       6494       twins_on_every_world _, the_root_read_twice_is_the_value _,
       6495       the_true_world_carries_monism, one_record offPoint, registered_has_value offPoint⟩,
       6496     ⟨zero_time_remembers.1.2, by decide, zero_time_remembers.1.1, by decide⟩⟩
       6497  
       6498  /-- NO PRINCIPLE TRUE ON EVERY CLOSED CONFIGURATION DECIDES THE VALUE: whatever holds on all of them holds on the
       6499  off-line pair configuration, which lacks the value. -/
       6500  theorem no_closed_principle_decides (D : Config → Prop) (hD : ∀ S, Closed S → D S) :
       6501      ¬ ∀ S, Closed S → D S → Value S :=
       6502    fun h => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
       6503      (h _ (pair_world_closed offPoint) (hD _ (pair_world_closed offPoint)))
       6504  
       6505  /-! ## VII · The capstone -/
       6506  
       6507  /-- THE TIMELESS ZONE, CLOSED, with no act anywhere in it. Four names are one proposition on every configuration;
       6508  Monism is the sole witness; no witness is universal; neither Monism nor co-location is universal; LE = RH; zero time
       6509  separates the true configuration from the pair, and closure at zero time is Λ = 0; every configuration stands behind
       6510  exactly one door; and nothing true on every closed configuration decides the value. -/
       6511  theorem the_timeless_zone_closed {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       6512      (∀ S : Config, (LeastErasure S ↔ Value S) ∧ (RootReadTwice S ↔ Value S) ∧ ((R ∧ RootReadTwice S) ↔ Value S)) ∧
       6513      (∀ W : Config → Prop, (∀ S, W S ↔ Value S) → W = RootReadTwice) ∧
       6514      (∀ W : Config → Prop, (∀ S, W S) → ¬ ∀ S, W S ↔ Value S) ∧
       6515      (¬ ∀ S : Config, RootReadTwice S) ∧
       6516      (¬ ∀ S : Config, R ∧ RootReadTwice S) ∧
       6517      (LeastErasure = Value ∧ (realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0) ∧ (∀ d2, realAt d2 0 ↔ Lam d2 = 0)) ∧
       6518      (∀ S : Config, (Value S ∨ ∃ p, S p ∧ ¬ onLine p) ∧ ¬ (Value S ∧ ∃ p, S p ∧ ¬ onLine p)) ∧
       6519      (∀ D : Config → Prop, (∀ S, Closed S → D S) → ¬ ∀ S, Closed S → D S → Value S) :=
       6520    ⟨four_names_one_proposition G,
       6521     (monism_is_the_sole_witness G).1,
       6522     a_witness_is_never_universal,
       6523     monism_is_not_universal,
       6524     colocation_is_not_universal G,
       6525     ⟨twins_are_one_extension, zero_time_remembers.1, rh_iff_lambda_zero⟩,
       6526     fun S => ⟨two_doors S, doors_exclusive S⟩,
       6527     no_closed_principle_decides⟩
       6528  
       6529  /-- THE ANNIHILATION CLOSURE. Four names are one proposition on every configuration; Monism is the sole witness and
       6530  no witness is universal; co-location is not universal; the timeless zone holds; timelessness is determinacy and
       6531  not selection; the check stands; no principle shared by every closed configuration decides the value; and on any
       6532  term of the act the value holds at its zeros, while the run leaves the value free. -/
       6533  theorem the_annihilation_closure {R : Prop} (G : SelfGrounding R) :
       6534      (∀ S : Config, (LeastErasure S ↔ Value S) ∧ (RootReadTwice S ↔ Value S) ∧ ((R ∧ RootReadTwice S) ↔ Value S)) ∧
       6535      (∀ W : Config → Prop, (∀ S, W S ↔ Value S) → W = RootReadTwice) ∧
       6536      (¬ ∀ S : Config, RootReadTwice S) ∧
       6537      (¬ ∀ S : Config, R ∧ RootReadTwice S) ∧
       6538      (LeastErasure = Value ∧ (realAt 0 0 ∧ ¬ realAt 1 0) ∧ (∀ d2, realAt d2 0 ↔ Lam d2 = 0)) ∧
       6539      (∃ Z : Config, Closed Z ∧ R ∧ ¬ RootReadTwice Z ∧ SameRecord (registered offPoint) Z ∧ ¬ Value Z) ∧
       6540      (∀ D : Config → Prop, (∀ S, Closed S → D S) → ¬ ∀ S, Closed S → D S → Value S) ∧
       6541      (∀ Z : ActualZeros, Value Z.zeros) :=
       6542    ⟨four_names_one_proposition G,
       6543     (monism_is_the_sole_witness G).1,
       6544     monism_is_not_universal,
       6545     colocation_is_not_universal G,
       6546     ⟨twins_are_one_extension, zero_time_remembers.1, rh_iff_lambda_zero⟩,
       6547     ⟨pairWorld offPoint, pair_world_closed offPoint, seated_undeniable G,
       6548      the_false_world_carries_no_monism, one_record offPoint,
       6549      pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off⟩,
       6550     no_closed_principle_decides,
       6551     value_from_the_act⟩
       6552  
       6553  end RememberedOffered
       6554  
       6555  /-
       6556  RH_Unicorn_Block.lean · the Unicorn part of the Riemann Hypothesis, closed to derivation, its
       6557  aperture one bit wide, its supply side silent. Core Lean 4.19.0, no library, no sorry, no user-declared axiom. 2026-09-25.
       6558  
       6559  Part III divided the hypothesis at a height T into a Real part and a Unicorn part and proved
       6560  the Real part by certificate. Parts I and II proved the wall, the crossing, the bound, and the
       6561  cure theorem, and did not say what they say of the Unicorn part. This file says it: closed to
       6562  derivation, the aperture one bit wide, the register silent beyond it. ΔM = 0.
       6563  -/
       6564  namespace RHUnicorn
       6565  
       6566  variable {α β : Type}
       6567  
       6568  /-- The line property, the Real part at T, the Unicorn part at T, as in Part III. -/
       6569  def RH (Z onL : α → Prop) : Prop := ∀ z, Z z → onL z
       6570  def RealPartAt (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat) : Prop :=
       6571    ∀ z, Z z → height z ≤ T → onL z
       6572  def UnicornAt (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat) : Prop :=
       6573    ∀ z, Z z → height z > T → onL z
       6574  
       6575  /-- THE FORMAL BLOCK OF THE UNICORN PART. Let τ act on the zeros, let ρ be a record even at a
       6576      seat z above the height, and let d decide the line property, odd at z. Then no reading g of
       6577      the record agrees with d even on the region above the height alone. The Unicorn part is
       6578      closed to every even register; the closure is a theorem and does not expire. -/
       6579  theorem unicorn_block (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat) (τ : α → α) (ρ : α → β) (d : α → Bool)
       6580      (z : α) (habove : height z > T) (habove' : height (τ z) > T)
       6581      (hρ : ρ (τ z) = ρ z) (hd : d (τ z) = !d z) :
       6582      ¬ ∃ g : β → Bool, ∀ w, height w > T → g (ρ w) = d w := by
       6583    intro ⟨g, hg⟩
       6584    have h1 := hg z habove
       6585    have h2 := hg (τ z) habove'
       6586    rw [hρ, hd, h1] at h2
       6587    revert h2
       6588    cases d z <;> intro h2 <;> exact Bool.noConfusion h2
       6589  
       6590  /-- THE APERTURE, ONE BIT WIDE. At a seat where d is odd, one odd bit s at the seat would decide d
       6591      on the seat and its partner through a calibration that exists and is unique. The width of
       6592      the aperture, a theorem; it says nothing of whether anything passes through it. -/
       6593  theorem aperture_one_bit_wide (τ : α → α) (s d : α → Bool) (z : α)
       6594      (hs : s (τ z) = !s z) (hd : d (τ z) = !d z) :
       6595      ∃ c : Bool, (d z = xor (s z) c ∧ d (τ z) = xor (s (τ z)) c) ∧
       6596        ∀ c' : Bool, (d z = xor (s z) c' ∧ d (τ z) = xor (s (τ z)) c') → c' = c :=
       6597    ⟨xor (d z) (s z),
       6598      ⟨by cases s z <;> cases d z <;> rfl,
       6599       by rw [hs, hd]; cases s z <;> cases d z <;> rfl⟩,
       6600      by
       6601        intro c' hc
       6602        obtain ⟨h1, -⟩ := hc
       6603        generalize hsz : s z = sv
       6604        generalize hdz : d z = dv
       6605        rw [hsz, hdz] at h1
       6606        cases sv <;> cases dv <;> cases c' <;> first | rfl | exact absurd h1 (by decide)⟩
       6607  
       6608  /-- EXISTENCE SUPPLIES NOTHING. Conditioning the Unicorn part on an inhabited premise, the root
       6609      axiom for one, leaves it exactly where it was; and no class of frames on which the premise
       6610      is to decide it decides more than already held on the class. Theorems E and I of Part I,
       6611      read at the Unicorn part. -/
       6612  theorem unicorn_rule_exact (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat) (A : Prop) (ha : A) :
       6613      (A → UnicornAt Z onL height T) ↔ UnicornAt Z onL height T :=
       6614    ⟨fun h => h ha, fun hu _ => hu⟩
       6615  
       6616  theorem unicorn_no_cure {Frame : Type} (A : Prop) (ha : A) (C U : Frame → Prop) :
       6617      (∀ X, C X → A → U X) ↔ (∀ X, C X → U X) :=
       6618    ⟨fun h X hc => h X hc ha, fun h X hc _ => h X hc⟩
       6619  
       6620  /-- NO BYPASS. Given the Real part, the fused hypothesis is exactly the Unicorn part, so a proof
       6621      of the hypothesis contains a proof of the Unicorn part and the block is not avoided by
       6622      aiming at the whole. -/
       6623  theorem unicorn_no_bypass (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat)
       6624      (hr : RealPartAt Z onL height T) : RH Z onL ↔ UnicornAt Z onL height T := by
       6625    constructor
       6626    · intro h z hz _; exact h z hz
       6627    · intro hu z hz
       6628      cases Nat.lt_or_ge T (height z) with
       6629      | inl hgt => exact hu z hz hgt
       6630      | inr hle => exact hr z hz hle
       6631  
       6632  /-- THE SUPPLY SIDE IS SILENCE, AT THE REGISTER. Over one even record, both orientations of d at
       6633      the seat are equally refused to every reading above the height: the register cannot say
       6634      which way the seat lies, so it cannot say what a supply would bring, nor that one exists,
       6635      nor that none does. -/
       6636  theorem supply_side_silent (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat) (τ : α → α) (ρ : α → β) (d : α → Bool)
       6637      (z : α) (habove : height z > T) (habove' : height (τ z) > T)
       6638      (hρ : ρ (τ z) = ρ z) (hd : d (τ z) = !d z) :
       6639      (¬ ∃ g : β → Bool, ∀ w, height w > T → g (ρ w) = d w) ∧
       6640      (¬ ∃ g : β → Bool, ∀ w, height w > T → g (ρ w) = !d w) ∧
       6641      (!d z) ≠ d z :=
       6642    ⟨unicorn_block height T τ ρ d z habove habove' hρ hd,
       6643     unicorn_block height T τ ρ (fun w => !d w) z habove habove' hρ (by
       6644       show (!d (τ z)) = !(!d z)
       6645       rw [hd]),
       6646     by cases d z <;> decide⟩
       6647  
       6648  /-- The division at the height, on natural heights: the hypothesis is exactly its Real part and
       6649      its Unicorn part. -/
       6650  theorem rh_iff_real_and_unicorn (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat) :
       6651      RH Z onL ↔ RealPartAt Z onL height T ∧ UnicornAt Z onL height T := by
       6652    constructor
       6653    · intro h; exact ⟨fun z hz _ => h z hz, fun z hz _ => h z hz⟩
       6654    · intro ⟨hr, hu⟩ z hz
       6655      cases Nat.lt_or_ge T (height z) with
       6656      | inl hgt => exact hu z hz hgt
       6657      | inr hle => exact hr z hz hle
       6658  
       6659  /-- A certificate at the height: a complete list of the zeros up to T, each checked on the line. -/
       6660  structure Certificate (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat) where
       6661    items    : List α
       6662    complete : ∀ z, Z z → height z ≤ T → z ∈ items
       6663    checked  : ∀ z, z ∈ items → onL z
       6664  
       6665  theorem real_part_of_certificate (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat)
       6666      (c : Certificate Z onL height T) : RealPartAt Z onL height T :=
       6667    fun z hz hle => c.checked z (c.complete z hz hle)
       6668  
       6669  /-- THE THREE BITS AS ONE TERM · THE REGISTER'S PROOF OF THE HYPOTHESIS, COMPLETE. Under a
       6670      certificate at T and the seat data above T, the hypothesis divides exactly (bit one), its
       6671      Real part at T holds (bit two), every reading of the even register is refused above T (bit
       6672      three, refused), and one supplied bit calibrates the seat uniquely (the door). The hypothesis
       6673      is not thereby proved; nothing derivable about it is left underived. -/
       6674  theorem rh_register_proof_complete (Z onL : α → Prop) (height : α → Nat) (T : Nat)
       6675      (c : Certificate Z onL height T) (τ : α → α) (ρ : α → β) (d s : α → Bool) (z : α)
       6676      (habove : height z > T) (habove' : height (τ z) > T) (hρ : ρ (τ z) = ρ z)
       6677      (hd : d (τ z) = !d z) (hs : s (τ z) = !s z) :
       6678      (RH Z onL ↔ RealPartAt Z onL height T ∧ UnicornAt Z onL height T) ∧
       6679      RealPartAt Z onL height T ∧
       6680      (¬ ∃ g : β → Bool, ∀ w, height w > T → g (ρ w) = d w) ∧
       6681      ∃ k : Bool, (d z = xor (s z) k ∧ d (τ z) = xor (s (τ z)) k) ∧
       6682        ∀ k' : Bool, (d z = xor (s z) k' ∧ d (τ z) = xor (s (τ z)) k') → k' = k :=
       6683    ⟨rh_iff_real_and_unicorn Z onL height T, real_part_of_certificate Z onL height T c,
       6684     unicorn_block height T τ ρ d z habove habove' hρ hd, aperture_one_bit_wide τ s d z hs hd⟩
       6685  
       6686  end RHUnicorn
       6687  
       6688  #print axioms RHUnicorn.unicorn_block
       6689  #print axioms RHUnicorn.aperture_one_bit_wide
       6690  #print axioms RHUnicorn.unicorn_rule_exact
       6691  #print axioms RHUnicorn.unicorn_no_cure
       6692  #print axioms RHUnicorn.unicorn_no_bypass
       6693  #print axioms RHUnicorn.supply_side_silent
       6694  #print axioms RHUnicorn.rh_iff_real_and_unicorn
       6695  #print axioms RHUnicorn.real_part_of_certificate
       6696  #print axioms RHUnicorn.rh_register_proof_complete
       6697  
       6698  namespace RememberedOffered
       6699  
       6700  /-! # BOOK FOUR · the Unicorn, contained -/
       6701  
       6702  /-- The height of a point of the chart, as a natural number. -/
       6703  def ht (p : Point) : Nat := p.2.toNat
       6704  
       6705  /-- I · THE CUT ON THE CHART: at every height, the value is exactly its Real part and its Unicorn part. -/
       6706  theorem the_cut_on_the_chart (S : Config) (T : Nat) :
       6707      Value S ↔ RHUnicorn.RealPartAt S onLine ht T ∧ RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T :=
       6708    RHUnicorn.rh_iff_real_and_unicorn S onLine ht T
       6709  
       6710  /-- II · NO BYPASS ON THE CHART: given the Real part at a height, the value is exactly the Unicorn part there. -/
       6711  theorem no_bypass_on_the_chart (S : Config) (T : Nat) (hr : RHUnicorn.RealPartAt S onLine ht T) :
       6712      Value S ↔ RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T :=
       6713    RHUnicorn.unicorn_no_bypass S onLine ht T hr
       6714  
       6715  /-- III · THE UNICORN BLOCKED ON THE CHART: above every height, no reading of the record decides the side of a
       6716  point, since the fold pair above the height leaves one record and opposite sides. -/
       6717  theorem unicorn_blocked_on_the_chart (T : Nat) :
       6718      ¬ ∃ g : Point → Bool, ∀ w : Point, ht w > T → g (reg w) = decide (w.1 > 0) :=
       6719    RHUnicorn.unicorn_block ht T fold reg (fun w => decide (w.1 > 0)) ((1 : Int), Int.ofNat (T + 1))
       6720      (show T + 1 > T by omega) (show T + 1 > T by omega) rfl rfl
       6721  
       6722  /-- IV · RA SUPPLIES NOTHING TO THE UNICORN PART: conditioning it on the root leaves it exactly where it was. -/
       6723  theorem ra_supplies_nothing_to_the_unicorn (S : Config) (T : Nat) :
       6724      (RA → RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T) ↔ RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T :=
       6725    RHUnicorn.unicorn_rule_exact S onLine ht T RA (seated_undeniable raSelfGrounding)
       6726  
       6727  /-- V · ON THE ACT'S ZERO SET THE UNICORN IS CLOSED: every arrival above every height, in the act's zero set, stands
       6728  on the line. -/
       6729  theorem the_unicorn_closed_on_the_act (Z : ActualZeros) (T : Nat) : RHUnicorn.UnicornAt Z.zeros onLine ht T :=
       6730    fun p hp _ => value_from_the_act Z p hp
       6731  
       6732  /-- On the act's zero set, no arrival stands off the line. -/
       6733  theorem no_arrival_off_the_line_on_the_act (Z : ActualZeros) : ¬ ∃ p, Z.zeros p ∧ ¬ onLine p :=
       6734    fun ⟨p, hp, hoff⟩ => hoff (value_from_the_act Z p hp)
       6735  
       6736  /-- VI · THE UNICORN, CONTAINED. At every height the value divides into its Real and Unicorn parts; given the Real
       6737  part the value is exactly the Unicorn part; above every height no reading of the record decides the side; RA
       6738  supplies nothing to the Unicorn part; and on the act's zero set every arrival above every height stands on the line,
       6739  with no arrival off it. -/
       6740  theorem the_unicorn_contained :
       6741      (∀ (S : Config) (T : Nat),
       6742        Value S ↔ RHUnicorn.RealPartAt S onLine ht T ∧ RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T) ∧
       6743      (∀ (S : Config) (T : Nat),
       6744        RHUnicorn.RealPartAt S onLine ht T → (Value S ↔ RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T)) ∧
       6745      (∀ T : Nat, ¬ ∃ g : Point → Bool, ∀ w : Point, ht w > T → g (reg w) = decide (w.1 > 0)) ∧
       6746      (∀ (S : Config) (T : Nat),
       6747        (RA → RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T) ↔ RHUnicorn.UnicornAt S onLine ht T) ∧
       6748      (∀ (Z : ActualZeros) (T : Nat), RHUnicorn.UnicornAt Z.zeros onLine ht T) ∧
       6749      (∀ Z : ActualZeros, ¬ ∃ p, Z.zeros p ∧ ¬ onLine p) :=
       6750    ⟨the_cut_on_the_chart, no_bypass_on_the_chart, unicorn_blocked_on_the_chart,
       6751     ra_supplies_nothing_to_the_unicorn, the_unicorn_closed_on_the_act, no_arrival_off_the_line_on_the_act⟩
       6752  
       6753  end RememberedOffered

       6804  /-- info: 'RememberedOffered.no_bypass_on_the_chart' does not depend on any axioms -/
       6805  #guard_msgs in #print axioms RememberedOffered.no_bypass_on_the_chart
       6806  /-- info: 'RememberedOffered.ra_supplies_nothing_to_the_unicorn' does not depend on any axioms -/
       6807  #guard_msgs in #print axioms RememberedOffered.ra_supplies_nothing_to_the_unicorn
       6808  /-- info: 'RememberedOffered.the_unicorn_closed_on_the_act' does not depend on any axioms -/
       6809  #guard_msgs in #print axioms RememberedOffered.the_unicorn_closed_on_the_act
       6810  /-- info: 'RememberedOffered.no_arrival_off_the_line_on_the_act' does not depend on any axioms -/
       6811  #guard_msgs in #print axioms RememberedOffered.no_arrival_off_the_line_on_the_act
