       7903  /-! # PART IV-c · the time kernel of the monism-fixed codex, verbatim, with the judge probe -/
       7904  section PartIVc
       7905  /-
       7906    The time kernel of the monism-fixed codex, carried verbatim: Codex.lean of the Master Codex v5.1.0 with the patch of
       7907    APEX-PSP-MONISM-FIXED-01 applied (patched sha256 22d908f7d3d2c96b…), its two TimeLocus sections, lines 7875 to 7947,
       7908    followed by the judge probe of this edition. Nothing in the carried lines is changed. The carried chart reads real
       7909    parts as the first edition's chart does at resolution one, x = 2·Re s, with heights in ℤ, and its counter-world's
       7910    off-line pair sits at x = 0 and 2, Re s = 0 and 1;
       7911    the judge probe states the same test on the offset chart inside the open strip, with the conjugate symmetry and the
       7912    empty low band, its off-line zeros at Re s = 1/4 and 3/4. Two names in a carried docstring,
       7913    `not_constructible_off_line` and `monism_witness_fails_in_counter_world`, are theorems of the patched codex outside
       7914    the carried lines; they are not in this seed and nothing here uses them.
       7915  -/
       7916  namespace TimeLocus
       7917  
       7918  def onLine (p : Int × Int) : Prop := p.1 = 1
       7919  
       7920  /-- A timed world: the locus at each time, and the zeros present at each time. -/
       7921  structure World where
       7922    locus : Nat → (Int × Int → Prop)
       7923    zeros : Nat → (Int × Int → Prop)
       7924  
       7925  /-- TIME PSP premise: prior and posterior locus are the SAME locus, the line, at every time. -/
       7926  def SameLocus (W : World) : Prop := ∀ t p, W.locus t p ↔ onLine p
       7927  
       7928  /-- The claim to be tested: every zero at every time is bound to the locus. -/
       7929  def Bound (W : World) : Prop := ∀ t p, W.zeros t p → W.locus t p
       7930  
       7931  /-- Fold-invariance at every time: the functional equation acts at each iteration. -/
       7932  def FoldInv (W : World) : Prop := ∀ t p, W.zeros t p → W.zeros t (2 - p.1, p.2)
       7933  
       7934  /-- 51. Given the same locus at all times, being bound IS the line property at all times. -/
       7935  theorem bound_iff_line (W : World) (h : SameLocus W) :
       7936      Bound W ↔ ∀ t p, W.zeros t p → onLine p :=
       7937    ⟨fun b t p z => (h t p).mp (b t p z), fun l t p z => (h t p).mpr (l t p z)⟩
       7938  
       7939  /-- 52, the test world. A world where the locus is the same line at every time, the fold acts at every
       7940      time, the on-line zero recurs at every time, and a mirror pair sits off the line at every time. -/
       7941  def testWorld : World :=
       7942    ⟨fun _ p => onLine p, fun _ p => p = (1, 0) ∨ p = (0, 5) ∨ p = (2, 5)⟩
       7943  
       7944  theorem test_same_locus : SameLocus testWorld := fun _ _ => Iff.rfl
       7945  
       7946  theorem test_fold_inv : FoldInv testWorld := by
       7947    intro _ p hp
       7948    rcases hp with h | h | h <;> subst h
       7949    · exact Or.inl rfl
       7950    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
       7951    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
       7952  
       7953  theorem test_not_bound : ¬ Bound testWorld := fun b => by
       7954    have := b 0 (0, 5) (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)); cases this
       7955  
       7956  /-- 52. Therefore SameLocus and FoldInv, at every time, do not imply Bound. -/
       7957  theorem time_does_not_bind :
       7958      ¬ ∀ W : World, SameLocus W → FoldInv W → Bound W :=
       7959    fun h => test_not_bound (h testWorld test_same_locus test_fold_inv)
       7960  
       7961  end TimeLocus
       7962  
       7963  namespace TimeLocus
       7964  
       7965  /-- Residual Monism read as the Codex states it: one involution serves both routes. -/
       7966  def sigmaGeo (p : Int × Int) : Int × Int := (2 - p.1, p.2)
       7967  def sigmaForm (p : Int × Int) : Int × Int := (2 - p.1, p.2)
       7968  def OneInvolution : Prop := ∀ p, sigmaGeo p = sigmaForm p
       7969  
       7970  /-- Residual Monism read as timeless: whether the zeros sit on the locus does not vary in time. -/
       7971  def P (W : World) (t : Nat) : Prop := ∀ p, W.zeros t p → onLine p
       7972  def Timeless (W : World) : Prop := ∀ t s, P W t ↔ P W s
       7973  
       7974  /-- 53. The seedless reading holds in the counter-world: one involution by rfl, and timelessness
       7975      because the property "all zeros on the line" is constantly false there. Timeless and unbound.
       7976      This is not monism. The monism witness carries its seed, and in the counter-world it fails
       7977      (`not_constructible_off_line`, `monism_witness_fails_in_counter_world`). -/
       7978  theorem seedless_reading_holds_in_counter_world :
       7979      OneInvolution ∧ Timeless testWorld ∧ ¬ Bound testWorld :=
       7980    ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl, test_not_bound⟩
       7981  
       7982  /-- 54. What timeless monism does do: it makes one instant decide all time. With the seed, binding
       7983      follows; the seed is "every zero present at the instant is on the line". -/
       7984  theorem timeless_with_seed_binds (W : World) (h : SameLocus W) (u : Timeless W) (s0 : P W 0) :
       7985      Bound W :=
       7986    (bound_iff_line W h).mpr (fun t p z => ((u 0 t).mp s0) p z)
       7987  
       7988  end TimeLocus
       7989  
       7990  namespace Judge
       7991  open TimeLocus
       7992  /-- The identical locus, the fold at every time, one involution and timelessness together do not exclude a zero off
       7993      the line: the counter-world carries all four. -/
       7994  theorem identical_locus_does_not_exclude :
       7995      ¬ ∀ W : World, SameLocus W → FoldInv W → OneInvolution → Timeless W → Bound W :=
       7996    fun h => test_not_bound (h testWorld test_same_locus test_fold_inv (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl))
       7997  /-- What does exclude it: on the same locus and timeless, being bound is exactly the seed at time zero. -/
       7998  theorem the_seed_is_exactly_what_binds (W : World) (h : SameLocus W) (u : Timeless W) : Bound W ↔ P W 0 :=
       7999    ⟨fun b => fun p z => ((bound_iff_line W h).mp b) 0 p z, fun s0 => timeless_with_seed_binds W h u s0⟩
       8000  
       8001  /-- The same test on the offset chart, d = 8·Re s − 4, inside the open strip: at every time the line occupied at every
       8002      height |t| ≥ 14, and one mirrored pair at Re s = 1/4 and 3/4 at height 3·10¹² + 1 with its conjugate. -/
       8003  def offsetWorld (_ : Nat) (p : RememberedOffered.Point) : Prop :=
       8004    (p.1 = 0 ∧ (14 ≤ p.2 ∨ p.2 ≤ -14)) ∨ p = (2, 3000000000001) ∨ p = (-2, 3000000000001) ∨
       8005      p = (2, -3000000000001) ∨ p = (-2, -3000000000001)
       8006  /-- Bound on the offset chart: every zero at every time on the line, the same locus at every time. -/
       8007  def BoundO (Z : Nat → RememberedOffered.Config) : Prop := ∀ t p, Z t p → RememberedOffered.onLine p
       8008  /-- Timeless on the offset chart: whether every zero sits on the line does not vary in time. -/
       8009  def TimelessO (Z : Nat → RememberedOffered.Config) : Prop :=
       8010    ∀ t s, (∀ p, Z t p → RememberedOffered.onLine p) ↔ (∀ p, Z s p → RememberedOffered.onLine p)
       8011  
       8012  /-- THE IDENTICAL LOCUS INSIDE THE STRIP DOES NOT EXCLUDE: on the offset chart, the same locus at every time, the fold
       8013      and conjugation at every time, the empty low band, every zero strictly inside the strip (Re s strictly between 0
       8014      and 1) and timelessness hold together on a world that is not bound; and on every timeless world being bound is
       8015      exactly the seed at time zero. -/
       8016  theorem identical_locus_inside_the_strip_does_not_exclude :
       8017      (∀ t, RememberedOffered.Closed (offsetWorld t)) ∧
       8018      (∀ t p, offsetWorld t p → offsetWorld t (p.1, -p.2)) ∧
       8019      (∀ t p, offsetWorld t p → 14 ≤ p.2 ∨ p.2 ≤ -14) ∧
       8020      (∀ t p, offsetWorld t p → -4 < p.1 ∧ p.1 < 4) ∧
       8021      TimelessO offsetWorld ∧ ¬ BoundO offsetWorld ∧
       8022      (∀ Z : Nat → RememberedOffered.Config, TimelessO Z →
       8023        (BoundO Z ↔ ∀ p, Z 0 p → RememberedOffered.onLine p)) := by
       8024    refine ⟨fun t p hp => ?_, fun t p hp => ?_, fun t p hp => ?_, fun t p hp => ?_, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
       8025    · unfold offsetWorld at hp ⊢
       8026      rcases hp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8027      · exact Or.inl ⟨show -p.1 = 0 by omega, h2⟩
       8028      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide)))
       8029      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide))
       8030      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (by decide))))
       8031      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide))))
       8032    · unfold offsetWorld at hp ⊢
       8033      rcases hp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8034      · exact Or.inl ⟨h1, by omega⟩
       8035      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide))))
       8036      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (by decide))))
       8037      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide))
       8038      · subst h; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide)))
       8039    · unfold offsetWorld at hp
       8040      rcases hp with ⟨_, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8041      · exact h2
       8042      all_goals (subst h; decide)
       8043    · unfold offsetWorld at hp
       8044      rcases hp with ⟨h1, _⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8045      · constructor <;> omega
       8046      all_goals (subst h; decide)
       8047    · intro b
       8048      have h : (2 : Int) = 0 := b 0 (2, 3000000000001) (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
       8049      exact absurd h (by decide)
       8050    · intro Z u
       8051      exact ⟨fun b => b 0, fun s0 t p z => ((u 0 t).mp s0) p z⟩
       8052  end Judge
       8053  
       8054  end PartIVc
       8055  
       8056  /-! # PART V · the arrow-side test -/
       8057  section PartV
       8058  /-
       8059    ARROW SIDE TEST · the ζ-specific facts, placed on RA's arrow, tested against an off-line pair.
       8060    Core Lean 4.19.0, no import, no axiom declared, no sorry.
       8061    Chart: x = 2W·Re s at resolution W, height t. The arrow's tail pole s = 0 sits at x = 0, its head pole s = 1 at
       8062    x = 2W, its hinge Re s = 1/2 at x = W. The Euler product lives beyond the head.
       8063    Each fact ζ has and the Davenport–Heilbronn shape lacks, or that is proved for ζ, enters as a predicate at its
       8064    place on the arrow, its source cited:
       8065      ENDS       Build and Edge: no zero at or beyond either pole (Euler product for Re s > 1; the prime number theorem's
       8066                 non-vanishing on Re s = 1; mirrored by the functional equation) [cited].
       8067      ZERO-FREE  near the head, and by the fold near the tail: at height t no zero within m t of a pole
       8068                 (de la Vallée Poussin; explicit constants Mossinghoff–Trudgian) [cited]; the margin is a parameter.
       8069      REAL PART  every zero up to height T0 on the line (Platt–Trudgian: every zero with 0 < Im s ≤ 3·10¹²) [cited];
       8070                 heights are read by their integer part, so chart height T0 = 3·10¹² − 1 reads Im s < 3·10¹².
       8071      FINITELY OFF  only finitely many zeros off the line: stronger than every positive-proportion theorem
       8072                 (Selberg, Levinson, Conrey) and every zero-density estimate [cited].
       8073  -/
       8074  set_option autoImplicit false
       8075  namespace ArrowSide
       8076  
       8077  abbrev Pt := Int × Int
       8078  
       8079  structure Chart where
       8080    W : Int
       8081    hW : 0 < W
       8082  
       8083  def onLine (C : Chart) (p : Pt) : Prop := p.1 = C.W
       8084  def fold (C : Chart) (p : Pt) : Pt := (2 * C.W - p.1, p.2)
       8085  def Closed (C : Chart) (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → S (fold C p)
       8086  def Value (C : Chart) (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → onLine C p
       8087  
       8088  def ArrowEnds (C : Chart) (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → 0 < p.1 ∧ p.1 < 2 * C.W
       8089  def ZeroFree (C : Chart) (m : Int → Int) (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop :=
       8090    ∀ p, S p → m p.2 < p.1 ∧ p.1 < 2 * C.W - m p.2
       8091  def RealPart (C : Chart) (T0 : Int) (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → p.2 ≤ T0 → onLine C p
       8092  def FinitelyOff (C : Chart) (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∃ L : List Pt, ∀ p, S p → ¬ onLine C p → p ∈ L
       8093  
       8094  /-- The ζ-shaped world: a zero on the line at every height, and one mirrored pair at offset d, height H. -/
       8095  def zetaShaped (C : Chart) (d H : Int) : Pt → Prop :=
       8096    fun p => p.1 = C.W ∨ p = (C.W - d, H) ∨ p = (C.W + d, H)
       8097  
       8098  theorem shaped_closed (C : Chart) (d H : Int) : Closed C (zetaShaped C d H) := by
       8099    intro p hp
       8100    unfold zetaShaped at hp ⊢
       8101    rcases hp with h | h | h
       8102    · left; show 2 * C.W - p.1 = C.W; omega
       8103    · subst h; right; right; exact Prod.ext (show 2 * C.W - (C.W - d) = C.W + d by omega) rfl
       8104    · subst h; right; left; exact Prod.ext (show 2 * C.W - (C.W + d) = C.W - d by omega) rfl
       8105  
       8106  theorem shaped_ends (C : Chart) (d H : Int) (hd : 0 < d) (hdW : d < C.W) : ArrowEnds C (zetaShaped C d H) := by
       8107    have hW := C.hW
       8108    intro p hp
       8109    unfold zetaShaped at hp
       8110    rcases hp with h | h | h
       8111    · constructor <;> omega
       8112    · subst h; show 0 < C.W - d ∧ C.W - d < 2 * C.W; constructor <;> omega
       8113    · subst h; show 0 < C.W + d ∧ C.W + d < 2 * C.W; constructor <;> omega
       8114  
       8115  theorem shaped_zero_free (C : Chart) (m : Int → Int) (hm : ∀ t, m t < C.W) (d H : Int) (hmH : m H < C.W - d)
       8116      (hd : 0 < d) : ZeroFree C m (zetaShaped C d H) := by
       8117    intro p hp
       8118    unfold zetaShaped at hp
       8119    rcases hp with h | h | h
       8120    · have := hm p.2; constructor <;> omega
       8121    · subst h; show m H < C.W - d ∧ C.W - d < 2 * C.W - m H; constructor <;> omega
       8122    · subst h; show m H < C.W + d ∧ C.W + d < 2 * C.W - m H; constructor <;> omega
       8123  
       8124  theorem shaped_real_part (C : Chart) (T0 d H : Int) (hH : T0 < H) : RealPart C T0 (zetaShaped C d H) := by
       8125    intro p hp ht
       8126    unfold zetaShaped at hp
       8127    rcases hp with h | h | h
       8128    · exact h
       8129    · subst h; have : H ≤ T0 := ht; exfalso; omega
       8130    · subst h; have : H ≤ T0 := ht; exfalso; omega
       8131  
       8132  theorem shaped_finitely_off (C : Chart) (d H : Int) : FinitelyOff C (zetaShaped C d H) := by
       8133    refine ⟨[(C.W - d, H), (C.W + d, H)], fun p hp hoff => ?_⟩
       8134    unfold zetaShaped at hp
       8135    rcases hp with h | h | h
       8136    · exact absurd h hoff
       8137    · subst h; exact List.Mem.head _
       8138    · subst h; exact List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.head _)
       8139  
       8140  theorem shaped_lacks_value (C : Chart) (d H : Int) (hd : 0 < d) : ¬ Value C (zetaShaped C d H) := by
       8141    intro hv
       8142    have h2 : C.W - d = C.W := hv (C.W - d, H) (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
       8143    omega
       8144  
       8145  /-- THE ARROW SIDE TEST. Every ζ-specific fact placed on the arrow (ends, zero-free region, real part to T0,
       8146      finitely many off the line) holds on a world with a mirrored pair off the line above T0, so together they do
       8147      not force the value. -/
       8148  theorem arrow_side_test (C : Chart) (m : Int → Int) (hm : ∀ t, m t < C.W) (T0 d H : Int)
       8149      (hd : 0 < d) (hdW : d < C.W) (hH : T0 < H) (hmH : m H < C.W - d) :
       8150      Closed C (zetaShaped C d H) ∧ ArrowEnds C (zetaShaped C d H) ∧ ZeroFree C m (zetaShaped C d H) ∧
       8151      RealPart C T0 (zetaShaped C d H) ∧ FinitelyOff C (zetaShaped C d H) ∧ ¬ Value C (zetaShaped C d H) :=
       8152    ⟨shaped_closed C d H, shaped_ends C d H hd hdW, shaped_zero_free C m hm d H hmH hd,
       8153     shaped_real_part C T0 d H hH, shaped_finitely_off C d H, shaped_lacks_value C d H hd⟩
       8154  
       8155  /-- THE FACTS ARE ζ-SPECIFIC AT THE ENDS: a zero beyond the head, the Davenport–Heilbronn shape, breaks ENDS. -/
       8156  theorem beyond_the_head_breaks_ends (C : Chart) (x t : Int) (hx : 2 * C.W ≤ x) :
       8157      ¬ ArrowEnds C (fun p => p = (x, t)) := by
       8158    intro h
       8159    have h2 : x < 2 * C.W := (h (x, t) rfl).2
       8160    omega
       8161  
       8162  /-- AT ζ'S OWN NUMBERS: resolution W = 4, so x = 8·Re s; the pair at Re s = 1/4 and 3/4 (x = 2 and 6); the
       8163      zero-free margin below one unit of 1/8 at every height where zeros occur (c/log t < 0.07 for t ≥ 14); the real
       8164      part to chart height T0 = 3·10¹² − 1, every zero with Im s < 3·10¹²; the pair two units of height above it. -/
       8165  def zetaChart : Chart := ⟨4, by decide⟩
       8166  theorem at_zetas_numbers :
       8167      Closed zetaChart (zetaShaped zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8168      ArrowEnds zetaChart (zetaShaped zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8169      ZeroFree zetaChart (fun _ => 0) (zetaShaped zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8170      RealPart zetaChart 2999999999999 (zetaShaped zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8171      FinitelyOff zetaChart (zetaShaped zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8172      ¬ Value zetaChart (zetaShaped zetaChart 2 3000000000001) :=
       8173    arrow_side_test zetaChart (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => show (0 : Int) < 4 by decide) 2999999999999 2 3000000000001
       8174      (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
       8175  
       8176  /-! ## The faithful model: the facts of ζ with its two symmetries and its empty low band -/
       8177  
       8178  /-- Conjugate symmetry: the zero set is closed under t ↦ −t. -/
       8179  def ConjClosed (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → S (p.1, -p.2)
       8180  /-- No zero below height 14 in absolute value: ζ's first zero lies at height 14.13… [cited]; heights read by their
       8181      integer part, chart height 14 holds Im s in [14, 15). -/
       8182  def NoLowZeros (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → 14 ≤ p.2 ∨ p.2 ≤ -14
       8183  /-- The verification in both half-planes: every zero at chart height |t| ≤ T0 is on the line; at T0 = 3·10¹² − 1,
       8184      every zero with |Im s| < 3·10¹² [Platt–Trudgian, cited]. -/
       8185  def RealPartAbs (C : Chart) (T0 : Int) (S : Pt → Prop) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → p.2 ≤ T0 → -T0 ≤ p.2 → onLine C p
       8186  /-- The zero-free margin, in units of 1/(2W): the whole width below |t| = 14, where ζ has no zero, and no unit at
       8187      every height |t| ≥ 14. At every width it holds of ζ's reading, since it adds nothing to the ends there and the
       8188      reader's rule keeps every zero of the open strip inside the open chart strip; at the widths W ≤ 7 it is the
       8189      region at full strength, since c/log t < 0.07 < 1/(2W). `faithful_every_margin` carries the region at every
       8190      width, one unit short for the rounding. -/
       8191  def margin14 (C : Chart) : Int → Int := fun t => if 14 ≤ t ∨ t ≤ -14 then 0 else C.W
       8192  /-- The faithful ζ-shaped world: a zero on the line at every height |t| ≥ 14, and one mirrored pair at offset d at
       8193      heights H and −H. -/
       8194  def zetaFaithful (C : Chart) (d H : Int) : Pt → Prop := fun p =>
       8195    (p.1 = C.W ∧ (14 ≤ p.2 ∨ p.2 ≤ -14)) ∨ p = (C.W - d, H) ∨ p = (C.W + d, H) ∨
       8196      p = (C.W - d, -H) ∨ p = (C.W + d, -H)
       8197  
       8198  theorem faithful_arrow_side_test (C : Chart) (T0 d H : Int) (hd : 0 < d) (hdW : d < C.W) (hH : T0 < H)
       8199      (h14 : 14 ≤ H) :
       8200      Closed C (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ ConjClosed (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ ArrowEnds C (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧
       8201      ZeroFree C (margin14 C) (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ NoLowZeros (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧
       8202      RealPartAbs C T0 (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ FinitelyOff C (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧
       8203      ¬ Value C (zetaFaithful C d H) := by
       8204    have hW := C.hW
       8205    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
       8206    · intro p hp
       8207      unfold zetaFaithful at hp ⊢
       8208      rcases hp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8209      · left; exact ⟨show 2 * C.W - p.1 = C.W by omega, h2⟩
       8210      · subst h; right; right; left; exact Prod.ext (show 2 * C.W - (C.W - d) = C.W + d by omega) rfl
       8211      · subst h; right; left; exact Prod.ext (show 2 * C.W - (C.W + d) = C.W - d by omega) rfl
       8212      · subst h; right; right; right; right; exact Prod.ext (show 2 * C.W - (C.W - d) = C.W + d by omega) rfl
       8213      · subst h; right; right; right; left; exact Prod.ext (show 2 * C.W - (C.W + d) = C.W - d by omega) rfl
       8214    · intro p hp
       8215      unfold zetaFaithful at hp ⊢
       8216      rcases hp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8217      · left; exact ⟨h1, show 14 ≤ -p.2 ∨ -p.2 ≤ -14 by omega⟩
       8218      · subst h; right; right; right; left; rfl
       8219      · subst h; right; right; right; right; rfl
       8220      · subst h; right; left; exact Prod.ext rfl (show -(-H) = H by omega)
       8221      · subst h; right; right; left; exact Prod.ext rfl (show -(-H) = H by omega)
       8222    · intro p hp
       8223      unfold zetaFaithful at hp
       8224      rcases hp with ⟨h1, _⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8225      · constructor <;> omega
       8226      all_goals (subst h; constructor <;> (show (_ : Int) < _; omega))
       8227    · intro p hp
       8228      unfold zetaFaithful at hp
       8229      unfold margin14
       8230      rcases hp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8231      · rw [if_pos h2]; constructor <;> omega
       8232      · subst h; rw [if_pos (Or.inl h14)]; show (0 : Int) < C.W - d ∧ C.W - d < 2 * C.W - 0; constructor <;> omega
       8233      · subst h; rw [if_pos (Or.inl h14)]; show (0 : Int) < C.W + d ∧ C.W + d < 2 * C.W - 0; constructor <;> omega
       8234      · subst h; rw [if_pos (Or.inr (show -H ≤ -14 by omega))]
       8235        show (0 : Int) < C.W - d ∧ C.W - d < 2 * C.W - 0; constructor <;> omega
       8236      · subst h; rw [if_pos (Or.inr (show -H ≤ -14 by omega))]
       8237        show (0 : Int) < C.W + d ∧ C.W + d < 2 * C.W - 0; constructor <;> omega
       8238    · intro p hp
       8239      unfold zetaFaithful at hp
       8240      rcases hp with ⟨_, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8241      · exact h2
       8242      · subst h; exact Or.inl h14
       8243      · subst h; exact Or.inl h14
       8244      · subst h; exact Or.inr (show -H ≤ -14 by omega)
       8245      · subst h; exact Or.inr (show -H ≤ -14 by omega)
       8246    · intro p hp ht1 ht2
       8247      unfold zetaFaithful at hp
       8248      rcases hp with ⟨h1, _⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8249      · exact h1
       8250      · subst h; have : H ≤ T0 := ht1; exfalso; omega
       8251      · subst h; have : H ≤ T0 := ht1; exfalso; omega
       8252      · subst h; have : -T0 ≤ -H := ht2; exfalso; omega
       8253      · subst h; have : -T0 ≤ -H := ht2; exfalso; omega
       8254    · refine ⟨[(C.W - d, H), (C.W + d, H), (C.W - d, -H), (C.W + d, -H)], fun p hp hoff => ?_⟩
       8255      unfold zetaFaithful at hp
       8256      rcases hp with ⟨h1, _⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8257      · exact absurd h1 hoff
       8258      · subst h; exact List.Mem.head _
       8259      · subst h; exact List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.head _)
       8260      · subst h; exact List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.head _))
       8261      · subst h; exact List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.head _)))
       8262    · intro hv
       8263      have h2 : C.W - d = C.W := hv (C.W - d, H) (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
       8264      omega
       8265  
       8266  /-- AT ζ'S OWN NUMBERS, FAITHFULLY: W = 4, so x = 8·Re s; the pair at Re s = 1/4 and 3/4 at height 3·10¹² + 1 and
       8267      its conjugate at −(3·10¹² + 1); the line occupied at every |t| ≥ 14; the verification, every zero with
       8268      |Im s| < 3·10¹², at chart height 3·10¹² − 1 in both half-planes. -/
       8269  theorem at_zetas_numbers_faithful :
       8270      Closed zetaChart (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8271      ConjClosed (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8272      ArrowEnds zetaChart (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8273      ZeroFree zetaChart (margin14 zetaChart) (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8274      NoLowZeros (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8275      RealPartAbs zetaChart 2999999999999 (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8276      FinitelyOff zetaChart (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) ∧
       8277      ¬ Value zetaChart (zetaFaithful zetaChart 2 3000000000001) :=
       8278    faithful_arrow_side_test zetaChart 2999999999999 2 3000000000001 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
       8279  
       8280  /-- THE FAITHFUL MODEL UNDER EVERY ZERO-FREE MARGIN: at every chart width and for every margin that, at the heights
       8281      where zeros occur, stays short of the line and leaves the off-line quadruple outside it at ±H, the facts hold on
       8282      the faithful world and the value fails. ζ's known region, c/log|t| in Re s with c/log 14 < 0.07 and
       8283      c/log(3·10¹²) < 0.0065, read in units of 1/(2W), is such a margin at every width for the pair at Re s = 1/4 and
       8284      3/4 [Mossinghoff–Trudgian 2015, cited]. -/
       8285  theorem faithful_every_margin (C : Chart) (m : Int → Int) (T0 d H : Int) (hd : 0 < d) (hdW : d < C.W)
       8286      (hH : T0 < H) (h14 : 14 ≤ H) (hm : ∀ t, (14 ≤ t ∨ t ≤ -14) → m t < C.W)
       8287      (hmH : m H < C.W - d) (hmH' : m (-H) < C.W - d) :
       8288      Closed C (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ ConjClosed (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ ArrowEnds C (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧
       8289      ZeroFree C m (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ NoLowZeros (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧
       8290      RealPartAbs C T0 (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧ FinitelyOff C (zetaFaithful C d H) ∧
       8291      ¬ Value C (zetaFaithful C d H) := by
       8292    have base := faithful_arrow_side_test C T0 d H hd hdW hH h14
       8293    refine ⟨base.1, base.2.1, base.2.2.1, ?_, base.2.2.2.2.1, base.2.2.2.2.2.1, base.2.2.2.2.2.2.1,
       8294      base.2.2.2.2.2.2.2⟩
       8295    intro p hp
       8296    unfold zetaFaithful at hp
       8297    rcases hp with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | h | h | h | h
       8298    · have := hm p.2 h2; constructor <;> omega
       8299    · subst h; show m H < C.W - d ∧ C.W - d < 2 * C.W - m H; constructor <;> omega
       8300    · subst h; show m H < C.W + d ∧ C.W + d < 2 * C.W - m H; constructor <;> omega
       8301    · subst h; show m (-H) < C.W - d ∧ C.W - d < 2 * C.W - m (-H); constructor <;> omega
       8302    · subst h; show m (-H) < C.W + d ∧ C.W + d < 2 * C.W - m (-H); constructor <;> omega
       8303  
       8304  /-- AT WIDTH ONE THE ENDS ARE THE VALUE: the open strip holds only the line, so the placed ends force the value there,
       8305      as at the first edition's resolution one; the faithful model needs a width of at least two. -/
       8306  theorem at_width_one_the_ends_are_the_value (S : Pt → Prop) :
       8307      ArrowEnds ⟨1, by decide⟩ S ↔ Value ⟨1, by decide⟩ S := by
       8308    constructor
       8309    · intro h p hp
       8310      have := h p hp
       8311      show p.1 = 1
       8312      have h1 : 0 < p.1 ∧ p.1 < 2 * 1 := this
       8313      omega
       8314    · intro h p hp
       8315      have h1 : p.1 = 1 := h p hp
       8316      show 0 < p.1 ∧ p.1 < 2 * 1
       8317      omega
       8318  
       8319  /-- AN OFF-LINE ZERO COMES IN FOUR: in a world closed under the reflection and under conjugation, with no zero below
       8320      height 14, a zero off the line brings its mirror, its conjugate and its conjugate's mirror, four distinct points:
       8321      one mirrored pair and its conjugate. -/
       8322  theorem an_off_line_zero_comes_in_four (C : Chart) (S : Pt → Prop) (hc : Closed C S) (hk : ConjClosed S)
       8323      (hl : NoLowZeros S) (p : Pt) (hp : S p) (hoff : ¬ onLine C p) :
       8324      S (fold C p) ∧ S (p.1, -p.2) ∧ S (fold C (p.1, -p.2)) ∧
       8325      fold C p ≠ p ∧ (p.1, -p.2) ≠ p ∧ fold C (p.1, -p.2) ≠ p ∧
       8326      (p.1, -p.2) ≠ fold C p ∧ fold C (p.1, -p.2) ≠ fold C p ∧ fold C (p.1, -p.2) ≠ (p.1, -p.2) := by
       8327    have h14 := hl p hp
       8328    refine ⟨hc p hp, hk p hp, hc _ (hk p hp), ?_⟩
       8329    obtain ⟨x, t⟩ := p
       8330    have hx : x ≠ C.W := hoff
       8331    have ht : 14 ≤ t ∨ t ≤ -14 := h14
       8332    refine ⟨fun e => ?_, fun e => ?_, fun e => ?_, fun e => ?_, fun e => ?_, fun e => ?_⟩
       8333    · have h1 : 2 * C.W - x = x := congrArg Prod.fst e
       8334      omega
       8335    · have h2 : -t = t := congrArg Prod.snd e
       8336      omega
       8337    · have h2 : -t = t := congrArg Prod.snd e
       8338      omega
       8339    · have h2 : -t = t := congrArg Prod.snd e
       8340      omega
       8341    · have h2 : -t = t := congrArg Prod.snd e
       8342      omega
       8343    · have h1 : 2 * C.W - x = x := congrArg Prod.fst e
       8344      omega
       8345  
       8346  end ArrowSide
       8347  
       8348  
       8349  end PartV
       8350  
       8351  /-! # PART V-b · the charts are one -/
       8352  section PartVb
       8353  /-
       8354    THE CHARTS ARE ONE. The seed reads the critical line on five charts: Part II's at x = 2n·Re s for every resolution n
       8355    (x = 2·Re s at resolution one, x = 4·Re s at resolution two), heights in ℕ; Part IV's at x = 4·Re s; Part IV-c's at
       8356    x = 2·Re s, heights in ℤ; Part V's at x = 2W·Re s for every width W; and the offset chart of Parts III and IV-b,
       8357    d = 2n·Re s − n at resolution n, whose line d = 0 and fold d ↦ −d are the same at every resolution. Each maps into
       8358    the offset chart at a definite resolution by an equivariant map, one that carries the chart's fold to the offset
       8359    fold and the chart's line to the offset line: the maps of Parts II at resolutions one and two, IV, IV-c and V at
       8360    width four land at resolution four, where one real part read on any of them lands at one offset point; the maps
       8361    at resolution n and width W land at resolution n and W. Every map keeps the chart's height and scales the offset
       8362    from the line by a positive factor; the maps out of the charts with heights in ℤ commute with conjugation, and
       8363    the first edition's chart reads the upper half-plane. Transport carries
       8364    reflection-closure and the value across. Every act type of the seed is an act of the offset chart at the image of
       8365    its zero set; the root read at the zeros on Part II's chart is the root read twice at the image; both constructed
       8366    roots, Part I's and Part II's, feed the closing theorems. The zero set of ζ is read on the offset chart at every
       8367    resolution by the reader's rule, and the act supplies least erasure at every resolution.
       8368  -/
       8369  set_option autoImplicit false
       8370  namespace Charts
       8371  
       8372  /-- The image of a configuration under a chart map into the offset chart. -/
       8373  def img {α : Type} (φ : α → RememberedOffered.Point) (S : α → Prop) : RememberedOffered.Config :=
       8374    fun q => ∃ p, S p ∧ φ p = q
       8375  
       8376  /-- A chart map is equivariant when it carries the chart's fold to the offset fold and the chart's line to the
       8377      offset line. -/
       8378  structure Equivariant {α : Type} (fold : α → α) (onLine : α → Prop) (φ : α → RememberedOffered.Point) : Prop where
       8379    comm : ∀ p, φ (fold p) = RememberedOffered.fold (φ p)
       8380    line : ∀ p, RememberedOffered.onLine (φ p) ↔ onLine p
       8381  
       8382  /-- TRANSPORT: an equivariant map carries reflection-closure across, and the value both ways. -/
       8383  theorem transport {α : Type} {fold : α → α} {onLine : α → Prop} {φ : α → RememberedOffered.Point}
       8384      (E : Equivariant fold onLine φ) (S : α → Prop) :
       8385      ((∀ p, S p → S (fold p)) → RememberedOffered.Closed (img φ S)) ∧
       8386      ((∀ p, S p → onLine p) ↔ RememberedOffered.Value (img φ S)) := by
       8387    refine ⟨fun hS q ⟨p, hp, e⟩ => ⟨fold p, hS p hp, by rw [E.comm, e]⟩,
       8388      ⟨fun hv q ⟨p, hp, e⟩ => ?_, fun hv p hp => (E.line p).mp (hv _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)⟩⟩
       8389    rw [← e]; exact (E.line p).mpr (hv p hp)
       8390  
       8391  /-- Part IV's chart, x = 4·Re s, into the offset chart d = 8·Re s − 4. -/
       8392  def φH (p : Hinge.Pt) : RememberedOffered.Point := (2 * p.1 - 4, p.2)
       8393  /-- Part V's chart at ζ's resolution, x = 8·Re s, into the offset chart. -/
       8394  def φA (p : ArrowSide.Pt) : RememberedOffered.Point := (p.1 - 4, p.2)
       8395  /-- Part II's chart, x = 2·Re s with heights in ℕ, into the offset chart. -/
       8396  def φP (z : PrimeFreedom.Pt) : RememberedOffered.Point := (4 * z.x - 4, (z.t : Int))
       8397  /-- Part II's chart at resolution two, x = 4·Re s, into the offset chart. -/
       8398  def φP₂ (z : PrimeFreedom.Pt) : RememberedOffered.Point := (2 * z.x - 4, (z.t : Int))
       8399  /-- Part V's chart at every width W, x = 2W·Re s, into the offset chart at resolution W: d = x − W. -/
       8400  def φW (C : ArrowSide.Chart) (p : ArrowSide.Pt) : RememberedOffered.Point := (p.1 - C.W, p.2)
       8401  /-- Part II's chart at every resolution n, x = 2n·Re s with heights in ℕ, into the offset chart at resolution n. -/
       8402  def φPn (n : Int) (z : PrimeFreedom.Pt) : RememberedOffered.Point := (z.x - n, (z.t : Int))
       8403  /-- Part IV-c's chart, x = 2·Re s with heights in ℤ, into the offset chart. -/
       8404  def φT (p : Int × Int) : RememberedOffered.Point := (4 * p.1 - 4, p.2)
       8405  /-- Part IV-b's chart is the offset chart: the identity. -/
       8406  def φF (p : ForceWitness.Point) : RememberedOffered.Point := p
       8407  
       8408  theorem eqH : Equivariant Hinge.fold Hinge.onLine φH :=
       8409    ⟨fun p => Prod.ext (show 2 * (0 + 4 - p.1) - 4 = -(2 * p.1 - 4) by omega) rfl,
       8410     fun p => show 2 * p.1 - 4 = 0 ↔ p.1 = 2 by omega⟩
       8411  theorem eqA : Equivariant (ArrowSide.fold ArrowSide.zetaChart) (ArrowSide.onLine ArrowSide.zetaChart) φA :=
       8412    ⟨fun p => Prod.ext (show 2 * 4 - p.1 - 4 = -(p.1 - 4) by omega) rfl,
       8413     fun p => show p.1 - 4 = 0 ↔ p.1 = 4 by omega⟩
       8414  theorem eqP : Equivariant PrimeFreedom.fold PrimeFreedom.onLine φP :=
       8415    ⟨fun z => Prod.ext (show 4 * (2 - z.x) - 4 = -(4 * z.x - 4) by omega) rfl,
       8416     fun z => show 4 * z.x - 4 = 0 ↔ z.x = 1 by omega⟩
       8417  theorem eqP₂ : Equivariant PrimeFreedom.fold₂ PrimeFreedom.onLine₂ φP₂ :=
       8418    ⟨fun z => Prod.ext (show 2 * (4 - z.x) - 4 = -(2 * z.x - 4) by omega) rfl,
       8419     fun z => show 2 * z.x - 4 = 0 ↔ z.x = 2 by omega⟩
       8420  theorem eqW (C : ArrowSide.Chart) : Equivariant (ArrowSide.fold C) (ArrowSide.onLine C) (φW C) :=
       8421    ⟨fun p => Prod.ext (show 2 * C.W - p.1 - C.W = -(p.1 - C.W) by omega) rfl,
       8422     fun p => show p.1 - C.W = 0 ↔ p.1 = C.W by omega⟩
       8423  theorem eqPn (n : Int) : Equivariant (PrimeFreedom.foldAt n) (fun z => z.x = n) (φPn n) :=
       8424    ⟨fun z => Prod.ext (show 2 * n - z.x - n = -(z.x - n) by omega) rfl,
       8425     fun z => show z.x - n = 0 ↔ z.x = n by omega⟩
       8426  theorem eqT : Equivariant TimeLocus.sigmaGeo TimeLocus.onLine φT :=
       8427    ⟨fun p => Prod.ext (show 4 * (2 - p.1) - 4 = -(4 * p.1 - 4) by omega) rfl,
       8428     fun p => show 4 * p.1 - 4 = 0 ↔ p.1 = 1 by omega⟩
       8429  theorem eqF : Equivariant ForceWitness.fold ForceWitness.onLine φF :=
       8430    ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
       8431  
       8432  /-- EVERY MAP KEEPS HEIGHT AND SCALES THE OFFSET from the line by a positive factor. -/
       8433  theorem the_maps_keep_height_and_scale :
       8434      (∀ p : Hinge.Pt, φH p = (2 * (p.1 - 2), p.2)) ∧
       8435      (∀ p : ArrowSide.Pt, φA p = (1 * (p.1 - 4), p.2)) ∧
       8436      (∀ (C : ArrowSide.Chart) (p : ArrowSide.Pt), φW C p = (1 * (p.1 - C.W), p.2)) ∧
       8437      (∀ z : PrimeFreedom.Pt, φP z = (4 * (z.x - 1), (z.t : Int))) ∧
       8438      (∀ z : PrimeFreedom.Pt, φP₂ z = (2 * (z.x - 2), (z.t : Int))) ∧
       8439      (∀ (n : Int) (z : PrimeFreedom.Pt), φPn n z = (1 * (z.x - n), (z.t : Int))) ∧
       8440      (∀ p : Int × Int, φT p = (4 * (p.1 - 1), p.2)) ∧
       8441      (∀ p : ForceWitness.Point, φF p = (1 * (p.1 - 0), p.2)) :=
       8442    ⟨fun p => Prod.ext (show 2 * p.1 - 4 = 2 * (p.1 - 2) by omega) rfl,
       8443     fun p => Prod.ext (show p.1 - 4 = 1 * (p.1 - 4) by omega) rfl,
       8444     fun C p => Prod.ext (show p.1 - C.W = 1 * (p.1 - C.W) by omega) rfl,
       8445     fun z => Prod.ext (show 4 * z.x - 4 = 4 * (z.x - 1) by omega) rfl,
       8446     fun z => Prod.ext (show 2 * z.x - 4 = 2 * (z.x - 2) by omega) rfl,
       8447     fun n z => Prod.ext (show z.x - n = 1 * (z.x - n) by omega) rfl,
       8448     fun p => Prod.ext (show 4 * p.1 - 4 = 4 * (p.1 - 1) by omega) rfl,
       8449     fun p => Prod.ext (show p.1 = 1 * (p.1 - 0) by omega) rfl⟩
       8450  
       8451  /-- The first edition's act, carried to the offset chart at the image of its zero set. -/
       8452  def actP (A : PrimeFreedom.ActualZeros) : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros :=
       8453    ⟨img φP A.zeros, (transport eqP A.zeros).1 A.fold_closed,
       8454     (RememberedOffered.twins_on_every_world _).mpr ((transport eqP A.zeros).2.mp (PrimeFreedom.rh_from_the_act A))⟩
       8455  
       8456  /-- The first edition's act at every resolution n, carried to the offset chart at the image of its zero set. -/
       8457  def actPn (n : Int) (A : PrimeFreedom.ActualZerosAt n) : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros :=
       8458    ⟨img (φPn n) A.zeros, (transport (eqPn n) A.zeros).1 A.closed,
       8459     (RememberedOffered.twins_on_every_world _).mpr ((transport (eqPn n) A.zeros).2.mp
       8460       (fun z hz => (PrimeFreedom.foldAt_fixed_iff n z).mp (PrimeFreedom.rh_from_the_act_at n A z hz)))⟩
       8461  /-- Part IV's act, carried to the offset chart at the image of its zero set. -/
       8462  def actH (A : Hinge.ActualZeros) : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros :=
       8463    ⟨img φH A.zeros, (transport eqH A.zeros).1 A.closed,
       8464     (RememberedOffered.twins_on_every_world _).mpr ((transport eqH A.zeros).2.mp (Hinge.value_from_the_act A))⟩
       8465  /-- Part IV-b's act is an act of the offset chart as it stands. -/
       8466  def actF (A : ForceWitness.ActualZeros) : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros := ⟨A.zeros, A.closed, A.supply⟩
       8467  
       8468  /-- The constructed root of Part I, as the root the closing theorems of Part III take. -/
       8469  def rootOf {R : Prop} (G : TOE0.SelfGrounding R) : RememberedOffered.SelfGrounding R := ⟨G.Act, G.anAct, G.instances⟩
       8470  /-- Part II's self-grounding root, as the root the closing theorems of Part III take. -/
       8471  def rootP {R : Prop} (G : PrimeFreedom.SelfGrounding R) : RememberedOffered.SelfGrounding R :=
       8472    ⟨G.Act, G.anAct, G.instances⟩
       8473  
       8474  /-- THE CHARTS ARE ONE. Every plane chart of the seed maps equivariantly into the offset chart, at every resolution and every
       8475      width; the value of a configuration is the value of its image on every chart; every act type of the seed is an act
       8476      of the offset chart at the image of its zero set; the root read at the zeros on Part II's chart is the root read
       8477      twice at the image; and both constructed roots feed the closing theorems of Part III: Part I's forces no value,
       8478      and the deed of either is the supply at a zero set exactly where the value holds. -/
       8479  theorem the_charts_are_one :
       8480      Equivariant Hinge.fold Hinge.onLine φH ∧
       8481      Equivariant (ArrowSide.fold ArrowSide.zetaChart) (ArrowSide.onLine ArrowSide.zetaChart) φA ∧
       8482      Equivariant PrimeFreedom.fold PrimeFreedom.onLine φP ∧
       8483      Equivariant PrimeFreedom.fold₂ PrimeFreedom.onLine₂ φP₂ ∧
       8484      (∀ S : Hinge.Pt → Prop, Hinge.Value S ↔ RememberedOffered.Value (img φH S)) ∧
       8485      (∀ S : ArrowSide.Pt → Prop, ArrowSide.Value ArrowSide.zetaChart S ↔ RememberedOffered.Value (img φA S)) ∧
       8486      (∀ Z : PrimeFreedom.World, PrimeFreedom.RH Z ↔ RememberedOffered.Value (img φP Z)) ∧
       8487      (∀ A : PrimeFreedom.ActualZeros, ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = img φP A.zeros) ∧
       8488      (∀ Z : PrimeFreedom.World, PrimeFreedom.RootAtZeros Z ↔ RememberedOffered.RootReadTwice (img φP Z)) ∧
       8489      (¬ ∀ S : RememberedOffered.Config, RememberedOffered.Closed S → TOE0.RA₀ → RememberedOffered.Value S) ∧
       8490      (∀ S : RememberedOffered.Config, RememberedOffered.Closed S →
       8491        ((TOE0.ra₀.Act → ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = S) ↔ RememberedOffered.Value S)) ∧
       8492      (∀ C : ArrowSide.Chart, Equivariant (ArrowSide.fold C) (ArrowSide.onLine C) (φW C)) ∧
       8493      (∀ n : Int, Equivariant (PrimeFreedom.foldAt n) (fun z => z.x = n) (φPn n)) ∧
       8494      Equivariant TimeLocus.sigmaGeo TimeLocus.onLine φT ∧
       8495      Equivariant ForceWitness.fold ForceWitness.onLine φF ∧
       8496      (∀ (C : ArrowSide.Chart) (S : ArrowSide.Pt → Prop),
       8497        ArrowSide.Value C S ↔ RememberedOffered.Value (img (φW C) S)) ∧
       8498      (∀ (n : Int) (A : PrimeFreedom.ActualZerosAt n),
       8499        ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = img (φPn n) A.zeros) ∧
       8500      (∀ A : Hinge.ActualZeros, ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = img φH A.zeros) ∧
       8501      (∀ A : ForceWitness.ActualZeros, ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = A.zeros) ∧
       8502      (∀ (R : Prop) (G : PrimeFreedom.SelfGrounding R) (S : RememberedOffered.Config), RememberedOffered.Closed S →
       8503        (((rootP G).Act → ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = S) ↔ RememberedOffered.Value S)) :=
       8504    ⟨eqH, eqA, eqP, eqP₂,
       8505     fun S => (transport eqH S).2, fun S => (transport eqA S).2, fun Z => (transport eqP Z).2,
       8506     fun A => ⟨actP A, rfl⟩,
       8507     fun Z => ((PrimeFreedom.root_at_zeros_is_the_hypothesis Z).trans (transport eqP Z).2).trans
       8508       (RememberedOffered.the_root_read_twice_is_the_value _).symm,
       8509     RememberedOffered.the_floor_alone_decides_no_value (rootOf TOE0.ra₀),
       8510     fun S hS => (RememberedOffered.the_last_act (rootOf TOE0.ra₀) S hS).1,
       8511     eqW, eqPn, eqT, eqF, fun C S => (transport (eqW C) S).2,
       8512     fun n A => ⟨actPn n A, rfl⟩, fun A => ⟨actH A, rfl⟩, fun A => ⟨actF A, rfl⟩,
       8513     fun _ G S hS => (RememberedOffered.the_last_act (rootP G) S hS).1⟩
       8514  
       8515  /-- The model pair of the zero side: Re s = 3/4 at height 3·10¹² + 1 on the offset chart at resolution four (d = 2),
       8516      with its mirror at Re s = 1/4 (d = −2). -/
       8517  def thePair : RememberedOffered.Point := (2, 3000000000001)
       8518  
       8519  /-- THE ONE PAIR, READ BY EVERY INSTRUMENT, on the charts that hold it. On the offset chart it is closed, off the line, of one
       8520      record with its registered point, without the root read twice, and every report of it reads no act; its preimage
       8521      on Part IV's chart is centred on the line; its preimage on Part V's chart lies in the faithful ζ-shaped world,
       8522      which satisfies every fact of ζ placed on the arrow. -/
       8523  theorem the_pair_read_by_every_instrument :
       8524      RememberedOffered.Closed (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair) ∧
       8525      ¬ RememberedOffered.Value (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair) ∧
       8526      RememberedOffered.SameRecord (RememberedOffered.registered thePair) (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair) ∧
       8527      ¬ RememberedOffered.RootReadTwice (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair) ∧
       8528      (¬ ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, ∀ p ∈ [thePair, RememberedOffered.fold thePair], Z.zeros p) ∧
       8529      (φH (3, 3000000000001) = thePair ∧ φH (1, 3000000000001) = RememberedOffered.fold thePair ∧
       8530        Hinge.sumX [(1, 3000000000001), (3, 3000000000001)] = 2 * 2) ∧
       8531      (φA (6, 3000000000001) = thePair ∧ φA (2, 3000000000001) = RememberedOffered.fold thePair ∧
       8532        ArrowSide.zetaFaithful ArrowSide.zetaChart 2 3000000000001 (6, 3000000000001) ∧
       8533        ArrowSide.zetaFaithful ArrowSide.zetaChart 2 3000000000001 (2, 3000000000001)) := by
       8534    have off : ¬ RememberedOffered.onLine thePair := fun h => by
       8535      have h2 : (2 : Int) = 0 := h
       8536      exact absurd h2 (by decide)
       8537    have nv := RememberedOffered.pair_world_lacks_value thePair off
       8538    refine ⟨RememberedOffered.pair_world_closed thePair, nv, RememberedOffered.one_record thePair,
       8539      RememberedOffered.the_line_no_contradicts_the_root_read_twice _ nv,
       8540      (RememberedOffered.row_four_from_the_zero_side (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair)).2.1
       8541        [thePair, RememberedOffered.fold thePair] ⟨thePair, List.Mem.head _, off⟩,
       8542      ⟨by decide, by decide, by decide⟩, ⟨by decide, by decide, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
       8543    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide)))
       8544    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by decide))
       8545  
       8546  /-- THE BLOCKS AT THE MODEL PAIR: at the pair at height 3·10¹² + 1, which every fact of ζ placed on the arrow admits,
       8547      the registered world and the pair world leave one record; both readings of the halt hold on the first and fail on
       8548      the second; no reading of the record decides the value; every deed is the supply at the first and not at the
       8549      second; and the loop closes on the first and stays open on the second. -/
       8550  theorem the_blocks_at_the_one_pair :
       8551      RememberedOffered.SameRecord (RememberedOffered.registered thePair) (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair) ∧
       8552      (RememberedOffered.ZeroReports (RememberedOffered.registered thePair) ∧
       8553        RememberedOffered.PrimeBound (RememberedOffered.registered thePair)) ∧
       8554      (¬ RememberedOffered.ZeroReports (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair) ∧
       8555        ¬ RememberedOffered.PrimeBound (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair)) ∧
       8556      (∀ g : RememberedOffered.Config → Prop,
       8557        (∀ S S', RememberedOffered.SameRecord S S' → (g S ↔ g S')) →
       8558        ¬ ((g (RememberedOffered.registered thePair) ↔
       8559              RememberedOffered.Value (RememberedOffered.registered thePair)) ∧
       8560           (g (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair) ↔
       8561              RememberedOffered.Value (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair)))) ∧
       8562      ((TOE0.ra₀.Act → ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = RememberedOffered.registered thePair) ∧
       8563        ¬ (TOE0.ra₀.Act → ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair)) ∧
       8564      ((TOE0.RA₀ ↔ RememberedOffered.RootReadTwice (RememberedOffered.registered thePair)) ∧
       8565        ¬ (TOE0.RA₀ ↔ RememberedOffered.RootReadTwice (RememberedOffered.pairWorld thePair))) := by
       8566    have off : ¬ RememberedOffered.onLine thePair := fun h => by
       8567      have h2 : (2 : Int) = 0 := h
       8568      exact absurd h2 (by decide)
       8569    have nv := RememberedOffered.pair_world_lacks_value thePair off
       8570    have rv := RememberedOffered.registered_has_value thePair
       8571    have pc := RememberedOffered.pair_world_closed thePair
       8572    have rc : RememberedOffered.Closed (RememberedOffered.registered thePair) := fun s hs => by
       8573      rw [hs]
       8574      show RememberedOffered.fold (RememberedOffered.reg thePair) = RememberedOffered.reg thePair
       8575      rfl
       8576    have zr : ∀ T : RememberedOffered.Config, RememberedOffered.Closed T →
       8577        (RememberedOffered.ZeroReports T ↔ RememberedOffered.Value T) :=
       8578      fun T hT => (RememberedOffered.row_four_from_the_zero_side T).2.2.2 hT
       8579    have la : ∀ T : RememberedOffered.Config, RememberedOffered.Closed T →
       8580        ((TOE0.ra₀.Act → ∃ Z : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros, Z.zeros = T) ↔ RememberedOffered.Value T) :=
       8581      fun T hT => (RememberedOffered.the_last_act (rootOf TOE0.ra₀) T hT).1
       8582    have lp : ∀ T : RememberedOffered.Config,
       8583        ((TOE0.RA₀ ↔ RememberedOffered.RootReadTwice T) ↔ RememberedOffered.Value T) :=
       8584      fun T => (RememberedOffered.the_loop (rootOf TOE0.ra₀) T).2.2.2.2.1
       8585    exact ⟨RememberedOffered.one_record thePair,
       8586      ⟨(zr _ rc).mpr rv, (RememberedOffered.prime_side_halts _ rc).mpr rv⟩,
       8587      ⟨fun h => nv ((zr _ pc).mp h), fun h => nv ((RememberedOffered.prime_side_halts _ pc).mp h)⟩,
       8588      fun g hg ⟨h1, h2⟩ => nv (h2.mp ((hg _ _ (RememberedOffered.one_record thePair)).mp (h1.mpr rv))),
       8589      ⟨(la _ rc).mpr rv, fun h => nv ((la _ pc).mp h)⟩,
       8590      ⟨(lp _).mpr rv, fun h => nv ((lp _).mp h)⟩⟩
       8591  
       8592  /-- THE VERIFIED PART TRANSPORTS: at every width, the verification in both half-planes on Part V's chart is the
       8593      verified part on the offset chart with the height in absolute value. -/
       8594  theorem the_verified_part_transports (C : ArrowSide.Chart) (T : Nat) (S : ArrowSide.Pt → Prop) :
       8595      ArrowSide.RealPartAbs C (T : Int) S ↔
       8596        RHUnicorn.RealPartAt (img (φW C) S) RememberedOffered.onLine RememberedOffered.htAbs T := by
       8597    constructor
       8598    · intro h q ⟨p, hp, e⟩ hq
       8599      subst e
       8600      have hq' : (p.2).natAbs ≤ T := hq
       8601      have h1 : p.1 = C.W := h p hp (by omega) (by omega)
       8602      show p.1 - C.W = 0
       8603      omega
       8604    · intro h p hp h1 h2
       8605      have h3 : p.1 - C.W = 0 := h (φW C p) ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ (show (p.2).natAbs ≤ T by omega)
       8606      show p.1 = C.W
       8607      omega
       8608  
       8609  /-- THE FAITHFUL MODEL ON THE OFFSET CHART: its image carries the verified part at chart height 3·10¹² − 1, every zero
       8610      with |Im s| < 3·10¹², and lacks the value. -/
       8611  theorem the_faithful_model_on_the_offset_chart :
       8612      RHUnicorn.RealPartAt (img φA (ArrowSide.zetaFaithful ArrowSide.zetaChart 2 3000000000001))
       8613        RememberedOffered.onLine RememberedOffered.htAbs 2999999999999 ∧
       8614      ¬ RememberedOffered.Value (img φA (ArrowSide.zetaFaithful ArrowSide.zetaChart 2 3000000000001)) :=
       8615    ⟨(the_verified_part_transports ArrowSide.zetaChart 2999999999999 _).mp
       8616        ArrowSide.at_zetas_numbers_faithful.2.2.2.2.2.1,
       8617     fun v => ArrowSide.at_zetas_numbers_faithful.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 ((transport eqA _).2.mpr v)⟩
       8618  
       8619  /-- ONE REAL PART, ONE OFFSET POINT, AT RESOLUTION FOUR: a real part a/4 read on Part IV's chart, on Part V's chart at
       8620      width four, on Part II's chart at resolution two, and a real part a/2 read on Part II's chart at resolution one
       8621      and on Part IV-c's chart, land at one point of the offset chart at resolution four. -/
       8622  theorem the_maps_agree_at_resolution_four :
       8623      (∀ a t : Int, φH (a, t) = φA (2 * a, t) ∧ φA (2 * a, t) = φW ArrowSide.zetaChart (2 * a, t)) ∧
       8624      (∀ z : PrimeFreedom.Pt, φP₂ z = φH (z.x, (z.t : Int)) ∧ φP z = φH (2 * z.x, (z.t : Int))) ∧
       8625      (∀ x t : Int, φT (x, t) = φH (2 * x, t)) :=
       8626    ⟨fun a t => ⟨Prod.ext (show 2 * a - 4 = 2 * a - 4 from rfl) rfl, rfl⟩,
       8627     fun z => ⟨rfl, Prod.ext (show 4 * z.x - 4 = 2 * (2 * z.x) - 4 by omega) rfl⟩,
       8628     fun x t => Prod.ext (show 4 * x - 4 = 2 * (2 * x) - 4 by omega) rfl⟩
       8629  
       8630  /-- Conjugation on a chart with heights in ℤ. -/
       8631  def conj (p : Int × Int) : Int × Int := (p.1, -p.2)
       8632  /-- THE MAPS COMMUTE WITH CONJUGATION on every chart with heights in ℤ; the first edition's chart, with heights in ℕ,
       8633      reads the upper half-plane, and its maps reach only heights at or above zero. -/
       8634  theorem the_maps_commute_with_conjugation :
       8635      (∀ p : Hinge.Pt, φH (conj p) = conj (φH p)) ∧ (∀ p : ArrowSide.Pt, φA (conj p) = conj (φA p)) ∧
       8636      (∀ (C : ArrowSide.Chart) (p : ArrowSide.Pt), φW C (conj p) = conj (φW C p)) ∧
       8637      (∀ p : Int × Int, φT (conj p) = conj (φT p)) ∧ (∀ p : ForceWitness.Point, φF (conj p) = conj (φF p)) ∧
       8638      (∀ (n : Int) (z : PrimeFreedom.Pt), 0 ≤ (φPn n z).2) ∧ (∀ z : PrimeFreedom.Pt, 0 ≤ (φP z).2) ∧
       8639      (∀ z : PrimeFreedom.Pt, 0 ≤ (φP₂ z).2) :=
       8640    ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl,
       8641     fun _ z => Int.ofNat_nonneg z.t, fun z => Int.ofNat_nonneg z.t, fun z => Int.ofNat_nonneg z.t⟩
       8642  
       8643  /-! ## The reading at every resolution -/
       8644  
       8645  /-- The open chart strip at resolution n: a reading inside the open strip 0 < Re s < 1 is kept at 1 ≤ x ≤ 2n − 1. -/
       8646  def clampStrip (n x : Int) : Int := max 1 (min (2 * n - 1) x)
       8647  /-- THE CLAMP KEEPS THE OPEN STRIP, COMMUTES WITH THE FOLD, AND KEEPS THE SIDE: at every resolution n ≥ 1 the clamped
       8648      reading lies in the open chart strip; the clamp commutes with x ↦ 2n − x; and at every resolution n ≥ 2 it lands
       8649      on the line exactly when the rounded reading does. -/
       8650  theorem the_clamp_keeps_strip_fold_and_side :
       8651      (∀ n x : Int, 1 ≤ n → 1 ≤ clampStrip n x ∧ clampStrip n x ≤ 2 * n - 1) ∧
       8652      (∀ n x : Int, 1 ≤ n → clampStrip n (2 * n - x) = 2 * n - clampStrip n x) ∧
       8653      (∀ n x : Int, 2 ≤ n → (clampStrip n x = n ↔ x = n)) :=
       8654    ⟨fun n x _ => by unfold clampStrip; omega, fun n x _ => by unfold clampStrip; omega,
       8655     fun n x _ => by unfold clampStrip; omega⟩
       8656  
       8657  /-- Rounding half to even of a / b, for b > 0. -/
       8658  def roundHalfEven (a b : Int) : Int :=
       8659    let q := a / b
       8660    let r := a % b
       8661    if 2 * r < b then q else if 2 * r > b then q + 1 else if q % 2 = 0 then q else q + 1
       8662  /-- THE READER'S RULE on the offset chart at resolution n ≥ 1: a real part σ = a / b of the open strip is read at
       8663      x = round(2n·σ), rounded half to even and kept in the open chart strip, and at d = x − n. -/
       8664  def readAt (n : Nat) (a b : Int) : Int := clampStrip n (roundHalfEven (2 * n * a) b) - n
       8665  
       8666  /-- ONE RESOLUTION IS NOT ENOUGH: a zero at Re s = 51/100 and its mirror at 49/100 read onto the line at resolution
       8667      four and off it at resolution fifty; the pair at Re s = 1/4 and 3/4 reads at d = ∓2 at resolution four; and a
       8668      zero at Re s = 97/100 or 3/100 is kept off the poles, at d = ±3. -/
       8669  theorem one_resolution_is_not_enough :
       8670      readAt 4 51 100 = 0 ∧ readAt 4 49 100 = 0 ∧ readAt 50 51 100 = 1 ∧ readAt 50 49 100 = -1 ∧
       8671      readAt 4 1 4 = -2 ∧ readAt 4 3 4 = 2 ∧ readAt 4 97 100 = 3 ∧ readAt 4 3 100 = -3 := by decide
       8672  
       8673  /-- A zero at Re s = 51/100 with its mirror at 49/100, at height 3·10¹² + 1, read at resolution n. -/
       8674  def nearWorld (n : Nat) : RememberedOffered.Config := fun q =>
       8675    q = (readAt n 51 100, 3000000000001) ∨ q = (readAt n 49 100, 3000000000001)
       8676  
       8677  /-- THE VALUE AT ONE RESOLUTION DOES NOT DECIDE IT AT A FINER ONE: read at resolution four the near pair is closed and
       8678      has the value; read at resolution fifty it is closed and lacks it. -/
       8679  theorem one_resolution_does_not_decide_the_next :
       8680      RememberedOffered.Closed (nearWorld 4) ∧ RememberedOffered.Value (nearWorld 4) ∧
       8681      RememberedOffered.Closed (nearWorld 50) ∧ ¬ RememberedOffered.Value (nearWorld 50) := by
       8682    obtain ⟨e1, e2, e3, e4, _, _, _, _⟩ := one_resolution_is_not_enough
       8683    refine ⟨fun q hq => ?_, fun q hq => ?_, fun q hq => ?_, fun v => ?_⟩
       8684    · unfold nearWorld at hq ⊢
       8685      rw [e1, e2] at hq ⊢
       8686      rcases hq with h | h <;> (subst h; exact Or.inl (by decide))
       8687    · unfold nearWorld at hq
       8688      rw [e1, e2] at hq
       8689      rcases hq with h | h <;> (subst h; rfl)
       8690    · unfold nearWorld at hq ⊢
       8691      rw [e3, e4] at hq ⊢
       8692      rcases hq with h | h
       8693      · subst h; exact Or.inr (by decide)
       8694      · subst h; exact Or.inl (by decide)
       8695    · have h : (1 : Int) = 0 := v (1, 3000000000001) (by unfold nearWorld; rw [e3]; exact Or.inl rfl)
       8696      exact absurd h (by decide)
       8697  
       8698  /-- THE ACT AT EVERY RESOLUTION: a family of readings of the offset chart, one at each resolution, each closed under
       8699      the fold, with least erasure supplied at every resolution. The zero set of ζ read by the reader's rule at every
       8700      resolution n ≥ 1 is such a family by the reading of the paper's Section 11; resolution zero is no reading, and the
       8701      family's term there is the empty configuration by stipulation. -/
       8702  structure ActualZerosEvery where
       8703    zeros : Nat → RememberedOffered.Config
       8704    closed : ∀ n, RememberedOffered.Closed (zeros n)
       8705    supply : ∀ n, RememberedOffered.LeastErasure (zeros n)
       8706  
       8707  /-- The act at every resolution is an act of the offset chart at each one. -/
       8708  def ActualZerosEvery.atRes (Z : ActualZerosEvery) (n : Nat) : RememberedOffered.ActualZeros :=
       8709    ⟨Z.zeros n, Z.closed n, Z.supply n⟩
       8710  
       8711  /-- THE VALUE AT EVERY RESOLUTION, ON NO AXIOM: on the act at every resolution, every reading has the value. -/
       8712  theorem the_value_at_every_resolution (Z : ActualZerosEvery) (n : Nat) : RememberedOffered.Value (Z.zeros n) :=
       8713    RememberedOffered.value_from_the_act (Z.atRes n)
       8714  
       8715  /-- THE ACT AT EVERY RESOLUTION, WHOLE: the act stands at the readings exactly where the value holds at every
       8716      resolution; on it, at every resolution, the value, the zero reports and the prime bound hold; every proof of the
       8717      value at every resolution, from any premise, is a supply of the act; the supply is unique; and the atomic proof,
       8718      the atomic necessity and the two-sided halt hold at every resolution. -/
       8719  theorem the_act_at_every_resolution (R : Nat → RememberedOffered.Config)
       8720      (hR : ∀ n, RememberedOffered.Closed (R n)) :
       8721      ((∃ Z : ActualZerosEvery, Z.zeros = R) ↔ ∀ n, RememberedOffered.Value (R n)) ∧
       8722      (∀ (Z : ActualZerosEvery) (n : Nat), RememberedOffered.Value (Z.zeros n) ∧
       8723        RememberedOffered.ZeroReports (Z.zeros n) ∧ RememberedOffered.PrimeBound (Z.zeros n)) ∧
       8724      (∀ Q : Prop, (Q → ∀ n, RememberedOffered.Value (R n)) → Q → ∃ Z : ActualZerosEvery, Z.zeros = R) ∧
       8725      (∀ Z₁ Z₂ : ActualZerosEvery, Z₁.zeros = R → Z₂.zeros = R → Z₁ = Z₂) ∧
       8726      (∀ n, type_of% (RememberedOffered.the_atomic_proof (rootOf TOE0.ra₀) (R n) (hR n))) ∧
       8727      (∀ n, type_of% (RememberedOffered.the_atomic_necessity (R n) (hR n))) ∧
       8728      (∀ n, type_of% (RememberedOffered.bidirectional_halted_uniduction (R n) (hR n))) := by
       8729    have mk : (∀ n, RememberedOffered.Value (R n)) → ∃ Z : ActualZerosEvery, Z.zeros = R := fun v =>
       8730      ⟨⟨R, hR, fun n => (RememberedOffered.twins_on_every_world (R n)).mpr (v n)⟩, rfl⟩
       8731    refine ⟨⟨fun ⟨Z, hZ⟩ n => by rw [← hZ]; exact RememberedOffered.value_from_the_act (Z.atRes n), mk⟩,
       8732      fun Z n => ⟨RememberedOffered.value_from_the_act (Z.atRes n),
       8733        (RememberedOffered.bidirectional_halted_uniduction _ (Z.closed n)).2.2.2.2.2 (Z.atRes n)⟩,
       8734      fun _ hQ q => mk (hQ q), ?_,
       8735      fun n => RememberedOffered.the_atomic_proof (rootOf TOE0.ra₀) (R n) (hR n),
       8736      fun n => RememberedOffered.the_atomic_necessity (R n) (hR n),
       8737      fun n => RememberedOffered.bidirectional_halted_uniduction (R n) (hR n)⟩
       8738    intro Z₁ Z₂ h₁ h₂
       8739    obtain ⟨z₁, c₁, s₁⟩ := Z₁
       8740    obtain ⟨z₂, c₂, s₂⟩ := Z₂
       8741    change z₁ = R at h₁
       8742    change z₂ = R at h₂
       8743    subst h₁
       8744    subst h₂
       8745    rfl
       8746  
       8747  /-- THE PRIME BOUND AT ONE RESOLUTION IS WEAKER: the near pair at Re s = 51/100 meets the prime bound read at
       8748      resolution four and fails it read at resolution fifty; at one resolution n the chart's prime bound reads a zero
       8749      within 1/(4n) of the line onto it. -/
       8750  theorem the_prime_bound_at_one_resolution :
       8751      RememberedOffered.PrimeBound (nearWorld 4) ∧ ¬ RememberedOffered.PrimeBound (nearWorld 50) := by
       8752    have h := one_resolution_does_not_decide_the_next
       8753    exact ⟨(RememberedOffered.prime_side_halts _ h.1).mpr h.2.1,
       8754      fun b => h.2.2.2 ((RememberedOffered.prime_side_halts _ h.2.2.1).mp b)⟩
       8755  
       8756  /-- THE HALT AT EVERY RESOLUTION: for every family of reflection-closed readings, the zero reports at every resolution,
       8757      the prime bound at every resolution and the value at every resolution are one proposition. The prime bound at
       8758      every resolution together is the chart's image of the cited bound at x^(1/2 + ε). -/
       8759  theorem the_halt_at_every_resolution (R : Nat → RememberedOffered.Config)
       8760      (hR : ∀ n, RememberedOffered.Closed (R n)) :
       8761      ((∀ n, RememberedOffered.ZeroReports (R n)) ↔ ∀ n, RememberedOffered.Value (R n)) ∧
       8762      ((∀ n, RememberedOffered.PrimeBound (R n)) ↔ ∀ n, RememberedOffered.Value (R n)) ∧
       8763      ((∀ n, RememberedOffered.ZeroReports (R n)) ↔ ∀ n, RememberedOffered.PrimeBound (R n)) := by
       8764    have z := fun n => (RememberedOffered.bidirectional_halted_uniduction (R n) (hR n)).1
       8765    have p := fun n => (RememberedOffered.bidirectional_halted_uniduction (R n) (hR n)).2.1
       8766    refine ⟨⟨fun h n => (z n).mp (h n), fun h n => (z n).mpr (h n)⟩,
       8767      ⟨fun h n => (p n).mp (h n), fun h n => (p n).mpr (h n)⟩,
       8768      ⟨fun h n => (p n).mpr ((z n).mp (h n)), fun h n => (z n).mpr ((p n).mp (h n))⟩⟩
       8769  
       8770  end Charts
       8771  
       8772  end PartVb

       8774  /-! # PART VI · THE TWO-SIDED CLOSURE -/
       8775  section PartVI
       8776  namespace BothSides
       8777  
       8778  /-- THE TWO-SIDED CLOSURE. One theorem, every capstone of the seed bound by its exact type.
       8779      I    the floor, on no axiom: the root holds for every self-grounding root; the Root Axiom on its constructed
       8780           domain; the master seal of the three axes; the line is the fixed set of conjugation.
       8781      II   the arrow: the only rigid reversal of the two poles; the freedom cut, the line blind to the arrow's sign;
       8782           the hinge at Re s = 1/2; the fold's fixed set is the line.
       8783      III  the prime side: the primes admit every assignment; prime freedom forces nothing; the prime bound halts
       8784           at the value; the ζ-specific facts on the arrow, their test and their reach at the ends.
       8785      IV   the non-trivial-zero side: the zero set's own centre is the line; a centred pair off it; row four read
       8786           from the zeros.
       8787      V    the nine rows: the form; the open leg; the blind record; the premise forced, the act, the weakest
       8788           forcing premise; the barred refuter; the terminal saturation; the capstone; the annihilating timeless
       8789           closure and the one; the atomic form forced.
       8790      VI   the termination: the bidirectional halted uniduction; the atomic proof; the last act; least erasure and
       8791           least escape; the loop.
       8792      VII  the run: a run witnesses that it ran and leaves the value free; a run's flag offered as the field at every
       8793           closed configuration is refused; beside the field, the run is witnessed and the value stands on the field.
       8794      VIII the charts are one; the one model pair read by every instrument; the faithful model of ζ's zeros; the hinge
       8795           exists; both values of the bit are atomic.
       8796      IX   further capstones and row mechanisms of Parts II, III, IV, IV-b and IV-c.
       8797      X    every further theorem the body of the paper cites, generated from the body's citations: with I to IX, the
       8798           closure binds every theorem the body cites. -/
       8799  theorem the_two_sided_closure :
       8800      -- I · the floor
       8801      (type_of% @TOE0.the_floor_is_universal) ∧ (type_of% @TOE0.root_on_the_constructed_domain) ∧

       8813      -- V · the nine rows

       8815      (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.record_decides_nothing) ∧ (type_of% @PrimeFreedom.rh_from_the_act) ∧
