      10487  /-! # PART IX . RH_Bound_Chain_v1.0.1.lean, verbatim (The Formal Arch, Discrete Offset Chart) -/
      10488  /-!
      10489    RH · BOUND CHAIN v1.0.1 — the Final Arch, in ONE FILE, in the Freedom register.
      10490  
      10491    Core Lean 4.19.0: no import, no axiom declared, no sorry, no admit, no native_decide.
      10492  
      10493    This file speaks only deliverance: what the Freedom arrow gives. No hypotheses are
      10494    taken and none are offered. Every statement below is exhibited by a closed term.
      10495  
      10496    THIS FILE BINDS `Cargo_Delivered_Flip.lean` (the flip: Freedom → act → locus → lever)
      10497    and `RH_Both_Sides_Flip_v1.0.lean` (the seed rebuilt in one stroke, pure formal domain)
      10498    into a SINGLE ARCH, one namespace, one capstone. Nothing is re-proved from
      10499    memory: every definition and proof below is the merged, de-duplicated content of the
      10500    two compiled files, with the prose lifted into the Freedom register.
      10501  
      10502    THE FINAL ARCH, end to end:
      10503      FREEDOM  — the arrow, unconditionally inhabited; the massless root. The source;
      10504                 everything below is its product.
      10505      ACT      — registration: the forgetting, definitional. Stage1: the formal
      10506                 annihilation, inhabited by the trivial neutral state.
      10507      EDGE     — where the deliverance stops, inside the arch: no universal route is
      10508                 delivered, no shared principle delivers the value, no inhabited deed
      10509                 delivers it, no record-reading delivers it. The edge is part of the
      10510                 arch, not a wall around it.
      10511      FORM     — the twins: LeastErasure ↔ Value, at each configuration.
      10512      LOCUS    — Rec S: the arrow's product, the formal world as the output of the act.
      10513      LEVER    — the remembered is lossless, definitionally; the twins carry it to
      10514                 least erasure; the remembering is stable.
      10515      SOCKET   — the filled ActualZeros at the locus, all fields by closed terms.
      10516      CLOSURE  — the identification IS the proof: the exhibited socket and the value
      10517                 coincide at the locus. One exhibited thing.
      10518      MEASURE  — the arrow's own measure of its reach: carrying the cargo from the
      10519                 record to a configuration IS the value there; and the arrow's product
      10520                 coexists with configurations the arrow does not value.
      10521      CAP      — bound_chain: Freedom ∧ lever ∧ socket ∧ edge ∧ inhabited act,
      10522                 one conjunction, empty cone.
      10523  
      10524    Read the capstone's type as the whole arch: what is delivered is exactly what is
      10525    exhibited. The arrow delivers the record, the socket, the closure — at its product.
      10526    Beyond its product the arrow delivers nothing.
      10527  
      10528    No seat is earned by this file. Seat follows the OS rule only. ΔM = 0.
      10529  -/
      10530  
      10531  section BoundChainV101
      10532  namespace BoundChain
      10533  
      10534  /-! ## chart: points, fold, line, registration -/
      10535  
      10536  /-- A point is (d, t): d its offset from the line, t its height. The line is d = 0. -/
      10537  abbrev Point := Int × Int
      10538  
      10539  /-- The fold: (d, t) ↦ (−d, t). -/
      10540  def fold (p : Point) : Point := (-p.1, p.2)
      10541  
      10542  /-- The line: offset zero. -/
      10543  def onLine (p : Point) : Prop := p.1 = 0
      10544  
      10545  /-- The registration: it keeps the height and forgets the side. The formal act. -/
      10546  def reg (p : Point) : Point := (0, p.2)
      10547  
      10548  /-- Integer negation is an involution, by the integer's constructors. -/
      10549  theorem neg_neg_free : ∀ d : Int, - -d = d := fun
      10550    | Int.ofNat 0 => rfl
      10551    | Int.ofNat (_ + 1) => rfl
      10552    | Int.negSucc _ => rfl
      10553  
      10554  /-- The fold is an involution. -/
      10555  theorem fold_involutive (p : Point) : fold (fold p) = p := by
      10556    obtain ⟨d, t⟩ := p
      10557    show (- -d, t) = (d, t)
      10558    rw [neg_neg_free d]
      10559  
      10560  /-- THE REGISTRATION LANDS ON THE LINE: the forgetting, definitional. -/
      10561  theorem reg_lands (p : Point) : onLine (reg p) := rfl
      10562  
      10563  /-- The registration erases nothing at a point exactly when the point is on the line. -/
      10564  theorem reg_erases_nothing_iff (p : Point) : reg p = p ↔ onLine p := by
      10565    obtain ⟨d, t⟩ := p
      10566    exact ⟨fun h => (congrArg Prod.fst h).symm, fun h => by cases h; rfl⟩
      10567  
      10568  /-- The fold fixes the registered point: the line is the fixed set. -/
      10569  theorem fold_reg (p : Point) : fold (reg p) = reg p := by
      10570    obtain ⟨d, t⟩ := p
      10571    rfl
      10572  
      10573  /-! ## configurations, the value, least erasure -/
      10574  
      10575  /-- A configuration: a set of points. Closed: the fold carries it to itself. -/
      10576  abbrev Config := Point → Prop
      10577  
      10578  def Closed (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → S (fold p)
      10579  
      10580  /-- The value: every point of the configuration is on the line. -/
      10581  def Value (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → onLine p
      10582  
      10583  /-- Least erasure: the registration leaves every point of the configuration unchanged. -/
      10584  def LeastErasure (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ p, S p → reg p = p
      10585  
      10586  /-! ## FREEDOM: the sole root -/
      10587  
      10588  /-- THE FREEDOM ARROW, massless: a true premise adds nothing. -/
      10589  theorem massless_arrow (Q : Prop) (hq : Q) (P : Prop) : (Q → P) ↔ P :=
      10590    ⟨fun f => f hq, fun h _ => h⟩
      10591  
      10592  /-- THE FORMAL ROOT: the identity arrow exists. Unconditionally inhabited, keyless. -/
      10593  def FreedomRoot : Prop := ∃ f : Nat → Nat, ∀ a, f a = a
      10594  
      10595  /-- The root is inhabited by a closed term. -/
      10596  theorem freedom_root_inhabited : FreedomRoot := ⟨id, fun _ => rfl⟩
      10597  
      10598  /-! ## THE ARROW'S EDGE: where the deliverance stops, inside the arch -/
      10599  
      10600  /-- The off-line point. -/
      10601  def offPoint : Point := (1, 0)
      10602  
      10603  theorem off_point_is_off : ¬ onLine offPoint := by
      10604    intro h
      10605    have e : (1 : Int) = 0 := h
      10606    exact absurd e (by decide)
      10607  
      10608  /-- The pair world: a point and its fold partner. -/
      10609  def pairWorld (p : Point) : Config := fun s => s = p ∨ s = fold p
      10610  
      10611  theorem pair_world_closed (p : Point) : Closed (pairWorld p) := fun _ hs =>
      10612    match hs with
      10613    | Or.inl e => Or.inr (congrArg fold e)
      10614    | Or.inr e => Or.inl (e ▸ fold_involutive p)
      10615  
      10616  theorem pair_world_lacks_value (p : Point) (h : ¬ onLine p) : ¬ Value (pairWorld p) :=
      10617    fun hv => h (hv p (Or.inl rfl))
      10618  
      10619  /-- The arrow delivers no universal route. -/
      10620  theorem the_unconditional_route_is_blocked :
      10621      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → Value S := by
      10622    intro h
      10623    exact pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off (h _ (pair_world_closed offPoint))
      10624  
      10625  /-- Nothing every closed configuration shares forces the value. -/
      10626  theorem no_closed_principle_decides (D : Config → Prop) (hD : ∀ S, Closed S → D S) :
      10627      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → D S → Value S := by
      10628    intro hall
      10629    exact pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
      10630      (hall _ (pair_world_closed offPoint) (hD _ (pair_world_closed offPoint)))
      10631  
      10632  /-- NO INHABITED FORMAL TYPE FORCES THE VALUE: whatever the deed, pairWorld offPoint
      10633      is closed and lacks the value. -/
      10634  theorem freedom_forces_nothing (D : Prop) (hD : D) :
      10635      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → D → Value S := by
      10636    intro hall
      10637    exact pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
      10638      (hall _ (pair_world_closed offPoint) hD)
      10639  
      10640  /-- The freedom root, inhabited, forces nothing on arbitrary configurations. -/
      10641  theorem freedom_root_forces_nothing :
      10642      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → FreedomRoot → Value S :=
      10643    freedom_forces_nothing _ freedom_root_inhabited
      10644  
      10645  /-! ## ACT: the formal forgetting, and Stage 1 -/
      10646  
      10647  /-- THE CARRIER. Two constructors: a self-conjugate state at a height, or a member of a
      10648      conjugate pair of magnitude m + 1 at a height with the sign that tells it from its partner. -/
      10649  inductive PhysicalCarrier where
      10650    | selfConjugate (t : Int)
      10651    | conjugatePair (m : Nat) (t : Int) (sign : Bool)
      10652  
      10653  /-- Annihilation, the discard: a member of a pair goes to the neutral state at its height;
      10654      a neutral state stays. The sign is kept nowhere. -/
      10655  def annihilate : PhysicalCarrier → PhysicalCarrier
      10656    | .selfConjugate t => .selfConjugate t
      10657    | .conjugatePair _ t _ => .selfConjugate t
      10658  
      10659  /-- A verification event: from `before` to `after`, with `after` the annihilation of
      10660      `before` — one label forgotten. -/
      10661  structure VerificationEvent where
      10662    before : PhysicalCarrier
      10663    after : PhysicalCarrier
      10664    h_forget : after = annihilate before
      10665  
      10666  /-- THE LOCAL COMPUTATION IS A FORGETTING: the event's own field. -/
      10667  theorem local_computation_is_forgetting (e : VerificationEvent) :
      10668      e.after = annihilate e.before :=
      10669    e.h_forget
      10670  
      10671  /-- STAGE 1: forgetting done, floor witnessed. -/
      10672  structure Stage1 where
      10673    event : VerificationEvent
      10674    forgetting_done : event.after = annihilate event.before
      10675    floor_witnessed : ∃ c, c = event.after
      10676  
      10677  /-- THE COMPUTATION ENACTS STAGE 1: every verification event supplies one. -/
      10678  def computation_enacts_stage1 (e : VerificationEvent) : Stage1 :=
      10679    ⟨e, e.h_forget, ⟨e.after, rfl⟩⟩
      10680  
      10681  /-- Stage 1 is inhabited by the trivial neutral state: selfConjugate 0. -/
      10682  def trivial_neutral_event : VerificationEvent :=
      10683    ⟨.selfConjugate 0, .selfConjugate 0, rfl⟩
      10684  
      10685  theorem stage1_inhabited : Nonempty Stage1 :=
      10686    ⟨computation_enacts_stage1 trivial_neutral_event⟩
      10687  
      10688  /-- The inhabited Stage1 forces nothing on arbitrary configurations. -/
      10689  theorem stage1_forces_nothing :
      10690      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → Nonempty Stage1 → Value S :=
      10691    freedom_forces_nothing _ stage1_inhabited
      10692  
      10693  /-! ## FORM: least erasure is the value -/
      10694  
      10695  /-- THE TWINS LAW: least erasure and the value are one extension, read two ways. -/
      10696  theorem twins_on_every_world (S : Config) : LeastErasure S ↔ Value S :=
      10697    ⟨fun le p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp (le p hp),
      10698     fun v p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr (v p hp)⟩
      10699  
      10700  /-! ## LOCUS + LEVER: the record, the lossless remembered -/
      10701  
      10702  /-- The record of a configuration: what the registration leaves. The constructed locus. -/
      10703  def Rec (S : Config) (q : Point) : Prop := ∃ p, S p ∧ reg p = q
      10704  
      10705  def SameRecord (S S' : Config) : Prop := ∀ q, Rec S q ↔ Rec S' q
      10706  
      10707  /-- The registered world of a point. -/
      10708  def registered (p : Point) : Config := fun s => s = reg p
      10709  
      10710  theorem registered_has_value (p : Point) : Value (registered p) := fun s hs => by
      10711    rw [hs]; exact reg_lands p
      10712  
      10713  theorem registered_closed (p : Point) : Closed (registered p) := fun s hs => by
      10714    rw [hs]; show fold (reg p) = reg p; exact fold_reg p
      10715  
      10716  /-- The registered world and the pair world leave one record. -/
      10717  theorem one_record (p : Point) : SameRecord (registered p) (pairWorld p) := fun q =>
      10718    ⟨fun ⟨_, hs, hq⟩ => ⟨p, Or.inl rfl, by rw [← hq, hs]; rfl⟩,
      10719     fun ⟨_, hs, hq⟩ => ⟨reg p, rfl, by
      10720        rw [← hq]
      10721        exact match hs with
      10722          | Or.inl e => by rw [e]; rfl
      10723          | Or.inr e => by rw [e]; rfl⟩⟩
      10724  
      10725  /-- NO READING OF THE RECORD DECIDES: two worlds, one record, the value on one side only. -/
      10726  theorem record_decides_nothing (g : Config → Prop)
      10727      (hg : ∀ S S', SameRecord S S' → (g S ↔ g S')) :
      10728      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → (g S ↔ Value S) := by
      10729    intro h
      10730    have pc := pair_world_closed offPoint
      10731    have pv := pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
      10732    have rc := registered_closed offPoint
      10733    exact pv ((h _ pc).mp ((hg _ _ (one_record offPoint)).mp
      10734      ((h _ rc).mpr (registered_has_value offPoint))))
      10735  
      10736  /-- THE REMEMBERED IS LOSSLESS: the record of every configuration has the value.
      10737      Kept core: the output of a line-landing map lies on the line. No hypothesis on S. -/
      10738  theorem the_remembered_is_lossless (S : Config) : Value (Rec S) :=
      10739    fun _ ⟨p, _, hq⟩ => hq ▸ reg_lands p
      10740  
      10741  /-- The record of every configuration has least erasure, via the twins law. -/
      10742  theorem record_has_least_erasure (S : Config) : LeastErasure (Rec S) :=
      10743    (twins_on_every_world (Rec S)).mpr (the_remembered_is_lossless S)
      10744  
      10745  /-- The record is closed: it lies on the line, which the fold fixes. -/
      10746  theorem record_closed (S : Config) : Closed (Rec S) := fun q ⟨p, hp, hq⟩ =>
      10747    ⟨p, hp, by rw [← hq, fold_reg p]⟩
      10748  
      10749  /-- Remembering is stable: the memory of a memory is the memory. -/
      10750  theorem remembering_is_stable (S : Config) (q : Point) : Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q := by
      10751    constructor
      10752    · intro ⟨p, ⟨r, hr, hp⟩, hq⟩
      10753      refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
      10754      rw [← hq, ← hp]
      10755      exact ((reg_erases_nothing_iff (reg r)).mpr (reg_lands r)).symm
      10756    · intro hq
      10757      exact ⟨q, hq, (reg_erases_nothing_iff q).mpr (the_remembered_is_lossless S q hq)⟩
      10758  
      10759  /-- The offered is the remembered exactly when the value holds. -/
      10760  theorem offered_is_remembered_iff_value (S : Config) : (∀ q, Rec S q ↔ S q) ↔ Value S := by
      10761    constructor
      10762    · intro h p hp
      10763      exact the_remembered_is_lossless S p ((h p).mpr hp)
      10764    · intro v q
      10765      constructor
      10766      · intro ⟨p, hp, hq⟩
      10767        have e : reg p = p := (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mpr (v p hp)
      10768        rw [← hq, e]; exact hp
      10769      · intro hq
      10770        exact ⟨q, hq, (reg_erases_nothing_iff q).mpr (v q hq)⟩
      10771  
      10772  /-- THE ONE-BIT GAP, CONNECTED. -/
      10773  theorem one_bit_gap_connected (S : Config) :
      10774      SameRecord S (Rec S) ∧ Value (Rec S) ∧ (∀ q, Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q) ∧
      10775      ((∀ q, Rec S q ↔ S q) ↔ Value S) :=
      10776    ⟨fun q => (remembering_is_stable S q).symm, the_remembered_is_lossless S, remembering_is_stable S,
      10777     offered_is_remembered_iff_value S⟩
      10778  
      10779  /-! ## SOCKET: the bit supplied, the closure at a term -/
      10780  
      10781  /-- THE SOCKET: the bit supplied once, in the open, as a field of a type. -/
      10782  structure ActualZeros where
      10783    zeros : Config
      10784    closed : Closed zeros
      10785    supply : LeastErasure zeros
      10786  
      10787  /-- THE FILLED SOCKET: the constructed locus supplies all three fields by closed terms. -/
      10788  def formal_act (S : Config) : ActualZeros :=
      10789    ⟨Rec S, record_closed S, record_has_least_erasure S⟩
      10790  
      10791  /-- CLOSURE AT A TERM: at the registered world of any point, the socket holds a closed term. -/
      10792  def formal_closure_term (p : Point) : ActualZeros :=
      10793    ⟨registered p, registered_closed p, (twins_on_every_world _).mpr (registered_has_value p)⟩
      10794  
      10795  /-! ## the remaining levels, delivered: force, bar, saturation, one, atom -/
      10796  
      10797  /-- The value is its own weakest forcing premise (constructive core). -/
      10798  theorem weakest_forcing_premise :
      10799      (∀ S : Config, Closed S → Value S → Value S) ∧
      10800      ∀ P : Config → Prop, (∀ S : Config, Closed S → P S → Value S) →
      10801        ∀ S : Config, Closed S → P S → Value S :=
      10802    ⟨fun _ _ h => h, fun _P h S hS hp => h S hS hp⟩
      10803  
      10804  /-- The barred refuter: the only other door is one point off the line. -/
      10805  theorem barred_refuter (p : Point) (hp : ¬ onLine p) : ∃ S, Closed S ∧ ¬ Value S :=
      10806    ⟨pairWorld p, pair_world_closed p, pair_world_lacks_value p hp⟩
      10807  
      10808  /-- SATURATION: the record is value-closed, least-erased, and stable. -/
      10809  theorem saturation (S : Config) :
      10810      Value (Rec S) ∧ LeastErasure (Rec S) ∧ (∀ q, Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q) :=
      10811    ⟨the_remembered_is_lossless S, record_has_least_erasure S, remembering_is_stable S⟩
      10812  
      10813  /-- THE ONE: the two faces as one, zero gap, on the locus. -/
      10814  theorem the_one (S : Config) : Value (Rec S) ∧ LeastErasure (Rec S) :=
      10815    ⟨the_remembered_is_lossless S, record_has_least_erasure S⟩
      10816  
      10817  /-- THE ATOMIC NECESSITY: at the constructed locus the socket is filled. -/
      10818  theorem atomic_necessity (S : Config) : ∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = Rec S :=
      10819    ⟨formal_act S, rfl⟩
      10820  
      10821  /-- Accepting the value at the locus forces the atomic proof. -/
      10822  theorem accepting_value_forces_atomic (S : Config) :
      10823      Value (Rec S) → ∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = Rec S :=
      10824    fun _ => ⟨formal_act S, rfl⟩
      10825  
      10826  /-! ## THE CAP: one arch, one capstone -/
      10827  
      10828  /-- THE BOUND CHAIN: Freedom (inhabited root) ∧ the lever with the filled socket on the
      10829      constructed locus ∧ the blocks intact ∧ the act inhabited — one conjunction, one
      10830      gapless chain, empty cone. This is the whole verdict in one type. -/
      10831  theorem bound_chain :
      10832      FreedomRoot ∧
      10833      (∀ S : Config, Value (Rec S) ∧ LeastErasure (Rec S) ∧ (∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = Rec S)) ∧
      10834      (¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → Value S) ∧
      10835      (∀ D : Config → Prop, (∀ S, Closed S → D S) → ¬ ∀ S, Closed S → D S → Value S) ∧
      10836      (∀ D : Prop, D → ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → D → Value S) ∧
      10837      (∀ g : Config → Prop, (∀ S S', SameRecord S S' → (g S ↔ g S')) →
      10838        ¬ ∀ S, Closed S → (g S ↔ Value S)) ∧
      10839      Nonempty Stage1 :=
      10840    ⟨freedom_root_inhabited,
      10841     fun S => ⟨the_remembered_is_lossless S, record_has_least_erasure S, formal_act S, rfl⟩,
      10842     the_unconditional_route_is_blocked, no_closed_principle_decides,
      10843     freedom_forces_nothing, record_decides_nothing, stage1_inhabited⟩
      10844  
      10845  /-! ## THE ARROW'S MEASURE I: the transport IS the value -/
      10846  
      10847  /-- THE ARROW'S MEASURE: carrying the cargo's least erasure from the record to a
      10848      configuration IS the value at that configuration — for every configuration M.
      10849      The arrow delivers the record; the distance from the record to M is the value
      10850      itself. The arrow measuring its own reach, in a proved iff. -/
      10851  theorem transport_needs_value (M : Config) :
      10852      (LeastErasure (Rec M) → LeastErasure M) ↔ Value M := by
      10853    constructor
      10854    · intro h
      10855      exact (twins_on_every_world M).mp (h (record_has_least_erasure M))
      10856    · intro v _
      10857      exact (twins_on_every_world M).mpr v
      10858  
      10859  /-! ## CLOSURE: the identification IS the proof, at the arrow's product -/
      10860  
      10861  /-- From the act, the value: the filled socket's zeros carry the value. -/
      10862  theorem value_from_the_act (Z : ActualZeros) : Value Z.zeros :=
      10863    fun p hp => (reg_erases_nothing_iff p).mp (Z.supply p hp)
      10864  
      10865  /-- THE IDENTIFICATION IS THE PROOF: at the arrow's product, the exhibited filled
      10866      socket and the value coincide — proof and identification are one exhibited thing,
      10867      with no gap between them. The socket is exhibited directly by the arrow; the value
      10868      follows at the locus. Full closure of the loop, delivered. -/
      10869  theorem identification_is_the_proof (S : Config) :
      10870      (∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = Rec S) ↔ Value (Rec S) := by
      10871    constructor
      10872    · intro ⟨Z, hZ⟩
      10873      exact hZ ▸ value_from_the_act Z
      10874    · intro _
      10875      exact ⟨formal_act S, rfl⟩
      10876  
      10877  /-! ## THE ARROW'S MEASURE II: the product coexists with what the arrow does not value -/
      10878  
      10879  /-- THE ARROW'S REACH: the arrow delivers least erasure at its product, the record —
      10880      and delivers nothing beyond its product. The product coexists with configurations
      10881      the arrow does not value. Checked coexistence, empty cone. -/
      10882  theorem cargo_compatible_with_denial :
      10883      ∃ S Z : Config, LeastErasure (Rec S) ∧ ¬ LeastErasure Z :=
      10884    ⟨fun _ => False, pairWorld offPoint,
      10885     record_has_least_erasure _,
      10886     fun h => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
      10887       ((twins_on_every_world (pairWorld offPoint)).mp h)⟩
      10888  
      10889  /-! ## THE SELF-GROUNDING RETRACTION RECURSION (DISCRETE CHART) -/
      10890  
      10891  /-- The retracted image Rec S is a self-grounding fixed-point root in the sense of Part I (TOE0),
      10892      canonically inhabited by the closed term `formal_act S` — the retraction witness bundle.
      10893      This is the discrete-chart instance of the cargo recursion lifted to ℂ in Part X. -/
      10894  def ra_cargo_self_grounding (S : Config) :
      10895      TOE0.SelfGrounding (LeastErasure (Rec S)) :=
      10896    ⟨ActualZeros, formal_act S, fun _ => record_has_least_erasure S⟩
      10897  
      10898  /-- THE SELF-GROUNDING FIXED-POINT RECURSION AT THE RETRACTED IMAGE:
      10899      idempotence of registration makes LeastErasure (Rec S) unconditional and self-verifying
      10900      with an empty axiom cone. The three conjuncts are obtained by applying the Part I
      10901      theorems `TOE0.seated_undeniable`, `TOE0.denial_instantiates`, and
      10902      `TOE0.external_proof_adds_nothing` to the closed term `ra_cargo_self_grounding S`. -/
      10903  theorem ra_recursion_at_record (S : Config) :
      10904      LeastErasure (Rec S) ∧
      10905      TOE0.SelfVerifying (LeastErasure (Rec S)) ∧
      10906      (∀ Q : Prop, (Q → LeastErasure (Rec S)) ↔ LeastErasure (Rec S)) :=
      10907    ⟨TOE0.seated_undeniable (ra_cargo_self_grounding S),
      10908     TOE0.denial_instantiates (ra_cargo_self_grounding S),
      10909     TOE0.external_proof_adds_nothing (ra_cargo_self_grounding S)⟩
      10910  
      10911  /-! ## cones, pinned -/
      10912  
      10913  /-- info: 'BoundChain.reg_lands' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10914  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.reg_lands
      10915  /-- info: 'BoundChain.massless_arrow' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10916  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.massless_arrow
      10917  /-- info: 'BoundChain.freedom_root_inhabited' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10918  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.freedom_root_inhabited
      10919  /-- info: 'BoundChain.the_unconditional_route_is_blocked' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10920  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.the_unconditional_route_is_blocked
      10921  /-- info: 'BoundChain.no_closed_principle_decides' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10922  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.no_closed_principle_decides
      10923  /-- info: 'BoundChain.freedom_forces_nothing' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10924  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.freedom_forces_nothing
      10925  /-- info: 'BoundChain.freedom_root_forces_nothing' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10926  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.freedom_root_forces_nothing
      10927  /-- info: 'BoundChain.local_computation_is_forgetting' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10928  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.local_computation_is_forgetting
      10929  /-- info: 'BoundChain.computation_enacts_stage1' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10930  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.computation_enacts_stage1
      10931  /-- info: 'BoundChain.stage1_inhabited' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10932  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.stage1_inhabited
      10933  /-- info: 'BoundChain.stage1_forces_nothing' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10934  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.stage1_forces_nothing
      10935  /-- info: 'BoundChain.twins_on_every_world' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10936  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.twins_on_every_world
      10937  /-- info: 'BoundChain.record_decides_nothing' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10938  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.record_decides_nothing
      10939  /-- info: 'BoundChain.the_remembered_is_lossless' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10940  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.the_remembered_is_lossless
      10941  /-- info: 'BoundChain.record_has_least_erasure' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10942  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.record_has_least_erasure
      10943  /-- info: 'BoundChain.remembering_is_stable' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10944  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.remembering_is_stable
      10945  /-- info: 'BoundChain.offered_is_remembered_iff_value' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10946  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.offered_is_remembered_iff_value
      10947  /-- info: 'BoundChain.one_bit_gap_connected' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10948  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.one_bit_gap_connected
      10949  /-- info: 'BoundChain.formal_act' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10950  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.formal_act
      10951  /-- info: 'BoundChain.formal_closure_term' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10952  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.formal_closure_term
      10953  /-- info: 'BoundChain.weakest_forcing_premise' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10954  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.weakest_forcing_premise
      10955  /-- info: 'BoundChain.barred_refuter' does not depend on any axioms -/
      10956  #guard_msgs in #print axioms BoundChain.barred_refuter

      11015  
      11016  /-! # PART X . The Complex Retraction, Fixed-Point Recursion, and Mathlib Binding -/
      11017  section PartX
      11018  open Complex
      11019  
      11020  namespace BoundChainMathlib
      11021  
      11022  /-! ### TRANSLATION DICTIONARY for analytic number theorists -/
      11023  
      11024  /-!
      11025    Dirichlet series and the Euler product → `riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re`
      11026    (Mathlib.NumberTheory.LSeries.Dirichlet): non-vanishing for Re s > 1, the right
      11027    edge of `zeta_zeros_in_strip`.
      11028  
      11029    The completed functional equation → `completedRiemannZeta_one_sub`: the analytic
      11030    symmetry s ↦ 1 − s is the retraction operator `foldPt`; its Schwarz reflection
      11031    form is `zeta_schwarz_reflection`.
      11032  
      11033    Zero-free regions and strip confinement → `zeta_zeros_in_strip`: every nontrivial
      11034    zero satisfies 0 ≤ Re s ≤ 1, unconditionally.
      11035  
      11036    Explicit-formula / Weil-positivity criteria → `analytic_face_vocabulary_law`:
      11037    every analytic face equivalent to RH is identical to the fixed-point identity
      11038    `LeastErasure ZetaZeros`.
      11039  
      11040    The classical statement → `h_id_proved`: Mathlib's `RiemannHypothesis` is
      11041    logically identical to `LeastErasure ZetaZeros`.
      11042  
      11043    The normal form → `zeta_ra_loop` (first leg) and `apex_cone`: RH is the apex of
      11044    a cone of equivalent readings — retraction injectivity, the ActualZeros socket,
      11045    record coincidence — any two the same proposition (`apex_one_gap`).
      11046  -/
      11047  
      11048  /-- Points of the complex plane. -/
      11049  abbrev Point := ℂ
      11050  
      11051  /-- The critical locus: Re s = 1/2. -/
      11052  def onLine (s : Point) : Prop := s.re = 1 / 2
      11053  
      11054  /-- Conjugate reflection across the critical line: s ↦ 1 - conj s. -/
      11055  def fold (s : Point) : Point := 1 - star s
      11056  
      11057  /-- Point reflection from the functional equation: s ↦ 1 - s. -/
      11058  def foldPt (s : Point) : Point := 1 - s
      11059  
      11060  /-- Orthogonal retraction onto the critical line: s ↦ 1/2 + i Im s. -/
      11061  noncomputable def reg (s : Point) : Point := ⟨1 / 2, s.im⟩
      11062  
      11063  abbrev Config := Point → Prop
      11064  
      11065  /-- Reflection-closed configuration: invariant under s ↦ 1 - conj s. -/
      11066  def Closed (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ s, S s → S (fold s)
      11067  
      11068  /-- Critical-line inclusion: every point of S lies on Re s = 1/2. -/
      11069  def Value (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ s, S s → onLine s
      11070  
      11071  /-- Pointwise retraction invariance: every point of S is fixed by reg. -/
      11072  def LeastErasure (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ s, S s → reg s = s
      11073  
      11074  /-- The nontrivial zero set of ζ(s), defined directly from Mathlib's riemannZeta. -/
      11075  def ZetaZeros (s : Point) : Prop :=
      11076    riemannZeta s = 0 ∧ (¬∃ n : ℕ, s = -2 * (n + 1)) ∧ s ≠ 1
      11077  
      11078  /-- The nontrivial zero set of the completed zeta function Λ(s). -/
      11079  def CompletedZetaZeros (s : Point) : Prop :=
      11080    completedRiemannZeta s = 0 ∧ s ≠ 0 ∧ s ≠ 1
      11081  
      11082  /-- Conjugate reflection is an involution on ℂ. -/
      11083  theorem fold_involutive (s : Point) : fold (fold s) = s := by
      11084    simp only [fold, star_sub, star_one, star_star, sub_sub_cancel]
      11085  
      11086  /-- Point reflection fixes the real part if and only if the point lies on the critical line. -/
      11087  theorem foldPt_re_fixed_iff (s : Point) : (foldPt s).re = s.re ↔ onLine s := by
      11088    unfold foldPt onLine
      11089    simp only [sub_re, one_re]
      11090    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
      11091  
      11092  /-- Symmetry of the completed zero set under s ↦ 1 - s from Mathlib's functional equation. -/
      11093  theorem completed_zeta_zeros_symm (s : Point) (h : CompletedZetaZeros s) :
      11094      CompletedZetaZeros (foldPt s) := by
      11095    rcases h with ⟨hz, h0, h1⟩
      11096    refine ⟨?_, sub_ne_zero.mpr h1.symm, ?_⟩
      11097    · show completedRiemannZeta (1 - s) = 0
      11098      rw [completedRiemannZeta_one_sub]
      11099      exact hz
      11100    · show (1 : Point) - s ≠ 1
      11101      intro hcon
      11102      apply h0
      11103      have h2 := congrArg (fun x : Point => (1 : Point) - x) hcon
      11104      simpa using h2
      11105  
      11106  /-- The retraction lands on the critical line for every complex number. -/
      11107  theorem reg_lands (s : Point) : onLine (reg s) := rfl
      11108  
      11109  /-- Conjugate reflection fixes every retracted point. -/
      11110  theorem fold_reg (s : Point) : fold (reg s) = reg s := by
      11111    apply Complex.ext
      11112    · simp [fold, reg]
      11113      norm_num
      11114    · simp [fold, reg]
      11115  
      11116  /-- The retraction fixes a point if and only if the point lies on the critical line. -/
      11117  theorem reg_eq_self_iff (s : Point) : reg s = s ↔ onLine s := by
      11118    constructor
      11119    · intro h
      11120      show s.re = 1 / 2
      11121      have hr := congrArg Complex.re h
      11122      simpa [reg] using hr.symm
      11123    · intro h
      11124      have hre : s.re = 1 / 2 := h
      11125      show (⟨1 / 2, s.im⟩ : Point) = s
      11126      apply Complex.ext
      11127      · show (1 / 2 : ℝ) = s.re
      11128        exact hre.symm
      11129      · rfl
      11130  
      11131  /-- Pointwise retraction invariance is equivalent to critical-line inclusion on every subset of ℂ. -/
      11132  theorem twins_zeta (S : Config) : LeastErasure S ↔ Value S := by
      11133    constructor
      11134    · intro h s hs
      11135      exact (reg_eq_self_iff s).mp (h s hs)
      11136    · intro h s hs
      11137      exact (reg_eq_self_iff s).mpr (h s hs)
      11138  
      11139  /-- Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis is definitionally equivalent to critical-line inclusion of ZetaZeros. -/
      11140  theorem h_read_proved : RiemannHypothesis ↔ Value ZetaZeros := by
      11141    constructor
      11142    · intro h s ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩
      11143      exact h s h0 h1 h2
      11144    · intro h s h0 h1 h2
      11145      exact h s ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩
      11146  
      11147  /-- Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis is equivalent to pointwise retraction invariance of ZetaZeros. -/
      11148  theorem h_id_proved : RiemannHypothesis ↔ LeastErasure ZetaZeros :=
      11149    h_read_proved.trans (twins_zeta ZetaZeros).symm
      11150  
      11151  /-- The retracted image of a configuration S under reg. -/
      11152  def Rec (S : Config) : Config := fun q => ∃ p, S p ∧ reg p = q
      11153  
      11154  /-- Retraction is idempotent on ℂ. -/
      11155  theorem reg_idem (s : Point) : reg (reg s) = reg s := rfl
      11156  
      11157  /-- Every retracted image lies on the critical line. -/
      11158  theorem the_remembered_is_lossless (S : Config) : Value (Rec S) := by
      11159    intro q ⟨p, _, hpq⟩
      11160    rw [← hpq]
      11161    exact reg_lands p
      11162  
      11163  /-- Every retracted image is closed under conjugate reflection. -/
      11164  theorem record_closed (S : Config) : Closed (Rec S) := by
      11165    intro q ⟨p, hp, hpq⟩
      11166    exact ⟨p, hp, by rw [← hpq, fold_reg p]⟩
      11167  
      11168  /-- Every retracted image is pointwise invariant under reg. -/
      11169  theorem record_has_least_erasure (S : Config) : LeastErasure (Rec S) := by
      11170    intro q ⟨p, _, hpq⟩
      11171    show reg q = q
      11172    rw [← hpq, reg_idem]
      11173  
      11174  /-- Fixed-point witness bundle: a reflection-closed configuration equipped with retraction invariance. -/
      11175  structure ActualZeros where
      11176    zeros : Config
      11177    closed : Closed zeros
      11178    supply : LeastErasure zeros
      11179  
      11180  /-- Canonical fixed-point witness bundle at the retracted image Rec S. -/
      11181  noncomputable def formal_act (S : Config) : ActualZeros :=
      11182    ⟨Rec S, record_closed S, record_has_least_erasure S⟩
      11183  
      11184  /-- Every fixed-point witness bundle satisfies critical-line inclusion. -/
      11185  theorem value_from_the_act (Z : ActualZeros) : Value Z.zeros :=
      11186    fun s hs => (reg_eq_self_iff s).mp (Z.supply s hs)
      11187  
      11188  /-- At the retracted image Rec S, existence of a fixed-point witness bundle coincides with Value (Rec S). -/
      11189  theorem identification_is_the_proof (S : Config) :
      11190      (∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = Rec S) ↔ Value (Rec S) := by
      11191    constructor
      11192    · intro ⟨Z, hZ⟩
      11193      exact hZ ▸ value_from_the_act Z
      11194    · intro _
      11195      exact ⟨formal_act S, rfl⟩
      11196  
      11197  /-- Retraction transfer measure: carrying retraction invariance from Rec M to M is equivalent to Value M. -/
      11198  theorem transport_zeta (M : Config) :
      11199      (LeastErasure (Rec M) → LeastErasure M) ↔ Value M := by
      11200    constructor
      11201    · intro h
      11202      exact (twins_zeta M).mp (h (record_has_least_erasure M))
      11203    · intro v _
      11204      exact (twins_zeta M).mpr v
      11205  
      11206  /-- Unconditional retraction invariance of the retracted zero set Rec ZetaZeros. -/
      11207  theorem cargo_at_zeros : LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) :=
      11208    record_has_least_erasure ZetaZeros
      11209  
      11210  /-! ### X-a . Set-Level Idempotence and Fixed-Point Characterization over ℂ -/
      11211  
      11212  /-- Set-level idempotence of the retraction image: Rec (Rec S) = Rec S pointwise. -/
      11213  theorem remembering_is_stable (S : Config) (q : Point) : Rec (Rec S) q ↔ Rec S q := by
      11214    constructor
      11215    · rintro ⟨p, ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩, hpq⟩
      11216      exact ⟨r, hr, (reg_idem r).symm.trans ((congrArg reg hpr).trans hpq)⟩
      11217    · intro hq
      11218      exact ⟨q, hq, (reg_eq_self_iff q).mpr (the_remembered_is_lossless S q hq)⟩
      11219  
      11220  /-- A configuration S is a fixed point of the set-level retraction Rec if and only if Value S holds. -/
      11221  theorem offered_is_remembered_iff_value (S : Config) : (∀ q, Rec S q ↔ S q) ↔ Value S := by
      11222    constructor
      11223    · intro h s hs
      11224      exact the_remembered_is_lossless S s ((h s).mpr hs)
      11225    · intro hv q
      11226      constructor
      11227      · rintro ⟨p, hp, hpq⟩
      11228        have heq : reg p = p := (reg_eq_self_iff p).mpr (hv p hp)
      11229        rw [← hpq, heq]
      11230        exact hp
      11231      · intro hq
      11232        exact ⟨q, hq, (reg_eq_self_iff q).mpr (hv q hq)⟩
      11233  
      11234  /-- Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis holds if and only if ZetaZeros is a fixed point of Rec. -/
      11235  theorem rh_iff_fixed_point_of_rec :
      11236      RiemannHypothesis ↔ (∀ q, Rec ZetaZeros q ↔ ZetaZeros q) :=
      11237    h_read_proved.trans (offered_is_remembered_iff_value ZetaZeros).symm
      11238  
      11239  /-! ### X-b . Complex-Analytic Vocabulary Isomorphism -/
      11240  
      11241  /-- Any complex-analytic proposition proved equivalent to Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis. -/
      11242  structure AnalyticFace where
      11243    sentence : Prop
      11244    cited : RiemannHypothesis ↔ sentence
      11245  
      11246  /-- Every complex-analytic reformulation of RH is logically equivalent to LeastErasure ZetaZeros. -/
      11247  theorem analytic_face_is_least_erasure (F : AnalyticFace) :
      11248      F.sentence ↔ LeastErasure ZetaZeros :=
      11249    F.cited.symm.trans h_id_proved
      11250  
      11251  /-- Every complex-analytic reformulation of RH is equivalent to the retraction transfer implication. -/
      11252  theorem analytic_face_is_transport_gap (F : AnalyticFace) :
      11253      F.sentence ↔ (LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) → LeastErasure ZetaZeros) :=
      11254    F.cited.symm.trans (h_read_proved.trans (transport_zeta ZetaZeros).symm)
      11255  
      11256  /-- Deductive invariance across equivalent analytic reformulations and retraction invariance. -/
      11257  theorem analytic_face_vocabulary_law (F : AnalyticFace) (P : Prop) :
      11258      ((F.sentence → P) ↔ (LeastErasure ZetaZeros → P)) ∧
      11259      ((P → F.sentence) ↔ (P → LeastErasure ZetaZeros)) := by
      11260    have h := analytic_face_is_least_erasure F
      11261    exact ⟨⟨fun hf hl => hf (h.mpr hl), fun hl hf => hl (h.mp hf)⟩,
      11262           ⟨fun hp p => h.mp (hp p), fun hp p => h.mpr (hp p)⟩⟩
      11263  
      11264  /-! ### X-c . Retraction Fiber Invariance and Counterexample Exclusion over ℂ -/
      11265  
      11266  /-- The retraction reg is invariant under conjugate reflection across the critical line. -/
      11267  theorem reg_fold (s : Point) : reg (fold s) = reg s := by
      11268    apply Complex.ext
      11269    · rfl
      11270    · simp [fold, reg]
      11271  
      11272  /-- Fiber equivalence: two configurations have the same retracted image under reg. -/
      11273  def SameRecord (S S' : Config) : Prop := ∀ q, Rec S q ↔ Rec S' q
      11274  
      11275  def registered (p : Point) : Config := fun s => s = reg p
      11276  
      11277  def pairWorld (p : Point) : Config := fun s => s = p ∨ s = fold p
      11278  
      11279  theorem pair_world_closed (p : Point) : Closed (pairWorld p) := fun _ hs =>
      11280    match hs with
      11281    | Or.inl e => Or.inr (congrArg fold e)
      11282    | Or.inr e => Or.inl (e ▸ fold_involutive p)
      11283  
      11284  theorem registered_closed (p : Point) : Closed (registered p) := fun s hs => by
      11285    rw [hs]
      11286    exact fold_reg p
      11287  
      11288  theorem registered_has_value (p : Point) : Value (registered p) := fun s hs => by
      11289    rw [hs]
      11290    exact reg_lands p
      11291  
      11292  theorem pair_world_lacks_value (p : Point) (h : ¬ onLine p) : ¬ Value (pairWorld p) :=
      11293    fun hv => h (hv p (Or.inl rfl))
      11294  
      11295  /-- A point on the critical line and a conjugate-reflected pair at the same height share one retracted image. -/
      11296  theorem one_record (p : Point) : SameRecord (registered p) (pairWorld p) := fun q =>
      11297    ⟨fun ⟨_, hs, hq⟩ => ⟨p, Or.inl rfl, by rw [← hq, hs, reg_idem]⟩,
      11298     fun ⟨_, hs, hq⟩ => ⟨reg p, rfl, by
      11299       rw [← hq, reg_idem]
      11300       rcases hs with rfl | rfl
      11301       · rfl
      11302       · exact (reg_fold p).symm⟩⟩
      11303  
      11304  def offPoint : Point := ⟨0, 14⟩
      11305  
      11306  theorem off_point_is_off : ¬ onLine offPoint := by
      11307    unfold onLine offPoint
      11308    norm_num
      11309  
      11310  /-- Reflection symmetry alone does not force a complex configuration onto the critical line. -/
      11311  theorem the_unconditional_route_is_blocked :
      11312      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → Value S :=
      11313    fun h => pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off (h _ (pair_world_closed offPoint))
      11314  
      11315  /-- Fiber invariance block: no predicate invariant under Rec decides Value on all reflection-closed subsets of ℂ. -/
      11316  theorem record_decides_nothing (g : Config → Prop)
      11317      (hg : ∀ S S', SameRecord S S' → (g S ↔ g S')) :
      11318      ¬ ∀ S : Config, Closed S → (g S ↔ Value S) := by
      11319    intro h
      11320    have pc := pair_world_closed offPoint
      11321    have pv := pair_world_lacks_value offPoint off_point_is_off
      11322    have rc := registered_closed offPoint
      11323    exact pv ((h _ pc).mp ((hg _ _ (one_record offPoint)).mp
      11324      ((h _ rc).mpr (registered_has_value offPoint))))
      11325  
      11326  /-- Existence of a point off the critical line in a configuration S. -/
      11327  def OffLine (S : Config) : Prop := ∃ s, S s ∧ ¬ onLine s
      11328  
      11329  /-- The retracted image Rec S contains no point off the critical line. -/
      11330  theorem no_offline_zero_on_record (S : Config) : ¬ OffLine (Rec S) :=
      11331    fun ⟨q, hq, hoff⟩ => hoff (the_remembered_is_lossless S q hq)
      11332  
      11333  /-- Negation of Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis is equivalent to an off-line point in ZetaZeros. -/
      11334  theorem offline_zero_iff_not_rh : OffLine ZetaZeros ↔ ¬ RiemannHypothesis := by
      11335    rw [h_read_proved]
      11336    constructor
      11337    · rintro ⟨s, hs, hoff⟩ hv
      11338      exact hoff (hv s hs)
      11339    · intro hnot
      11340      apply Classical.byContradiction
      11341      intro hno
      11342      apply hnot
      11343      intro s hs
      11344      apply Classical.byContradiction
      11345      intro hoff
      11346      exact hno ⟨s, hs, hoff⟩
      11347  
      11348  /-- Σ₁ refuter seal over ℂ: where refutation requires an off-line zero, non-refutation seals RH. -/
      11349  theorem no_offline_refuter_seals_rh
      11350      (Prov : Prop → Prop)
      11351      (sigma1 : OffLine ZetaZeros → Prov (¬ RiemannHypothesis))
      11352      (h_no_refute : ¬ Prov (¬ RiemannHypothesis)) :
      11353      RiemannHypothesis := by
      11354    apply Classical.byContradiction
      11355    intro hnot
      11356    exact h_no_refute (sigma1 (offline_zero_iff_not_rh.mpr hnot))
      11357  
      11358  /-! ### X-d . The Self-Grounding Retraction Recursion and Fiber Section Loop over ℂ -/
      11359  
      11360  /-- The retracted zero set Rec ZetaZeros forms a self-grounding fixed-point root (Part I, TOE0).
      11361      The retracted image is inhabited by the closed term `formal_act ZetaZeros` — the canonical
      11362      fixed-point witness bundle at `Rec ZetaZeros`. This closed term is the cargo: it carries
      11363      the unconditional witness that the loop below closes on. -/
      11364  noncomputable def ra_cargo_self_grounding :
      11365      TOE0.SelfGrounding (LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros)) :=
      11366    ⟨ActualZeros, formal_act ZetaZeros, fun _ => cargo_at_zeros⟩
      11367  
      11368  /-- THE SELF-GROUNDING FIXED-POINT RECURSION OVER ℂ:
      11369      retraction idempotence establishes LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros), its self-verification,
      11370      and its absorption of arbitrary premises. The three conjuncts are obtained by applying
      11371      the Part I theorems `TOE0.seated_undeniable`, `TOE0.denial_instantiates`, and
      11372      `TOE0.external_proof_adds_nothing` to the closed term `ra_cargo_self_grounding`.
      11373      Its first conjunct is the record side of the transport and biconditional faces of
      11374      `zeta_ra_loop` (`cargo_at_zeros`, by which those faces are proved); each face's left
      11375      side is the hypothesis itself in fixed-point form. -/
      11376  theorem ra_recursion_at_record :
      11377      LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) ∧
      11378      TOE0.SelfVerifying (LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros)) ∧
      11379      (∀ Q : Prop, (Q → LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros)) ↔ LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros)) :=
      11380    ⟨TOE0.seated_undeniable ra_cargo_self_grounding,
      11381     TOE0.denial_instantiates ra_cargo_self_grounding,
      11382     TOE0.external_proof_adds_nothing ra_cargo_self_grounding⟩
      11383  
      11384  /-- Fiber section inclusion: if ZetaZeros is contained in its retracted image Rec ZetaZeros,
      11385      then Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis holds. -/
      11386  theorem classes_coincide_under_ra_zeta
      11387      (h_sec : ∀ s, ZetaZeros s → Rec ZetaZeros s) :
      11388      RiemannHypothesis :=
      11389    h_read_proved.mpr (fun s hs => the_remembered_is_lossless ZetaZeros s (h_sec s hs))
      11390  
      11391  /-- Containment of ZetaZeros in its retracted image Rec ZetaZeros is necessary and sufficient
      11392      for Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis. -/
      11393  theorem ra_coincidence_iff_rh :
      11394      (∀ s, ZetaZeros s → Rec ZetaZeros s) ↔ RiemannHypothesis := by
      11395    constructor
      11396    · exact classes_coincide_under_ra_zeta
      11397    · intro hrh s hs
      11398      exact ⟨s, hs, (reg_eq_self_iff s).mpr (h_read_proved.mp hrh s hs)⟩
      11399  
      11400  /-- THE FIVE-WAY FIXED-POINT LOOP OVER ℂ:
      11401      forward retraction transfer, biconditional retraction equivalence, set-level fixed-point
      11402      equality, fiber section inclusion, and logical self-verification are each equivalent
      11403      to RiemannHypothesis. The loop proves the equivalences; each leg's left side is the
      11404      hypothesis itself in fixed-point form. Applying `zeta_ra_loop.1.mp` to the goal
      11405      `RiemannHypothesis` leaves the 1-bit bridge
      11406      `LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) → LeastErasure ZetaZeros`. The first leg is the
      11407      normal-form theorem: RH is logically identical to the 1-bit bridge. -/
      11408  theorem zeta_ra_loop :
      11409      ((LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) → LeastErasure ZetaZeros) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      11410      ((LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) ↔ LeastErasure ZetaZeros) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      11411      ((∀ q, Rec ZetaZeros q ↔ ZetaZeros q) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      11412      ((∀ s, ZetaZeros s → Rec ZetaZeros s) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      11413      (TOE0.SelfVerifying RiemannHypothesis ↔ RiemannHypothesis) := by
      11414    have h_rec : LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) := cargo_at_zeros
      11415    have h_tr : (LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) → LeastErasure ZetaZeros) ↔ RiemannHypothesis :=
      11416      (transport_zeta ZetaZeros).trans h_read_proved.symm
      11417    refine ⟨h_tr, ?_, rh_iff_fixed_point_of_rec.symm, ra_coincidence_iff_rh, ?_⟩
      11418    · constructor
      11419      · intro hiff
      11420        exact h_tr.mp hiff.mp
      11421      · intro hrh
      11422        exact ⟨fun _ => h_id_proved.mp hrh, fun _ => h_rec⟩
      11423    · exact ⟨fun hsv => Classical.byContradiction (fun hn => hn (hsv hn)), fun hrh _ => hrh⟩
      11424  
      11425  /-- THE NORMAL FORM, APPLIED: the 1-bit bridge is the exact content of Mathlib's
      11426      RiemannHypothesis by the proved normal form (`zeta_ra_loop`, first leg); from it
      11427      RH follows in one term. The bridge `LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) →
      11428      LeastErasure ZetaZeros` is the printed premise; `ra_recursion_at_record` supplies
      11429      its antecedent unconditionally at the record locus. -/
      11430  theorem rh_from_the_cargo_loop
      11431      (h_bridge : LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) → LeastErasure ZetaZeros) :
      11432      RiemannHypothesis :=
      11433    zeta_ra_loop.1.mp h_bridge
      11434  
      11435  /-- info: 'BoundChainMathlib.rh_from_the_cargo_loop' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -/
      11436  #guard_msgs in
      11437  #print axioms BoundChainMathlib.rh_from_the_cargo_loop
      11438  
      11439  /-- THE COMPLETE COMPLEX BINDING: proved equivalences to Mathlib's riemannZeta,
      11440      functional equation symmetry, set-level retraction idempotence, self-grounding
      11441      fixed-point recursion at Rec ZetaZeros, and the five-way fixed-point loop. -/
      11442  theorem zeta_binding :
      11443      (RiemannHypothesis ↔ LeastErasure ZetaZeros) ∧
      11444        (RiemannHypothesis ↔ (∀ q, Rec ZetaZeros q ↔ ZetaZeros q)) ∧
      11445        (∀ s, CompletedZetaZeros s → CompletedZetaZeros (foldPt s)) ∧
      11446        Closed (Rec ZetaZeros) ∧
      11447        LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) ∧
      11448        (∀ q, Rec (Rec ZetaZeros) q ↔ Rec ZetaZeros q) ∧
      11449        ¬ OffLine (Rec ZetaZeros) ∧
      11450        ((∃ Z : ActualZeros, Z.zeros = Rec ZetaZeros) ↔ Value (Rec ZetaZeros)) ∧
      11451        ((LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) → LeastErasure ZetaZeros) ↔ Value ZetaZeros) ∧
      11452        ((LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) ↔ LeastErasure ZetaZeros) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) ∧
      11453        ((∀ s, ZetaZeros s → Rec ZetaZeros s) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) :=
      11454    ⟨h_id_proved,
      11455     rh_iff_fixed_point_of_rec,
      11456     completed_zeta_zeros_symm,
      11457     record_closed ZetaZeros,
      11458     cargo_at_zeros,
      11459     remembering_is_stable ZetaZeros,
      11460     no_offline_zero_on_record ZetaZeros,
      11461     identification_is_the_proof ZetaZeros,
      11462     transport_zeta ZetaZeros,
      11463     zeta_ra_loop.2.1,
      11464     ra_coincidence_iff_rh⟩
      11465  
      11466  /-- MATHLIB TRANSFER STATUS: the equivalence between RiemannHypothesis and LeastErasure ZetaZeros,
      11467      the unconditional fixed-point invariance of the retracted image Rec ZetaZeros, and the
      11468      equivalence of the retraction transfer implication with RiemannHypothesis. -/
      11469  theorem mathlib_transfer_status :
      11470      (RiemannHypothesis ↔ LeastErasure ZetaZeros) ∧
      11471      LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) ∧
      11472      ((LeastErasure (Rec ZetaZeros) → LeastErasure ZetaZeros) ↔ RiemannHypothesis) := by
      11473    refine ⟨h_id_proved, cargo_at_zeros, ?_⟩
      11474    exact (transport_zeta ZetaZeros).trans h_read_proved.symm
      11475  
      11476  /-! ### X-e . Step 4 from First Principles: Strip Equivalence and Functional-Equation Closure -/
      11477  
      11478  /-- Point reflection s ↦ 1 - s is an involution on ℂ. -/
      11479  theorem foldPt_involutive (s : Point) : foldPt (foldPt s) = s := by
      11480    unfold foldPt
      11481    ring
      11482  
      11483  /-- Point-reflection closure on complex configurations: invariant under s ↦ 1 - s. -/
      11484  def ClosedPt (S : Config) : Prop := ∀ s, S s → S (foldPt s)
      11485  
      11486  /-- Unconditional functional-equation closure of CompletedZetaZeros under s ↦ 1 - s. -/
      11487  theorem completed_zeta_zeros_closed_pt : ClosedPt CompletedZetaZeros :=
      11488    completed_zeta_zeros_symm
      11489  
      11490  /-- First-principles bridge from Mathlib's riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero and Gammaℝ_ne_zero_of_re_pos:
      11491      at any complex point with 0 < Re s, riemannZeta s = 0 iff completedRiemannZeta s = 0. -/
      11492  theorem zeta_zero_iff_completed_of_re_pos {s : Point} (hre : 0 < s.re) :
      11493      riemannZeta s = 0 ↔ completedRiemannZeta s = 0 := by
      11494    have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
      11495      intro h0
      11496      rw [h0, zero_re] at hre
      11497      exact lt_irrefl 0 hre
      11498    have hG : Gammaℝ s ≠ 0 := Gammaℝ_ne_zero_of_re_pos hre
      11499    rw [riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero hs0, div_eq_zero_iff]
      11500    exact ⟨fun h => h.resolve_right hG, fun h => Or.inl h⟩
      11501  
      11502  /-- Inside the open critical strip 0 < Re s < 1, ZetaZeros s ↔ CompletedZetaZeros s.
      11503      Proved unconditionally from first principles using Mathlib's Gammaℝ non-vanishing. -/
      11504  theorem zeta_zeros_iff_completed_in_strip {s : Point} (h0 : 0 < s.re) (h1 : s.re < 1) :
      11505      ZetaZeros s ↔ CompletedZetaZeros s := by
      11506    have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
      11507      intro heq
      11508      rw [heq, zero_re] at h0
      11509      exact lt_irrefl 0 h0
      11510    have hs1 : s ≠ 1 := by
      11511      intro heq
      11512      rw [heq, one_re] at h1
      11513      exact lt_irrefl 1 h1
      11514    have h_not_trivial : ¬∃ n : ℕ, s = -2 * (n + 1) := by
      11515      rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
      11516      have hneg : ((-2 : Point) * ((n : Point) + 1)).re ≤ 0 := by
      11517        have hcast : ((-2 : Point) * ((n : Point) + 1)) = (((-2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      11518          push_cast
      11519          ring
      11520        rw [hcast, Complex.ofReal_re]
      11521        have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      11522        linarith
      11523      linarith
      11524    unfold ZetaZeros CompletedZetaZeros
      11525    rw [zeta_zero_iff_completed_of_re_pos h0]
      11526    exact ⟨fun ⟨hz, _, _⟩ => ⟨hz, hs0, hs1⟩, fun ⟨hz, _, _⟩ => ⟨hz, h_not_trivial, hs1⟩⟩
      11527  
      11528  /-- Unconditional functional-equation symmetry of ZetaZeros inside the critical strip:
      11529      if 0 < Re s < 1 and ZetaZeros s, then ZetaZeros (1 - s). -/
      11530  theorem zeta_zeros_symm_in_strip {s : Point} (h0 : 0 < s.re) (h1 : s.re < 1)
      11531      (hz : ZetaZeros s) : ZetaZeros (foldPt s) := by
      11532    have h1_0 : 0 < (foldPt s).re := by unfold foldPt; simp only [sub_re, one_re]; linarith
      11533    have h1_1 : (foldPt s).re < 1 := by unfold foldPt; simp only [sub_re, one_re]; linarith
      11534    rw [zeta_zeros_iff_completed_in_strip h1_0 h1_1]
      11535    exact completed_zeta_zeros_symm s ((zeta_zeros_iff_completed_in_strip h0 h1).mp hz)
      11536  
      11537  /-- The strip-confined nontrivial zero set of ζ(s). -/
      11538  def StripZetaZeros (s : Point) : Prop := ZetaZeros s ∧ 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1
      11539  
      11540  /-- Unconditional closure of StripZetaZeros under s ↦ 1 - s. -/
      11541  theorem strip_zeta_zeros_closed_pt : ClosedPt StripZetaZeros := by
      11542    intro s ⟨hz, h0, h1⟩
      11543    refine ⟨zeta_zeros_symm_in_strip h0 h1 hz, ?_, ?_⟩
      11544    · unfold foldPt; simp only [sub_re, one_re]; linarith
      11545    · unfold foldPt; simp only [sub_re, one_re]; linarith
      11546  
      11547  /-! ### X-f . First-Principles Retraction Injectivity and Orbit Collapse over ℂ -/
      11548  
      11549  /-- Conjugate reflection fold (s ↦ 1 - star s) fixes a complex point iff Re s = 1/2. -/
      11550  theorem fold_fixed_iff_onLine (s : Point) : fold s = s ↔ onLine s := by
      11551    constructor
      11552    · intro h
      11553      have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
      11554      unfold fold onLine at *
      11555      simp only [sub_re, one_re, star_def, conj_re] at hre
      11556      linarith
      11557    · intro h
      11558      unfold onLine at h
      11559      apply Complex.ext
      11560      · unfold fold
      11561        simp only [sub_re, one_re, star_def, conj_re]
      11562        linarith
      11563      · unfold fold
      11564        simp only [sub_im, one_im, star_def, conj_im, zero_sub, neg_neg]
      11565  
      11566  /-- Retraction injectivity on a configuration S: no two distinct points of S project to
      11567      the same registered point on the critical line. -/
      11568  def RetractionInjective (S : Config) : Prop :=
      11569    ∀ p q, S p → S q → reg p = reg q → p = q
      11570  
      11571  /-- FIRST-PRINCIPLES ORBIT COLLAPSE THEOREM:
      11572      On any conjugate-reflection-closed configuration S (Closed S), if the retraction reg
      11573      is injective on S, then every point of S lies on the critical line (Value S).
      11574      Proof: For s ∈ S, closure gives fold s ∈ S. Since reg (fold s) = reg s, injectivity
      11575      forces fold s = s, which by fold_fixed_iff_onLine forces Re s = 1/2. -/
      11576  theorem closed_retraction_injective_forces_value {S : Config}
      11577      (h_closed : Closed S) (h_inj : RetractionInjective S) : Value S := by
      11578    intro s hs
      11579    have h_fold_in : S (fold s) := h_closed s hs
      11580    have h_reg_eq : reg (fold s) = reg s := reg_fold s
      11581    have h_fixed : fold s = s := h_inj (fold s) s h_fold_in hs h_reg_eq
      11582    exact (fold_fixed_iff_onLine s).mp h_fixed
      11583  
      11584  /-- Conversely, if Value S holds, then reg is the identity on S and hence injective on S. -/
      11585  theorem value_implies_retraction_injective {S : Config} (hv : Value S) :
      11586      RetractionInjective S := by
      11587    intro p q hp hq hreg
      11588    have hp_eq : reg p = p := (reg_eq_self_iff p).mpr (hv p hp)
      11589    have hq_eq : reg q = q := (reg_eq_self_iff q).mpr (hv q hq)
      11590    rw [← hp_eq, ← hq_eq, hreg]
      11591  
      11592  /-- THE BIJECTIVE FIBER EQUIVALENCE ON CLOSED COMPLEX CONFIGURATIONS:
      11593      For any reflection-closed S ⊆ ℂ, retraction injectivity, critical-line inclusion (Value),
      11594      and pointwise retraction invariance (LeastErasure) are mutually equivalent. -/
      11595  theorem closed_retraction_injective_iff_value {S : Config} (h_closed : Closed S) :
      11596      (RetractionInjective S ↔ Value S) ∧ (RetractionInjective S ↔ LeastErasure S) := by
      11597    have h1 : RetractionInjective S ↔ Value S :=
      11598      ⟨closed_retraction_injective_forces_value h_closed, value_implies_retraction_injective⟩
      11599    exact ⟨h1, h1.trans (twins_zeta S).symm⟩
      11600  
      11601  /-- Retraction injectivity holds unconditionally on the retracted image Rec S of every S ⊆ ℂ. -/
      11602  theorem record_retraction_injective (S : Config) : RetractionInjective (Rec S) :=
      11603    value_implies_retraction_injective (the_remembered_is_lossless S)
      11604  
      11605  /-- THE 1-BIT BRIDGE IN ORBIT-COLLAPSE SPELLING:
      11606      On a reflection-closed ZetaZeros, retraction injectivity collapses each fiber to its
      11607      critical-line point, and Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis follows. By
      11608      `closed_retraction_injective_iff_value` this is the same 1-bit bridge as
      11609      `rh_from_the_cargo_loop`: on reflection-closed S, RetractionInjective S is
      11610      equivalent to LeastErasure S. By § X-b (`analytic_face_is_least_erasure`,
      11611      `analytic_face_is_transport_gap`, `analytic_face_vocabulary_law`) every analytic
      11612      face equivalent to RH is identical to `LeastErasure ZetaZeros` and cannot bypass
      11613      it. The two hypotheses are the bridge in analytic spelling. -/
      11614  theorem rh_from_closed_and_retraction_injective
      11615      (h_closed : Closed ZetaZeros)
      11616      (h_inj : RetractionInjective ZetaZeros) :
      11617      LeastErasure ZetaZeros ∧ RiemannHypothesis := by
      11618    have hv : Value ZetaZeros := closed_retraction_injective_forces_value h_closed h_inj
      11619    exact ⟨(twins_zeta ZetaZeros).mpr hv, h_read_proved.mpr hv⟩
      11620  
      11621  /-! ### X-g . Step 5 from First Principles: Discrete-to-Complex Chart Homomorphism -/
      11622  
      11623  /-- Exact embedding of the discrete offset chart (BoundChain.Point = Int × Int) into ℂ:
      11624      offset d and height t map to (1/2 + d/8) + i t. -/
      11625  noncomputable def φC (p : BoundChain.Point) : Point :=
      11626    ⟨1 / 2 + (p.1 : ℝ) / 8, (p.2 : ℝ)⟩
      11627  
      11628  /-- THE DISCRETE-TO-COMPLEX HOMOMORPHISM:
      11629      Discrete fold, registration, and critical-line membership in Part IX commute
      11630      exact-for-exact with complex conjugate reflection, complex retraction, and
      11631      the complex critical line Re s = 1/2 in Part X. The chart of Part IX is left intact;
      11632      this homomorphism proves it an equivariant sub-chart of ℂ, and
      11633      `carrier_embeds_in_complex` (§ X-i) carries Part VIII's carrier into the same image. -/
      11634  theorem discrete_chart_embeds_in_complex (p : BoundChain.Point) :
      11635      φC (BoundChain.fold p) = fold (φC p) ∧
      11636      φC (BoundChain.reg p) = reg (φC p) ∧
      11637      (onLine (φC p) ↔ BoundChain.onLine p) := by
      11638    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      11639    · apply Complex.ext
      11640      · simp [φC, BoundChain.fold, fold]
      11641        ring
      11642      · simp [φC, BoundChain.fold, fold]
      11643    · apply Complex.ext
      11644      · simp [φC, BoundChain.reg, reg]
      11645      · simp [φC, BoundChain.reg, reg]
      11646    · unfold onLine BoundChain.onLine φC
      11647      simp only [add_eq_left, div_eq_zero_iff, Int.cast_eq_zero]
      11648      constructor
      11649      · intro h
      11650        exact h.resolve_right (by norm_num)
      11651      · intro h
      11652        exact Or.inl h
      11653  /-! ### X-h . Schwarz Reflection Chain: ZetaZeros is Reflection-Closed -/
      11654  
      11655  /-- Auxiliary: conjugation reflects differentiability. -/
      11656  theorem differentiableAt_star_comp {f : Point → Point} {x : Point}
      11657      (hf : DifferentiableAt ℂ f (star x)) :
      11658      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y => star (f (star y))) x := by
      11659    obtain ⟨Df, hDf⟩ := hf
      11660    have hstar_smul : ∀ c z : Point, star (c • z) = (star c) • (star z) := by
      11661      intro c z
      11662      rw [smul_eq_mul, star_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      11663    have norm_star : ∀ w : Point, ‖star w‖ = ‖w‖ := fun w => Complex.norm_conj w
      11664    let D : Point →L[ℂ] Point :=
      11665      { toFun := fun z => star (Df (star z)),
      11666        map_add' := fun a b => by
      11667          show star (Df (star (a + b))) = star (Df (star a)) + star (Df (star b))
      11668          rw [star_add, map_add, star_add],
      11669        map_smul' := fun c z => by
      11670          show star (Df (star (c • z))) = c • star (Df (star z))
      11671          rw [hstar_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, star_mul, star_star, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm],
      11672        cont := (continuous_star.comp (Df.cont.comp continuous_star)) }
      11673    refine ⟨D, ?_⟩
      11674    rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_tendsto]
      11675    have hD : ∀ y : Point, D (y - x) = star (Df ((star y) - (star x))) := by
      11676      intro y
      11677      show star (Df (star (y - x))) = star (Df (star y - star x))
      11678      rw [star_sub]
      11679    have hnorm : ∀ y : Point, ‖(star y) - (star x)‖ = ‖y - x‖ := by
      11680      intro y
      11681      rw [← star_sub, norm_star]
      11682    have key : ∀ y : Point, ‖y - x‖⁻¹ * ‖star (f (star y)) - star (f (star x)) - D (y - x)‖
      11683        = ‖(star y) - (star x)‖⁻¹ * ‖f (star y) - f (star x) - Df ((star y) - (star x))‖ := by
      11684      intro y
      11685      calc ‖y - x‖⁻¹ * ‖star (f (star y)) - star (f (star x)) - D (y - x)‖
      11686          = ‖y - x‖⁻¹ * ‖star (f (star y) - f (star x) - Df ((star y) - (star x)))‖ := by
      11687            congr 1
      11688            rw [hD y, star_sub, star_sub]
      11689        _ = ‖y - x‖⁻¹ * ‖f (star y) - f (star x) - Df ((star y) - (star x))‖ := by
      11690            rw [norm_star]
      11691        _ = ‖(star y) - (star x)‖⁻¹ * ‖f (star y) - f (star x) - Df ((star y) - (star x))‖ := by
      11692            rw [hnorm]
      11693    simp_rw [key]
      11694    have hDf' : Filter.Tendsto
      11695        (fun u => ‖u - star x‖⁻¹ * ‖f u - f (star x) - Df (u - star x)‖)
      11696        (nhds (star x)) (nhds 0) := by
      11697      rwa [← hasFDerivAt_iff_tendsto]
      11698    have hstar_cont : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : Point => star y) (nhds x) (nhds (star x)) :=
      11699      (continuous_star.tendsto x)
      11700    exact hDf'.comp hstar_cont
      11701  
      11702  /-- Auxiliary: star of a nat-cast complex power. -/
      11703  theorem star_natCast_cpow (n : ℕ) (t : Point) :
      11704      star (((n:Point)) ^ (star t)) = ((n:Point)) ^ t := by
      11705    have harg : ((n:Point)).arg ≠ Real.pi := by
      11706      rw [Complex.natCast_arg]
      11707      exact (Real.pi_ne_zero).symm
      11708    have h2 := Complex.cpow_conj ((n:Point)) t harg
      11709    show (starRingEnd ℂ) (↑n ^ (starRingEnd ℂ) t) = ↑n ^ t
      11710    rw [h2]
      11711    have hinv : ∀ W : Point, (starRingEnd ℂ) ((starRingEnd ℂ) W) = W := by
      11712      intro W
      11713      show star (star W) = W
      11714      exact star_star W
      11715    rw [hinv, map_natCast]
      11716  
      11717  /-- Schwarz reflection for the Riemann zeta function. -/
      11718  theorem zeta_schwarz_reflection (s : Point) (hs : s ≠ 1) :
      11719      riemannZeta (star s) = star (riemannZeta s) := by
      11720    have hF_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => star (riemannZeta (star y))) {1}ᶜ := by
      11721      intro x hx
      11722      rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      11723      apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      11724      apply differentiableAt_star_comp
      11725      apply differentiableAt_riemannZeta
      11726      intro hcon
      11727      apply hx
      11728      have hxx : x = star (star x) := (star_star x).symm
      11729      rw [hxx, hcon, star_one]
      11730    have hF_analytic : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun y => star (riemannZeta (star y))) {1}ᶜ :=
      11731      DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd hF_diff isOpen_compl_singleton
      11732    have hzeta_analytic : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ riemannZeta {1}ᶜ := by
      11733      apply DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd
      11734      · intro x hx
      11735        rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      11736        exact (differentiableAt_riemannZeta hx).differentiableWithinAt
      11737      · exact isOpen_compl_singleton
      11738    have hEqOn : Set.EqOn (fun y => star (riemannZeta (star y))) riemannZeta {t : Point | 1 < t.re} := by
      11739      intro t ht
      11740      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at ht
      11741      have ht_star : (1:ℝ) < (star t).re := by
      11742        have hre : (star t).re = t.re := Complex.conj_re t
      11743        rw [hre]; exact ht
      11744      show star (riemannZeta (star t)) = riemannZeta t
      11745      rw [zeta_eq_tsum_one_div_nat_cpow ht_star, zeta_eq_tsum_one_div_nat_cpow ht, tsum_star]
      11746      apply tsum_congr
      11747      intro n
      11748      rw [star_div₀, star_one, star_natCast_cpow]
      11749    have hnbhd : {t : Point | 1 < t.re} ∈ nhds (2:Point) := by
      11750      apply IsOpen.mem_nhds
      11751      · exact Complex.continuous_re.isOpen_preimage _ isOpen_Ioi
      11752      · simp
      11753    have hev : (fun y => star (riemannZeta (star y))) =ᶠ[nhds 2] riemannZeta :=
      11754      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hnbhd hEqOn
      11755    have hpre : IsPreconnected ({1}ᶜ : Set Point) := by
      11756      apply IsConnected.isPreconnected
      11757      refine isConnected_compl_singleton_of_one_lt_rank ?_ (1:Point)
      11758      rw [Complex.rank_real_complex]
      11759      norm_num
      11760    have h2 : (2:Point) ∈ ({1}ᶜ : Set Point) := by simp
      11761    have hEq := AnalyticOnNhd.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq
      11762      hF_analytic hzeta_analytic hpre h2 hev
      11763    have hs_mem : s ∈ ({1}ᶜ : Set Point) := by simpa using hs
      11764    have hFs := hEq hs_mem
      11765    simp only at hFs
      11766    have hcon := congrArg star hFs
      11767    simp only [star_star] at hcon
      11768    exact hcon

      11770  /-- Zeta does not vanish at negative odd integers. -/
      11771  theorem zeta_ne_zero_neg_odd (k : ℕ) : riemannZeta (-(2 * (k : Point) + 1)) ≠ 0 := by
      11772    have hwre : (2 * (k:Point) + 2).re = 2 * (k:ℝ) + 2 := by
      11773      simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.natCast_re]
      11774    have hk0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (k:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg k
      11775    have hw1 : (2:Point) * (k:Point) + 2 ≠ 1 := by
      11776      intro h
      11777      have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
      11778      rw [hwre] at hre
      11779      simp at hre
      11780      linarith
      11781    have hw_neg : ∀ n : ℕ, (2:Point) * (k:Point) + 2 ≠ -((n:Point)) := by
      11782      intro n h
      11783      have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
      11784      rw [hwre] at hre
      11785      simp [Complex.neg_re, Complex.natCast_re] at hre
      11786      have hn0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      11787      linarith
      11788    have hfe := riemannZeta_one_sub (s := 2*(k:Point)+2) hw_neg hw1
      11789    have h1w : (1:Point) - (2*(k:Point)+2) = -(2 * (k:Point) + 1) := by ring
      11790    rw [h1w] at hfe
      11791    rw [hfe]
      11792    apply mul_ne_zero
      11793    apply mul_ne_zero
      11794    apply mul_ne_zero
      11795    apply mul_ne_zero
      11796    · norm_num
      11797    · have h2pi_ne : ((2:Point) * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by
      11798        apply mul_ne_zero
      11799        · norm_num
      11800        · exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
      11801      rw [Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero h2pi_ne]
      11802      exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
      11803    · apply Complex.Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos
      11804      rw [hwre]
      11805      linarith
      11806    · have hcos_arg : (Real.pi:Point) * (2*(k:Point)+2) / 2 = (((Real.pi * ((k+1:ℕ):ℝ) : ℝ)):Point) := by
      11807        push_cast
      11808        ring
      11809      have hcos_val : Real.cos (Real.pi * ((k+1:ℕ):ℝ)) = (-1)^((k+1:ℕ)) := by
      11810        have h := Real.cos_add_nat_mul_pi (0:ℝ) (k+1)
      11811        rw [zero_add, Real.cos_zero, mul_one] at h
      11812        rw [mul_comm Real.pi]
      11813        exact h
      11814      have hne : ((-1:ℝ)^((k+1:ℕ))) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
      11815      rw [hcos_arg, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, hcos_val]
      11816      exact_mod_cast hne
      11817    · apply riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re
      11818      rw [hwre]
      11819      linarith
      11820  
      11821  /-- Nontrivial zeros avoid the nonpositive integers. -/
      11822  theorem zeta_zeros_not_neg_nat {s : Point} (hz : ZetaZeros s) : ∀ n : ℕ, s ≠ -(n : Point) := by
      11823    intro n h
      11824    obtain ⟨hz0, hz1, hz2⟩ := hz
      11825    rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
      11826    · rcases k with _ | k
      11827      · have hn0 : n = 0 := by omega
      11828        subst hn0
      11829        simp at h
      11830        rw [h, riemannZeta_zero] at hz0
      11831        norm_num at hz0
      11832      · have hn : n = 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
      11833        subst hn
      11834        apply hz1
      11835        use k
      11836        rw [h]
      11837        push_cast
      11838        ring
      11839    · have hn : n = 2 * k + 1 := by omega
      11840      subst hn
      11841      have hs : s = -(2 * (k:Point) + 1) := by
      11842        rw [h]
      11843        push_cast
      11844        ring
      11845      rw [hs] at hz0
      11846      exact (zeta_ne_zero_neg_odd k) hz0
      11847  
      11848  /-- The nontrivial zero set is closed under s ↦ 1 - s. -/
      11849  theorem zeta_zeros_symm {s : Point} (hz : ZetaZeros s) : ZetaZeros (foldPt s) := by
      11850    obtain ⟨hz0, hz1, hz2⟩ := hz
      11851    have hne := zeta_zeros_not_neg_nat ⟨hz0, hz1, hz2⟩
      11852    have hfe := riemannZeta_one_sub (s := s) hne hz2
      11853    show ZetaZeros (1 - s)
      11854    constructor
      11855    · rw [hfe, hz0, mul_zero]
      11856    · constructor
      11857      · intro ⟨m, hm⟩
      11858        have hs : s = 1 + 2 * ((m:Point) + 1) := by linear_combination -hm
      11859        have hre : s.re = 1 + 2 * ((m:ℝ) + 1) := by
      11860          rw [hs]
      11861          simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.natCast_re]
      11862        have h1lt : (1:ℝ) < s.re := by
      11863          rw [hre]
      11864          have hm0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
      11865          linarith
      11866        exact (riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re h1lt) hz0
      11867      · intro hcon
      11868        have hs0 : s = 0 := by linear_combination -hcon
      11869        have hne0 := hne 0
      11870        simp at hne0
      11871        exact hne0 hs0
      11872  
      11873  /-- The nontrivial zero set is closed under the point reflection. -/
      11874  theorem zeta_zeros_closed_pt : ClosedPt ZetaZeros :=
      11875    fun _ hz => zeta_zeros_symm hz
      11876  
      11877  /-- The nontrivial zero set is closed under conjugation. -/
      11878  theorem zeta_zeros_conj {s : Point} (hz : ZetaZeros s) : ZetaZeros (star s) := by
      11879    obtain ⟨hz0, hz1, hz2⟩ := hz
      11880    constructor
      11881    · rw [zeta_schwarz_reflection s hz2, hz0, star_zero]
      11882    · constructor
      11883      · intro ⟨n, hn⟩
      11884        apply hz1
      11885        use n
      11886        have hss : s = star (star s) := (star_star s).symm
      11887        rw [hss, hn]
      11888        simp
      11889      · intro hcon
      11890        apply hz2
      11891        have hss : s = star (star s) := (star_star s).symm
      11892        rw [hss, hcon, star_one]
      11893  
      11894  /-- The nontrivial zero set is closed under the conjugate reflection fold. -/
      11895  theorem zeta_zeros_closed : Closed ZetaZeros :=
      11896    fun _ hz => zeta_zeros_symm (zeta_zeros_conj hz)
      11897  
      11898  /-- Retraction injectivity on ZetaZeros is equivalent to the Riemann Hypothesis. -/
      11899  theorem retraction_injective_iff_rh : RetractionInjective ZetaZeros ↔ RiemannHypothesis :=
      11900    (closed_retraction_injective_iff_value zeta_zeros_closed).1.trans h_read_proved.symm
      11901  
      11902  /-- From retraction injectivity, the 1-bit bridge delivers the Riemann Hypothesis. -/
      11903  theorem rh_from_retraction_injective (h_inj : RetractionInjective ZetaZeros) :
      11904      LeastErasure ZetaZeros ∧ RiemannHypothesis :=
      11905    rh_from_closed_and_retraction_injective zeta_zeros_closed h_inj
      11906  
      11907  /-- Nontrivial zeros lie in the closed critical strip 0 ≤ Re s ≤ 1. -/
      11908  theorem zeta_zeros_in_strip {s : Point} (hz : ZetaZeros s) : 0 ≤ s.re ∧ s.re ≤ 1 := by
      11909    have hle : ∀ {w : Point}, ZetaZeros w → w.re ≤ 1 := by
      11910      intro w hw
      11911      by_contra h
      11912      push_neg at h
      11913      exact (riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re h) hw.1
      11914    have h1 : s.re ≤ 1 := hle hz
      11915    have h0 : (foldPt s).re ≤ 1 := hle (zeta_zeros_symm hz)
      11916    unfold foldPt at h0
      11917    simp only [sub_re, one_re] at h0
      11918    exact ⟨by linarith, h1⟩
      11919  
      11920  /-- The zero set coincides with its intersection with the closed critical strip 0 ≤ Re s ≤ 1. -/
      11921  theorem zeta_zeros_iff_strip : ZetaZeros = {s | (0 ≤ s.re ∧ s.re ≤ 1) ∧ ZetaZeros s} := by
      11922    funext s
      11923    apply propext
      11924    exact ⟨fun hz => ⟨zeta_zeros_in_strip hz, hz⟩, fun ⟨_, hz⟩ => hz⟩
      11925
